黑洞磁层的电阻性对齐

Resistive alignment of a black-hole magnetosphere

Ruben Lier, Oliver Porth · astro-ph.HE, hep-th, physics.plasm-ph · v2 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：近期数值模拟显示，黑洞磁层会迅速演化至磁轴与自旋轴对齐，但其物理起源仍不清楚。我们在电阻性相对论磁流体力学框架下建立该对齐的解析理论。以慢旋转的 Blandford-Znajek 单极子解作为外部磁场，将感应方程约化为电流片倾角的弛豫方程。分析表明，对齐源于 Blandford-Znajek 解中的二阶自旋效应与显式电阻耗散的共同作用。我们用多个自旋和电阻率的电阻性 GRMHD 模拟检验该预言，并将测得的晚期长期衰减与解析预言比较。因此，该对齐时标携带了结合等离子体耗散与时空旋转的独特特征。

English: Recent numerical simulations have shown that black-hole magnetospheres evolve rapidly toward alignment between the magnetic axis and spin axis but the physical origin of this process has remained unclear. We develop an analytic theory of this alignment within resistive relativistic magnetohydrodynamics. Taking the slow-spin Blandford-Znajek monopole solution as the exterior magnetic field, we reduce the induction equation to a relaxation equation for the current-sheet inclination angle. Our analysis shows that alignment results from second-order spin effects in the Blandford-Znajek solution combined with explicit resistive dissipation. We test this prediction using resistive-GRMHD simulations at several spins and resistivities and compare the measured late-time secular decay with the analytic prediction. This alignment timescale hence carries a unique signature which combines plasma dissipation with spacetime rotation.

一句话导读：建立电阻性相对论 MHD 中黑洞磁层磁轴-自旋轴对齐的解析理论，并用 GRMHD 模拟验证。

引力几何三位一体中的真空稳定性

Vacuum stability in Geometric Trinity of Gravity

Vincenzo Branchina, Salvatore Capozziello, Filippo Contino, Carmen Ferrara · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：我们研究广义相对论、其远平行等价表述和对称远平行等价表述之间的经典等价性是否在半经典领头阶延伸到假真空衰变。对于最小耦合引力的实标量场，我们比较决定衰变率指数抑制的隧穿指数 B=S_b-S_fv 与欧几里得反弹作用量 S_b 和假真空作用量 S_fv。三种表述给出相同的 O(4) 对称 Coleman-De Luccia 反弹，但联系它们作用量的边界项可能对 B 有贡献。我们显式计算了正则原点 r=0 和渐近端点 r→∞ 处的挠率与非度规性边界贡献。对于反弹与假真空边界数据一致匹配的正则位形，这些贡献在 TEGR 和 STEGR 中均消失。因此得到 B_GR=B_TEGR=B_STEGR，表明在所考虑的位形和边界条件类别内，三种表述预言相同的半经典领头阶假真空衰变抑制。

English: We investigate whether the classical equivalence of general relativity, its teleparallel equivalent, and its symmetric teleparallel equivalent extends to false-vacuum decay at leading semiclassical order. For a real scalar field minimally coupled to gravity, we compare the tunnelling exponent $B=S_{\rm b}-S_{\rm fv}$, which determines the exponential suppression of the decay rate, $\Gamma\sim e^{-B}$, with the Euclidean bounce, $S_{\rm b}$, and false-vacuum actions, $S_{\rm fv}$. The three formulations admit the same $O(4)$-symmetric Coleman-De Luccia bounce, but the boundary terms relating their actions can contribute to $B$. We explicitly evaluate the torsion and non-metricity boundary contributions at the regular origin, $r=0$, and at the asymptotic endpoint, $r\to\infty$. For regular configurations with consistently matched bounce and false-vacuum boundary data, these contributions vanish in both TEGR and STEGR. We therefore obtain $B_{\rm GR}=B_{\rm TEGR}=B_{\rm STEGR}$, establishing that the three formulations predict the same leading semiclassical suppression of false-vacuum decay within the class of configurations and boundary conditions considered.

一句话导读：在 GR、TEGR 与 STEGR 中比较 Coleman-De Luccia 反弹，表明边界项不改变领头半经典假真空衰变指数。

非广延视界熵与拓扑校准的热力学引力

Thermodynamic Gravity with Non-Extensive Horizon Entropy and Topological Calibration

Marco Figliolia, Petr Jizba, Gaetano Lambiase · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO, hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：论文重新审视Jacobson从视界热力学推导引力的框架，针对广义非广延视界熵S(A)建立一致描述。把S(A)视为进入热力学本构关系的粗粒化熵后，在局部Rindler楔构造中只有参考面积A_*处的局部斜率影响宏观动力学；Clausius关系被改写为固定Unruh温度下Massieu泛函的平稳条件，熵斜率s0控制有效引力耦合，线性熵恢复Einstein方程且G_eff=1/(4s0)。作为独立检验，标量响应扩展加内部熵产生可重现f(R)引力场方程。文章还采用幂律熵S(A)=η(A/4G)^δ，并引入基于Gauss-Bonnet定理的拓扑校准原则以消除粗粒化尺度歧义，得到由Euler示性数控制的拓扑相关有效耦合，并讨论对广延性的偏离及可能的宇宙学观测效应。

English: We revisit Jacobson's thermodynamic derivation of gravity for generalized, non-extensive horizon entropies and develop a consistent framework in which modified gravitational dynamics emerge from horizon thermodynamics. By interpreting $S(A)$ as a coarse-grained entropy entering the thermodynamic constitutive relation, we show that only its local slope at a reference area $A_*$ contributes to macroscopic dynamics within a local Rindler-wedge construction. In this setting, the Clausius relation is reformulated as a stationarity condition for a Massieu functional at fixed Unruh temperature, allowing the entropy slope $s_0=(dS/dA)|_{A_*}$ to be identified as the parameter controlling the effective gravitational coupling. For entropy linear in area, Einstein's equations are recovered with $G_{\mathrm{eff}}=1/(4s_0)$. As a separate consistency check, we demonstrate that a scalar-response extension of the horizon entropy density, supplemented by internal entropy production, correctly reproduces the field equations of $f(R)$ gravity. Motivated by group-entropic arguments and generalized thermodynamics, we adopt a power-law entropy $S(A)=\eta(A/4G)^{\delta}$ and study its implications across scales. To remove the ambiguity in the coarse-graining scale, we introduce a Topological Calibration Principle linking the reference area to intrinsic geometric data through the Gauss-Bonnet theorem. For compact cross-sections admitted by the chosen theory or boundary conditions, this yields a topology-dependent effective coupling governed by the Euler characteristic. Consistency requirements constrain deviations from extensivity and generate scale-dependent modifications with potentially observable cosmological signatures. The resulting framework provides a systematic setting for testing non-extensive horizon thermodynamics and its phenomenological implications.

一句话导读：从非广延视界熵的局部斜率出发重构热力学引力，并用Gauss-Bonnet拓扑校准得到拓扑相关的有效引力耦合。

相关度：medium — 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论中的热力学引力与修改引力，涉及Einstein方程和f(R)场方程，与用户关注的经典引力支线相关；但不涉及AdS/CFT或全息对偶具体字典，因此全息相关性低。

暗物质晕中极端质量比旋进引力波中的混沌印记

Chaotic Imprints in Gravitational Waves from Extreme-Mass-Ratio-Inspirals Embedded in Dark Matter Halo

Surajit Das, Surojit Dalui, Bum-Hoon Lee, Yi-Fu Cai · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO, hep-th, nlin.CD · v2 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：我们研究嵌于Dehnen型暗物质晕中的超大质量Schwarzschild类黑洞周围，一个受外部谐振子势约束的恒星级天体所构成极端质量比旋进构型中，引力波携带的混沌印记。基于此前用Poincaré截面、轨道演化和Lyapunov指数展示该系统由非混沌到混沌转变的工作，本文采用numerical kludge方案计算小天体沿不同混沌与非混沌轨道的引力波形，并对波形做谱分析。结果显示，当系统处于混沌态时，所考虑混沌轨道的引力波信号具有更宽且有限宽度的频谱、不规则的波形调制和相对较大的应变偏离，并伴随改变的能量辐射特征，从而明显区别于非混沌态信号。我们还讨论LISA、天琴和太极等未来探测器对这些轨道的潜在可探测性，强调探测引力波中的混沌印记对理解黑洞物理和星系核暗物质环境的意义。

English: We investigate imprints of chaos in gravitational waves from extreme-mass-ratio inspirals configuration, where a stellar massive object, confined in an external potential as a harmonic oscillators, orbits a supermassive Schwarzschild-like black hole embedded in a Dehnen-type dark matter halo. In our previous work (Das S, et al., Extreme-mass-ratio inspirals embedded in dark matter halo: Existence of homoclinic orbit and horizon-induced chaos, Sci. China-Phys. Mech. Astron. 69, 290413 (2026)), we demonstrated the system's transition from non-chaotic to chaotic dynamics by analyzing Poincar\'e sections, orbital evolution, and Lyapunov exponents across different energies and dark matter halo parameters. In this work, we compute the gravitational waveforms of the small celestial object along different chaotic and non-chaotic orbits by implementing the numerical kludge scheme. We further perform spectral analysis of the gravitational waveforms from such orbits. In particular, we show that when the system is in a chaotic state, the gravitational wave signals are characterized by broader frequency spectra with finite widths, irregular waveform modulations with comparatively large strain excursions for the chaotic trajectories considered here, together with modified energy-emission characteristics, distinctly differentiating them from the signals generated during the system's non-chaotic state. Furthermore, we discuss the potential detectability of these orbits for upcoming observatories like Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA), TianQin, and Taiji, emphasizing the significant potential for detecting chaotic imprints in gravitational waves to substantially enhance our understanding of chaotic dynamics in black hole physics and the dark matter environments of galactic nuclei.

一句话导读：暗物质晕中的极端质量比旋进若处于混沌轨道，其引力波频谱更宽、调制不规则且能量辐射改变，并可能被LISA/天琴/太极探测。

极端黑洞模拟体：几何、稳定性与长延迟信号列

Extremal black hole mimickers: geometry, stability, and long-delay signal trains

Sergey N. Solodukhin · hep-th, gr-qc, math-ph, math.MP · v2 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：我们提出一种作为极端黑洞无视界模拟体的时空。与先前研究的非退化视界黑洞模拟体不同（其几何为虫洞型，由长喉道连接两个渐近平直区域），极端黑洞模拟体一端只有一个渐近平直区域，另一端为无限长喉道。在喉道区域，时空趋近于直积几何 M_{1,1}×S^2，其中 M_{1,1} 为二维闵可夫斯基时空，S^2 为二维球面。我们研究标量场动力学以及 Aretakis 不稳定性的命运。尽管在喉道的局部分析中出现类 Aretakis 模式，它们并不导致该模拟体的物理不稳定性。初始局域于喉道的标量扰动在晚期产生一系列信号，其特征间隔为 t_delay~1/λ，其中 λ<<1 为形变参数。该时间尺度在参数上大于非极端黑洞模拟体特征的 echo 时间 t_echo~ln(1/λ)。我们称此序列为长延迟信号列。几何上，长延迟信号的周期性关联于 S^2 上的周期测地线。随后我们将构造推广到极端 Kerr。此时喉道区域趋近于涉及 M_{1,1} 与二维曲面 Σ_2 的广义直积几何。相应信号预计形成准周期信号列，反映 Σ_2 上的准周期测地运动。我们还评论了对非极端黑洞虫洞型模拟体的推广，以及这些结果在 AdS/CFT 对应背景下对幺正性的启示。

English: We present a spacetime that serves as a horizonless mimicker of extremal black holes. Unlike previously studied mimickers of black holes with non-degenerate horizons, whose geometries are of the wormhole type and consist of two asymptotically flat regions connected by a very long throat, the mimicker of an extremal black hole possesses a single asymptotically flat region at one end and an infinitely long throat at the other. In the throat region, the spacetime approaches the direct-product geometry $M_{1,1} \times S^2$, where $M_{1,1}$ is two-dimensional Minkowski spacetime and $S^2$ is the two-sphere. We investigate scalar-field dynamics and the fate of the Aretakis instability. Although Aretakis-like modes arise in a local analysis of the throat, they do not lead to a physical instability of the mimicker. A scalar perturbation initially localized in the throat gives rise, at late times, to a sequence of signals with a characteristic separation $t_{\rm delay}\sim 1/\lambda$, where $\lambda\ll 1$ is a deformation parameter. This timescale is parametrically larger than the echo time $t_{\rm echo}\sim \ln(1/\lambda)$ characteristic of non-extremal black-hole mimickers. We refer to this sequence as a {\it long-delay signal train}. Geometrically, the periodicity of the long-delay signals is associated with periodic geodesics on $S^2$. We then extend the construction to extremal Kerr. In this case, the throat region approaches a generalized product geometry involving $M_{1,1}$ and a two-dimensional surface $\Sigma_2$. The corresponding signals are expected to form a quasi-periodic signal train, reflecting the quasi-periodic geodesic motion on $\Sigma_2$. We also comment on the generalization to wormhole mimickers of non-extremal black holes and on the implications of these results for unitarity in the context of the AdS/CFT correspondence.

一句话导读：构造无视界极端黑洞模拟时空，分析标量场稳定性并发现由 S^2 测地线导致的长延迟信号列。

相关度：medium — 论文主要属于经典引力/黑洞模拟时空与标量扰动稳定性研究，并涉及长延迟信号列；仅在结尾提及 AdS/CFT 幺正性，未展开全息计算，因此与全息主线相关性中等。

Courant–Hilbert 变形的引力实现

A gravitational realization of Courant--Hilbert deformations

Osamu Fukushima, Miyabi Kurihara, Takaki Matsumoto, Kentaroh Yoshida · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：Courant–Hilbert（CH）变形统一了包括 T\bar{T} 和 root-T\bar{T} 在内的多类可解应力张量流。然而，一个能够系统地给出这类一般变形的引力作用量此前仍属未知。本文构造了一个二维有质量引力理论，其在壳作用量可完整重现 CH 变形。引力部分由相对 zweibein 本征值比 y 的任意函数定义。为绕过直接消去辅助 zweibein 的技术困难，我们采用涉及 y 和秩一投影算符 K 的 2×2 谱分解来重新表述物质部分。依次求解运动方程（先对 K 后对 y）自然将体系映射到 CH 流的 Russo–Townsend 形式。我们的工作将 Tolley 关于 T\bar{T} 流的有质量引力表述推广到 CH 范围，为可解应力张量流提供了清晰的几何机制。

English: Courant--Hilbert (CH) deformations unify broad classes of solvable stress-tensor flows including $T\bar{T}$ and root-$T\bar{T}$. However, a gravitational action that systematically yields such general deformations has remained unknown. In this Letter, we construct a two-dimensional massive gravity theory whose on-shell action reproduces the complete CH deformation. The gravity sector is defined via an arbitrary function of the eigenvalue ratio $y$ of the relative zweibein. To bypass the technical difficulty of directly eliminating the auxiliary zweibein, we reformulate the matter sector using a $2 \times 2$ spectral decomposition involving $y$ and a rank-one projector $K$. Sequentially solving the equations of motion---first for $K$ and subsequently for $y$---naturally maps the system onto the Russo-Townsend form of the CH flow. Our work extends Tolley's massive gravity formulation of $T\bar{T}$ flows to the CH landscape, providing a clear geometric mechanism for solvable stress-tensor flows.

一句话导读：构造二维有质量引力作用量，使其在壳作用量重现一般 Courant–Hilbert 变形，并将 Tolley 的 T\bar{T} 引力表述推广到 CH 范围。

Higgs 支 CFT2 诱导规范理论的 BRST 量子化

BRST quantization of the induced gauge theory for the Higgs-branch CFT${}_2$

Bogdan Stefa\'nski Jr · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：我们研究 Witten 提出的与 D1-D5 Higgs 支 CFT2 相关的诱导规范理论：其中非动力学矢量多重态通过积分掉基本超多重态而获得动力学。我们提出该理论的 BRST 量子化并推导诱导传播子。我们证明鬼场扇区首次在次领头阶贡献，诱导的 Aφ² 顶点满足 Slavnov-Taylor 恒等式，且规范不变关联函数与规范参数无关。结合所选正则化方案，这为计算诱导理论中的可观测量提供了微扰框架。

English: We study Witten's induced gauge theory associated with the D1-D5 Higgs-branch CFT${}_2$, in which the non-dynamical vector multiplet becomes reanimated by integrating out the fundamental hypermultiplets. We propose a BRST quantisation of this theory and derive its induced propagators. We show that the ghost sector first contributes at subleading order, that the induced $A\phi^2$ vertex satisfies the Slavnov-Taylor identity and that gauge-invariant correlators are independent of the gauge parameter. Together with our chosen regularization prescription, this gives a perturbative framework for computing observables in the induced theory.

一句话导读：为 D1-D5 Higgs 支 CFT2 的诱导规范理论建立 BRST 微扰量子化框架。

Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet AdS引力中洛伦兹Taub-NUT时空的热力学

Thermodynamics of Lorentzian Taub-NUT spacetimes in Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet AdS gravity

Borja Diez · hep-th, gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：我们研究任意偶数维Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet AdS引力中洛伦兹Taub-NUT时空的热力学，这些时空构造为Einstein-Kähler底流形上的U(1)纤维丛。我们用表面引力计算温度，并使用离壳Abbott-Deser-Tekin形式将能量作为与稳态Killing矢量相关的守恒荷。在同一框架下，我们得到熵作为视界Noether荷。结果与Iyer-Wald公式一致，并包含对Bekenstein-Hawking面积律的Gauss-Bonnet修正。只要存在Misner弦就予以保留，我们建立具有完全同质性的第一定律，其中NUT参数独立于视界半径变化。这需要额外的NUT相关热力学变量及其共轭势，我们显式确定它们。我们还简要讨论静态极限。

English: We study the thermodynamics of Lorentzian Taub-NUT spacetimes in Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet AdS gravity in arbitrary even dimensions, constructed as $U(1)$ fibrations over Einstein-K\"ahler base manifolds. We compute the temperature from the surface gravity and the energy as the conserved charge associated with the stationary Killing vector using the off-shell Abbott-Deser-Tekin formalism. Within the same framework, we obtain the entropy as a horizon Noether charge. The result agrees with the Iyer-Wald formula and includes a Gauss-Bonnet correction to the Bekenstein-Hawking area law. Retaining the Misner strings whenever present, we formulate a first law of full cohomogeneity in which the NUT parameter varies independently of the horizon radius. This requires an additional NUT-related thermodynamic variable and its conjugate potential, which we determine explicitly. We also briefly discuss the static limit.

一句话导读：在任意偶数维EGB AdS中计算洛伦兹Taub-NUT时空的温度、能量、熵，并建立含Misner弦与独立NUT参数的第一定律。

超对称 SYK 中的偶然性与脆弱性

Fortuity and fragility in supersymmetric SYK

James Chryssanthacopoulos, David Vegh · hep-th, cond-mat.str-el · v2 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：在具有 N 个费米子的 N=2 超对称 SYK 模型中，每个 BPS 态都是偶然的：在固定电荷下，它只在一个有限的 N 范围内存在。让电荷增加，我们证明 BPS 类可以沿着偶然性窗口内的格点行走被提升，可能达到任意大的 N。然而不存在规范的提升。因此我们引入解码器 D，其谱量化精确提升及其度规代价。我们把提升调和代表的失败或代价增加称为度规脆弱性。Chen 的单矩阵模型和双味 SYK 模型的受保护塔分别实现完美提升的裸机制和真正着衣的机制。在一般单味模型中，精确提升最终失败。Lin-Maldacena-Rozenberg-Shan 型算子 D†D 的能级统计与高斯幺正系综一致。其本征值量化 BPS 态跨系统尺度的度规连续性，而其关联探测 BPS 扇区内的混沌。度规脆弱性与 BPS 混沌因此被编码在同一算子的互补可观测量中，从而区分混沌 BPS 扇区与精确可解塔。

English: In the $\mathcal N=2$ supersymmetric SYK model with $N$ fermions, every BPS state is fortuitous: at fixed charge, it exists only over a finite range of $N$. Allowing the charge to increase, we show that BPS classes may instead be uplifted along lattice walks inside the fortuity window, potentially to arbitrarily large $N$. However, there is no canonical uplift. We therefore introduce a decoder $D$ whose spectrum quantifies exact uplift and its metric cost. We call the failure or increasing cost of uplifting harmonic representatives metric fragility. Chen's single-matrix model and the protected tower of the two-flavor SYK model realize bare and genuinely dressed mechanisms of perfect uplift, respectively. In the generic one-flavor model, exact uplift eventually fails. The Lin-Maldacena-Rozenberg-Shan-type operator $D^\dagger D$ exhibits level statistics consistent with the Gaussian unitary ensemble. Its eigenvalues quantify the metric continuity of BPS states across system size, while their correlations probe chaos within the BPS sector. Metric fragility and BPS chaos are thus encoded in complementary observables of the same operator, distinguishing chaotic BPS sectors from exactly solvable towers.

一句话导读：该文研究 N=2 超对称 SYK 中 BPS 态的偶然存在、跨 N 提升的度规脆弱性，以及 BPS 扇区混沌与可解塔的算子谱判据。

English: We introduce combinatorial holographic quantum secret sharing (CHQSS) for a bulk subregion in AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$ to study how logical information of the bulk subregion is encoded in the boundary and protected from erasures of boundary subregions. We introduce a distance, a reconstruction threshold, and a secret threshold to characterize CHQSS schemes. The distance and thresholds depend on the holographic phase and the choice of bulk subregion. We derive the maximum distance. Moreover, we derive the relations between the distance and the thresholds. Philipp Dorau, Albert Much, Leonardo Sangaletti, Rainer Verch · hep-th, gr-qc, math-ph, math.MP · v2 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：我们在 AdS3/CFT2 中建立了一个精化的 Ryu–Takayanagi（RT）关系，以相对熵而非紫外发散的 von Neumann 纠缠熵为核心对象。将 Hollands 关于手征相对熵的精确结果适配到 diamond 区域，我们把真空与相干态之间的边界相对熵表示为 Schwarzian 泛函；Fefferman–Graham 字典将其等同于 Bañados 几何的渐近数据，而三维引力的刚性把这一边界识别提升到体。到度规微扰的线性阶，相对熵等于 RT 测地线长度变分除以 4G_N。该构造仅依赖 Bisognano–Wichmann/Borchers 定理与全息字典，给出 RT 关系的一个紫外有限、算子代数对应。

English: We establish a refined Ryu--Takayanagi (RT) relation in AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$ using \emph{relative entropy} as the central object, in place of the ultraviolet-divergent von Neumann entanglement entropy. Adapting Hollands' exact result for the chiral relative entropy to a diamond region, we express the boundary relative entropy between the vacuum and a coherent state as a Schwarzian functional, which the Fefferman--Graham dictionary identifies with the asymptotic data of a Ba\~nados geometry; the rigidity of three-dimensional gravity promotes this boundary identification to the bulk. To linear order in the metric perturbation, the relative entropy then equals the variation of the RT geodesic length divided by $4G_N$. The construction rests only on the Bisognano--Wichmann/Borchers theorem and the holographic dictionary, giving a UV-finite, operator-algebraic counterpart to the RT relation.

中文摘要：我们基于具有格点边上和乐变量的 BF 型规范结构，构造了二维 Carroll 膨胀子引力的离散实现。体理论保持拓扑性，而物理动力学编码在边界自由度中。施加容许边界条件，我们直接在格点层面导出渐近对称性结构。最宽松条件给出 Carroll 代数的仿射扩展，额外约束将对称性约化为由离散 Virasoro 型代数支配的共形部分。在连续极限下，格点对称性结构重现预期的仿射 Carroll 代数及其共形约化。该构造因此给出离散 Jackiw-Teitelboim (JT) 引力的超相对论对应。

English: We construct a discrete realization of two-dimensional Carroll dilaton gravity based on a BF-type gauge structure with holonomy variables on lattice links. The bulk theory remains topological, while the physical dynamics is encoded in boundary degrees of freedom. Imposing admissible boundary conditions, we derive the asymptotic symmetry structure directly at the lattice level. The least restrictive conditions yield an affine extension of the Carroll algebra, while additional constraints reduce the symmetry to a conformal sector governed by a discrete Virasoro-type algebra. In the continuum limit, the lattice symmetry structure reproduces the expected affine Carroll algebra together with its conformal reduction. The construction therefore provides the ultra-relativistic counterpart of discrete Jackiw-Teitelboim(JT) gravity.

Kerr/CFT Traversable Wormhole with Fermionic Double-Trace Deformation

M. Zhahir Djogama, Fitria Khairunnisa, Hadyan Luthfan Prihadi, Freddy Permana Zen · hep-th, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：本文在Kerr/CFT框架下研究利用费米子场双迹形变构造可穿越虫洞。作者考虑近视界、近极端Kerr几何及其对偶共形场论，指出费米子不存在超辐射，因此可在包括玻色场因超辐射而不稳定的离轴区域在内的各个区域描述虫洞。通过选择左右边界的特定耦合，两点函数被修正，其一阶修正贡献负能量并打开虫洞。扰动在早期开启时虫洞最可穿越，其打开程度依赖模式频率、黑洞温度和费米子质量；晚期平均零能量呈阻尼振荡并最终趋于零。温度较低时可穿越性较弱，极端极限下虫洞完全闭合。eikonal方法可重现相同可穿越性。旋转和参与形变的场数可将信息传输上界提高至熵量级。此外，由虫洞连接的对称有效势垒可产生可观测回声，且回声时间延迟不超过黑洞的 scrambling time。

English: The construction of a traversable wormhole with double-trace deformation has been achieved so far by using boson fields as the perturbation. In this work, we study double-trace deformation with fermion fields in the two-sided Kerr background to open a traversable wormhole. We construct the fermionic double-trace deformation within the Kerr/CFT framework. We consider the near-horizon, near-extremal Kerr geometry, which is dual to a conformal field theory. The lack of fermionic superradiance let us describe the wormhole at every region, even at the off-axis region where bosonic field experiences instability due to superradiance. By choosing a certain coupling between the left and right boundaries, the two-point function is modified, and its first order correction contributes the negative energy to open the wormhole. The wormhole is most traversable when the perturbation is turned on at early times, with opening that depends on the mode's frequency, the black hole temperature, and the fermion mass. At late times, the average null energy has damped oscillation behavior until eventually reaches zero. Wormhole with lower temperature have less traversability and it is completely closed at extreme limit. The same traversability can also be reproduced by using eikonal method. On the other hand, rotation and the number of fields involved in the deformation can increases the upper bound on information transfer up to the order of the entropy. Additionally, symmetrical effective potential bumps connected by the wormhole can produce observable echoes. We find that the echo time delay cannot exceed the scrambling time of the black hole.

一句话导读：在Kerr/CFT框架下用费米子双迹形变构造可穿越虫洞，并分析其可穿越性、信息传输上界与回声信号。

Hwajin Eom, Yunseok Seo · hep-th, cond-mat.str-el · v3 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：我们在自顶向下方法中研究D-瞬子对全息外尔半金属的影响。发现D-瞬子的存在会诱导从外尔半金属到有能隙相的新相变，为强耦合系统中的能隙形成提供新机制。通过分析探针D7膜嵌入的自由能，我们以Weyl参数为单位，构建了关于费米子质量、瞬子密度和温度的相图。我们表明，除了与能带反转相关的常规质量驱动相变外，瞬子密度还导致一种定性不同的相变，其机制不能在标准Dirac图像中理解。我们从黑洞视界处的正则性条件计算非线性电导率，并证明两类相变表现出不同的输运行为；特别地，瞬子诱导的相变导致的有能隙相性质不同于常规绝缘相。我们还讨论了该相在边界理论中的可能解释，并评论其与强相互作用系统中非微扰效应的关系。

English: We investigate the effects of D-instantons on a holographic Weyl semimetal in a top-down approach. We find that the presence of D-instantons induces a novel phase transition from a Weyl semimetal to a gapped phase, providing a new mechanism for gap formation in strongly coupled systems. By analyzing the free energy of probe D7-brane embeddings, we construct the phase diagram in terms of the fermion mass, instanton density, and temperature, measured in units of the Weyl parameter. We show that, in addition to the conventional mass-driven transition associated with band inversion, the instanton density gives rise to a qualitatively different transition whose mechanism cannot be understood within the standard Dirac picture. We compute nonlinear electric conductivities from the regularity condition at the black hole horizon and demonstrate that the two types of transitions exhibit distinct transport behavior. In particular, the instanton-induced transition leads to a gapped phase with properties that differ from the conventional insulating phase. We also discuss possible interpretations of this phase in the boundary theory and comment on its relation to nonperturbative effects in strongly interacting systems.

环境诱导的黑洞热力学拓扑重构

Environment-induced topological reconstruction of black-hole thermodynamics

Xinyu Zhou, Chen Lan, Zhen-Ming Xu · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：热力学拓扑将黑洞平衡态描述为由离壳自由能构造的向量场的零点或缺陷。以往考虑周围物质的研究发现拓扑类不变，但未说明物质的空间分布如何影响单个平衡态。本文追问局域环境的位置能否在总拓扑数固定的情况下重组这些平衡态。作者将环境建模为峰值位于 a_m 的径向局域能量凸起，并把其外部能量加入广义离壳自由能。随着 a_m 变化，缺陷迁移并成对产生或湮灭相反电荷的缺陷，这一过程被称为拓扑重构。它会改变平衡分支的数量和稳定性，但只要没有零点穿过物理区域边界，总拓扑数保持不变。作者在 Schwarzschild、Schwarzschild-AdS、Reissner-Nordström 和 Reissner-Nordström-AdS 黑洞中发现了这一现象，临界位置和所需强度依赖于背景。在所给例子中，所需环境能量从低于黑洞质量的 1% 到与黑洞质量相当。该模型是无可反作用的有效固定背景描述；在此框架内，总拓扑数无法刻画环境响应，必须追踪局域缺陷。

English: Thermodynamic topology describes black-hole (BH) equilibria as zeros, or defects, of a vector field built from the off-shell free energy. Studies with surrounding matter find that the topological class is unchanged, but not how the matter's spatial distribution affects individual equilibria. We ask whether the position of a localized environment can reorganize these equilibria at fixed total topological number. We model the environment as a radially localized energy bump peaked at $a_m$ and add its exterior energy to the generalized off-shell free energy. As $a_m$ varies, defects migrate and are created or annihilated in opposite-charge pairs, a process we call topological reconstruction. It changes the number and stability of equilibrium branches but preserves the total topological number, provided no zero crosses the boundary of the physical domain. We find this in Schwarzschild, Schwarzschild-AdS, Reissner-Nordstr\"om, and Reissner-Nordstr\"om-AdS BHs, with critical positions and required strength that depend on the background. In our examples, the required environmental energy ranges from below $1\%$ of the BH mass to a value comparable to it. The model is an effective fixed-background description without backreaction. Within it, the total topological number cannot capture the environmental response; local defects must be tracked.

一句话导读：在固定背景有效模型中，局域环境能量凸起可改变黑洞热力学平衡缺陷的数量和稳定性，但总拓扑数保持不变。

English: We investigate the critical collapse of gravitational waves that carry angular momenta. Working in five-dimensional vacuum Einstein gravity under an SU$(2)\times\mathbb Z_4$ symmetry ansatz, we numerically evolve several families of initial data near the threshold of black-hole formation. We find that the near-threshold mass scaling has a universal critical exponent, but the angular-momentum scaling has one of two critical exponents, depending on the family of initial data. Dynamical entropy and thermodynamics of causal diamonds

Avik Chakraborty, Pratik K. Das, Manavendra Mahato · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：本文利用零边界上的 Wald-Zoupas 荷与通量研究因果钻石的动力学熵。对选定的边界辛势，boost 荷定义的熵由面积项加膨胀修正组成，并在钻石边缘约化为面积的四分之一。在 Einstein 引力中，作者得到联系零边界任意两个截面熵与带符号通量的精确平衡律，因此熵仅在该通量非负时减小。文中还在不假设背景 Killing 对称性的情况下，分别在有、无外部物质时得到线性化物理过程第一定律，并基于改进的量子零能条件推广到半经典引力；最后考察最大对称时空和 Einstein-标量引力中的因果钻石。

English: We study the dynamical entropy of causal diamonds using Wald-Zoupas charges and fluxes on their null boundaries. For a chosen boundary symplectic potential, the boost charge defines an entropy made of an area term plus an expansion correction, which reduces to one quarter of the area at the edge on the diamond. In Einstein gravity, we find an exact balance law relating the entropy on any two cuts of the null boundary to a signed flux, so the entropy decreases only when this flux is non-negative. We obtain a linearised physical process first law without assuming a background Killing symmetry, both in the presence and absence of external matter; and extend it for semiclassical gravity based on the improved quantum null energy condition. We also examine causal diamonds in maximally symmetric spacetimes and in Einstein-scalar gravity.

一句话导读：用 Wald-Zoupas 荷与通量建立因果钻石动力学熵的平衡律和线性化第一定律，并推广到半经典情形。

三线表述的广义相对论

General Relativity in Three Lines

Pawel Nurowski · math-ph, gr-qc, hep-th, math.MP · v1 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：本文表明，复广义相对论可以直接用赋予每个时空点的三条仿射线来表述。这些线由Plücker双矢表示，而对相关二形式应用Urbantke构造可重建共形时空度规。从手征Plebański作用量出发，简单性约束将三个二形式变为简单双矢的零内基，从而变为三条射影线。随后3+1分解给出一个一阶正则理论，其位形变量是加权三线，共轭变量是线动量。所得约束系统包括三个内禀Gauss约束、三个矢量约束和一个Hamiltonian约束。线表述的一个显著特征是，在对空间部分分部积分后，对线动量变分得到的方程是逐点代数的。因此，在相应Legendre映射可逆之处可显式消去动量，得到一个二阶作用量，其唯一动力学位形变量是加权三线。线曲率自然分解为宇宙学迹和所选手征扇区的Weyl矩阵。Legendre映射在一个特殊的零演化轨迹上变为奇异，而该处时空度规仍非退化；其秩从九降到六，给出三个代数相容性条件。作者构造了一个有限不变的部分Legendre变换以及穿过该轨迹的光滑约束二阶延拓。该分析为演化方向变为零的情形提供了正则框架，并可能有助于近视界几何及相关引力现象的研究。

English: We show that complex general relativity can be formulated directly in terms of three affine lines assigned to each spacetime point. The lines are represented by Pl\"ucker bivectors, and Urbantke's construction applied to the associated two-forms reconstructs the conformal spacetime metric. Starting from the chiral Pleba\'nski action, the simplicity constraints turn the three two-forms into a null internal basis of simple bivectors and thereby into three projective lines. A $3+1$ decomposition then yields a first-order canonical theory whose configuration variable is the weighted triple of lines and whose conjugate variable is a line momentum. The resulting constraint system consists of three internal Gauss constraints, three vector constraints, and one Hamiltonian constraint. A notable feature of the line formulation is that the equation obtained by varying the line momentum is pointwise algebraic after the spatial integrations by parts. Consequently the momentum can be eliminated explicitly wherever the corresponding Legendre map is invertible, giving a second-order action whose only dynamical configuration variable is the weighted triple of lines. The line curvature separates naturally into a cosmological trace and the Weyl matrix of the selected chiral sector. The Legendre map becomes singular on a distinguished null-evolution locus where the spacetime metric remains nondegenerate. There its rank drops from nine to six, giving three algebraic compatibility conditions. We construct a finite invariant partial Legendre transform and a smooth constrained second-order continuation through this locus. This analysis provides a regular framework for regimes in which the evolution direction becomes null and may be useful in the study of near-horizon geometries and related gravitational phenomena.

一句话导读：用三条仿射线/Plücker双矢和Plebański作用量给出复广义相对论的正则表述，并分析Legendre映射在零演化轨迹上的奇异与延拓。

跨越PT对称破缺转变的全息两点函数

Holographic two-point functions across a PT symmetry-breaking transition

Zuo Wang, Liang He · hep-th, quant-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：在宇称-时间（PT）对称的非厄米系统中，本征值和本征矢合并的例外点通常将实谱与复共轭本征值分开。在对数共形场论（LCFT）中，这样的例外点出现在标度维谱中。LCFT的全息模型（如偶极模型）正是建立在该点。这里，我们形变全息偶极模型，使其两个合并的标度维分裂为两个实标度维或一对复共轭标度维。我们以闭合形式得到重整化两点函数；它们从两个幂律的线性组合，经过例外点处LCFT的对数形式，连续变为对数周期振荡。对于在膨胀下具有实混合的任意标量主算子对，共形Ward恒等式将该形式固定到两个归一化常数，而全息字典确定这些常数。在具有此类膨胀算子的PT对称理论中，实与复共轭标度维对应PT未破缺相与PT破缺相。在有限温度BTZ黑洞中，与两个标度维相关的准正频率之差在实到复谱转变前后从纯虚变为纯实。相应地，线性响应从过阻尼变为欠阻尼，并在例外点处临界阻尼。

English: In parity-time (PT)-symmetric non-Hermitian systems, an exceptional point, where eigenvalues and eigenvectors coalesce, typically separates a real spectrum from complex-conjugate eigenvalues. In logarithmic conformal field theories (LCFTs), such an exceptional point appears in the spectrum of scaling dimensions. Holographic models of LCFTs, such as the dipole model, are built exactly at this point. Here, we deform the holographic dipole model so that its two coalescing scaling dimensions split into either two real ones or a complex-conjugate pair. We obtain the renormalized two-point functions in closed form. They change continuously from a linear combination of two power laws, through the logarithmic form of the LCFT at the exceptional point, to log-periodic oscillations. For any pair of scalar primary operators with real mixing under dilatations, the conformal Ward identities fix this form up to two normalization constants, which the holographic dictionary determines. In PT-symmetric theories with such a dilatation operator, real and complex-conjugate scaling dimensions correspond to the PT-unbroken and PT-broken phases. In the BTZ black hole at finite temperature, the difference between the quasinormal frequencies associated with the two scaling dimensions changes from purely imaginary to purely real across the real-to-complex spectral transition. Correspondingly, the linear response changes from overdamped to underdamped, with critical damping at the exceptional point.

一句话导读：通过形变全息偶极模型，给出跨PT/LCFT例外点的闭合形式两点函数，并联系BTZ黑洞QNM与过阻尼-欠阻尼响应。

复化几何中的带引力反常时间向纠缠熵

Timelike entanglement entropy with gravitational anomaly from complexified geometry

Minwoo Lim, Himanshu Parihar, Junggi Yoon · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：本文研究二维共形场论中带引力反常（c_L≠c_R）的时间向纠缠熵（TEE），其对偶为 AdS3 中的拓扑大质量引力。全息上，TEE 由锚定在时间向区间端点的单条复测地线上大质量自旋粒子的 on-shell 作用量决定；该作用量包含复测地线长度和平行移动法标架的 twist。作者在 Poincaré AdS3、非极端与极端旋转 BTZ 背景中计算，并给出等价的 Chern-Simons 推导：体连接保持实，而 Wilson 线探针的鞍点变为复。各情形下全息结果与对偶场论 TEE 匹配。TEE 的实部唯一确定，虚部依赖边界 iε 规定和区间取向；在体中，取向依赖反映标架选择的不确定性。沿复测地线，剩余标架群为 SO(2,C)≃C*，因此端点条件只将标架 twist 确定到 2πi 的整数倍。两种取向之差 (c_L-c_R)/6 iπ 完全由引力反常固定，并在 Rényi pseudo-entropies 中持续存在。

English: We investigate the timelike entanglement entropy (TEE) in a two-dimensional conformal field theory with a gravitational anomaly, $c_L\neq c_R$, dual to topologically massive gravity in AdS$_3$. Holographically, the TEE is determined by the on-shell action of a massive spinning particle on a single complex geodesic anchored at the endpoints of the timelike interval. This action consists of the complex geodesic length and the twist of a parallel-transported normal frame. We carry out the computation in Poincar\'e AdS$_3$, non-extremal and extremal rotating BTZ backgrounds, and provide an equivalent Chern-Simons derivation in which the bulk connection stays real while only the saddle of the Wilson-line probe becomes complex. In each case, the holographic result matches the corresponding TEE in dual field theory. The real part of the TEE is fixed unambiguously whereas its imaginary part depends on the boundary $i\epsilon$ prescription and the orientation of the interval. In the bulk, the dependence on orientation reflects an ambiguity in the choice of framing. Along the complex geodesic, the residual frame group becomes $SO(2,\mathbb C)\simeq\mathbb C^*$, so the endpoint conditions determine the frame twist only up to integer multiples of $2\pi i$. The difference between the two orientations, $\frac{c_L-c_R}{6}\,i\pi$, is fixed entirely by the gravitational anomaly and persists for the R\'enyi pseudo-entropies.

一句话导读：在 AdS3/CFT2 中通过复测地线与 Chern-Simons 表述计算带引力反常的时间向纠缠熵，并指出其虚部取向差由反常固定。

Spinors, Doppelg\"angers and the Non-Perturbative Classical Double Copy

Kymani Armstrong-Williams · hep-th, gr-qc, hep-ph, math-ph, math.MP · v1 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：本文为复化 SU(2) Yang--Mills 理论中 Corrigan--Fairlie--'t Hooft--Wilczek 扇区与四维共形平坦引力之间的非微扰经典双拷贝建立几何与旋量表述。作者将规范势等同于共形平坦度规的正手征自旋联络，并给出 Yang--Mills 场强与 Riemann 张量手征投影之间的精确关系，从而在四维实现“doppelgänger”观点。该扇区中无源 Yang--Mills 方程要求常标量曲率，解释了共享的非线性标量方程，并将引力对应推广到具有常能量动量迹的物质。通过把伴随色指标表示为旋量指标的对称对，作者导出规范场强旋量到标量曲率与无迹 Ricci 分量的精确映射；即使 Weyl 张量为零，这些关系仍保留非平凡曲率信息。文中用 AdS、dS 以及由标量场支撑的 AdS3×R 时空说明该构造。

English: We develop a geometric and spinorial formulation of the non-perturbative classical double copy between the Corrigan--Fairlie--'t Hooft--Wilczek sector of complexified SU(2) Yang--Mills theory and four-dimensional conformally flat gravity. We identify the gauge potential with the positive-chiral spin connection of the conformally flat metric, establishing an exact relation between the Yang--Mills field strength and the chiral projection of the Riemann tensor. This provides a four-dimensional realisation of the doppelg\"anger viewpoint, in which gauge and gravitational fields arise from different interpretations of common connection data. Within this sector, the sourceless Yang--Mills equations require constant scalar curvature, explaining the shared nonlinear scalar equation and extending the gravitational correspondence from traceless matter to matter with constant energy--momentum trace. By representing adjoint colour indices as symmetric pairs of spinor indices, we derive exact relations mapping the gauge field-strength spinors to the scalar-curvature and trace-free Ricci components of the gravitational curvature. These relations retain nontrivial curvature information despite the vanishing Weyl tensor. We illustrate the construction using anti-de Sitter and de Sitter spacetimes, together with $\mathrm{AdS}_{3}\times\mathbb{R}$ supported by a scalar field, demonstrating the extension to matter with nonzero constant trace

一句话导读：构建复化 SU(2) Yang--Mills 与共形平坦引力之间非微扰经典双拷贝的旋量几何表述。

全息条纹超导体的光学电导率

Optical conductivity of holographic striped superconductors

Fang-jing Cheng, Kai Li, Yi Ling, Meng-He Wu · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：基于一个在离子晶格上表现出类 Mott 绝缘行为的全息模型，我们构建了全息条纹超导体（SSC），其特征是电荷密度波（CDW）与超导（SC）之间的相互作用。我们给出了 e-T 平面上的相图，其中 SSC 相出现在 e 的中间窗口内，揭示出 CDW 序与 SC 序之间既有合作也有竞争的关系。对于较小的电荷 e，系统在降温时经历从金属相到 CDW 相、再到 SSC 相的相变；而对于较大的 e，系统则直接从金属相进入 SC 相，然后进入 SSC 相。我们计算了这两种情形下系统的光学电导率，并展示了其不同行为。结果表明，沿两条路径，电导率虚部在临界温度 T_SSC 以下均表现出发散行为，从而首次在全息框架内验证了 SSC 相的超导性。沿 CDW 到 SSC 的路径，赝能隙和钉扎效应继承自 CDW 相；而沿 SC 到 SSC 的路径，自发条纹强烈抑制了相干的正常流体通道，同时增强了超流极点。此外，我们还在 p-T 相图中展示了条纹超导体的公度锁定行为。

English: Based on a holographic model exhibiting Mott-like insulating behavior on an ionic lattice, we construct a holographic striped superconductor (SSC), which is characterized by the interplay between the charge density wave (CDW) and superconductivity (SC). We present the phase diagram on the $e$-$T$ plane, where the SSC phase emerges within an intermediate window of $e$, revealing both cooperative and competitive relations between the CDW order and SC order. For small charge $e$, the system undergoes the phase transition from metallic phase to CDW phase, and then to SSC phase upon cooling; while for large $e$, it transitions from metallic phase to SC phase directly, and then to SSC phase. We compute the optical conductivity of the system for these two cases and demonstrate its distinct behavior. It turns out that the imaginary part of the conductivity exhibits a divergent behavior below the critical temperature $T_{\mathrm{SSC}}$ along both pathways, so that the superconductivity of SSC phase is justified for the first time in the holographic framework. Along the CDW-to-SSC pathway the pseudogap and the pinning effect are inherited from the CDW phase, whereas along the SC-to-SSC pathway the spontaneous stripe strongly suppresses the coherent normal-fluid channel while the superfluid pole is enhanced. In addition, we demonstrate the commensurate lock-in behavior of the striped superconductor in the $p$-$T$ diagram.

一句话导读：构建全息条纹超导体并计算光学电导率，展示CDW与超导的协同/竞争及SSC超导性的首次全息验证。

中文摘要：我们证明，在变形 AdS/QCD 模型中，从狄拉克方程分裂出的手征模式满足类薛定谔方程且是同谱的，因为手征有效势是 SUSY 伙伴。特别地，我们展示如何对这些势进行截断并保持手征模式的同谱性。按照这一方案，我们将变形 AdS 模型的二次近似与费米子的 dressed soft wall 模型进行比较，并说明两个模型的谱如何能够重合。

English: We show that the chiral modes splitted from the Dirac equation satisfying Schrodinger-like equations in the context of deformed AdS/QCD model are isospectral, since the chiral effective potentials are SUSY partners. In particular, we show how to perform truncations of these potentials that preserve isospectrality of the chiral modes. Following this prescription, we compare a quadratic approximation of the deformed AdS model with the dressed soft wall model for fermions and show how the spectra of both models can coincide.

增强的高维强能量条件不产生宇宙视界

No cosmic horizons from a strengthened higher-dimensional strong energy condition

Flavio Tonioni · hep-th, astro-ph.CO, gr-qc, math-ph, math.MP · v1 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：含时超引力紧致化超出了 Gibbons/Maldacena-Núñez 无 de Sitter 定理的适用范围，甚至可支持永恒宇宙加速，因此问题在于它们是否也能产生未来宇宙视界。对于一般高维物质，仅强能量条件不能排除这类视界。本文证明，满足强能量条件增强版本的理论不能被紧致化到能够支持未来宇宙视界的低维理论。对于约化到至少四个大时空维度的 10 维和 11 维超引力，该能量条件由在高维理论中已满足强能量条件的源所满足。本文对维度约化的假设是：约化在光滑、紧致且无边界空间上进行。

English: Time-dependent supergravity compactifications lie beyond the setting of the Gibbons/Maldacena-Nu\~nez no-de Sitter theorem and can even support eternal cosmic acceleration, raising the question of whether they can also produce future cosmic horizons. For general higher-dimensional matter, the strong energy condition alone does not exclude such horizons. Here, we demonstrate that a theory fulfilling a strengthened version of the strong energy condition cannot be compactified down to a lower-dimensional theory able to support a future cosmic horizon. For 10d and 11d supergravities reduced to at least four large spacetime dimensions, this energy condition is fulfilled by the sources that already fulfill the strong energy condition in the higher-dimensional theory. Our assumption on the dimensional reduction is that it is performed on a smooth compact and boundaryless space.

一句话导读：证明满足增强强能量条件的高维理论经光滑紧致无边界紧致化后，不能得到支持未来宇宙视界的低维理论，并应用于10维和11维超引力。

AdS_5×S^5 背景中的超弦理论：half-BPS 顶点算符

Superstring theory in $AdS_5\times S^5$ background: half-BPS vertex operators

Thiago Fleury, Lucas N. S. Martins, Dennis Zavaleta · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：本文通过全局 PSU(2,2|4) 变换构造 AdS_5×S^5 背景中与引力超多重态相关的所有顶点算符，用于世界面散射振幅计算。此前在纯旋量形式中曾用特殊超空间参数化构造其中一个算符，但由于玻色与费米坐标混合，实现完整整体对称性颇具挑战。我们引入一系列精心选择的重参数化将这些坐标解耦，从而解决该问题；随后在纯旋量形式和 B-RNS-GSS 形式中构造相应的积分顶点算符，推进该背景下超弦理论的形式化。

English: In this paper, we construct all vertex operators associated with the gravity supermultiplet in the $AdS_5 \times S^5$ background, relevant for worldsheet scattering amplitude computations, via global $PSU(2,2|4)$ transformations. Although one such operator was previously constructed in the pure spinor formalism using a special superspace parametrization, implementing the full global symmetries proved challenging due to the mixing of bosonic and fermionic coordinates. We resolve this issue by introducing a judicious sequence of reparametrizations that disentangle these coordinates. English: In AdS/CFT correlators, bulk cone singularities arise when two points that are timelike separated on the AdS boundary may be connected by a null geodesic through the bulk. A peculiar property of this geodesic is that it is not prompt, meaning that there exist points on it that are timelike separated. This implies that it may gravitationally affect itself. We show that this leads to an energy-dependent delay in the time elapsed along this geodesic. This coupled with possible inelastic effects due to gravitational radiation are the leading mechanisms that resolve the singularity. The resolved singularity is accompanied by oscillations and hence zeroes in the real and imaginary parts of the correlator. We comment on the role that additional inelastic effects play in damping these oscillations. Finally, we provide a concrete example in $2+1$D where we can compute the energy-dependent time delay effect explicitly by studying the boundary graviton mode.

中文摘要：我们研究长寿命准正规模的并合是否会增强旋转 BTZ 黑洞的边界响应。利用混合 Robin 边界条件下的精确标量解和推迟边界关联函数，我们在固定源与算符归一化下比较频域共振和时域信号。在适当选取的固定理论中，仅改变自旋即可穿过一个例外点（EP）。沿一条不同的近极端路径，通过调节标量质量和边界耦合来追踪共转 EP 面时，一个更高更窄的共振与一个较弱但持续时间更长的双极点脉冲响应共存。频域增强在远离 EP 处仍然存在，因此并非模式并合所独有。因此，EP 决定了双极点结构和 Jordan 弛豫，但本身并不决定响应强度；响应强度还依赖于物理路径和激发协议。

Along a distinct near-extremal path that tracks the co-rotating EP surface by tuning the scalar mass and boundary coupling, a taller, narrower resonance coexists with a weaker but longer-lasting double-pole impulse response. The frequency-domain enhancement persists away from the EP and is therefore not unique to mode coalescence. Embedding this test-mass information into an effective-one-body model, we construct inspiral-merger-ringdown waveforms for comparable-mass binaries and find coupling-dependent dephasing and waveform-peak shifts. English: We present a systematic method for constructing static, spherically symmetric regular spacetimes of Kerr-Schild type in general relativity that satisfy the weak energy condition. Our approach relies on physically reasonable assumptions on the matter energy density, together with the boundedness of the Kretschmann scalar. The latter property ensures the finiteness of all curvature invariants and, for the configurations considered, is equivalent to the completeness of causal geodesics. By classifying admissible density profiles according to their complexity, we recover well-known regular black hole solutions such as the Bardeen, Hayward, and Dymnikova models, which are thus naturally embedded in a unified and broader framework. Within this setting, we also derive closed-form expressions for several new families of regular geometries involving hypergeometric or incomplete Gamma functions, which in many cases reduce to elementary functions including algebraic, logarithmic, arctangent, and exponential forms. The emergence of horizons and photon spheres, as well as their observational implications, is also investigated. Finally, we extend the analysis to rotating metrics generated through the Newman-Janis algorithm.

Presently the quasi-normal modes of stellar-mass BH ringdowns have been successfully extracted in the ground-based gravitational wave (GW) observations. Looking ahead, the future space-borne observatories will listen to the ringdowns from massive BH binary coalescences more loudly and resolve multiple modes to unprecedented precision, which calls for efficient approaches to mitigate the sharply increasing computational burden. We develop a practical ringdown analysis pipeline for space-borne detectors by implementing FIREFLY, a novel acceleration algorithm validated in ground-based detectors, and for the first time demonstrate its compatibility and effectiveness with the time-delay interferometry (TDI) observables. With high fidelity, we achieve an over two-order-of-magnitude speedup for a simulated ringdown signal including six modes, providing a viable and scalable route for multi-mode ringdown analysis in the space context. This new approach has sound statistical interpretation and is extensible to other GW sources in band.

中文摘要：最近在Schwarzschild时空的类时测地线方程中发现了三个隐藏守恒量，它们类似于牛顿引力中与Laplace-Runge-Lenz（LRL）矢量相关的动力学量：LRL角、LRL Killing矢量时间和LRL固有时，均为所有类时测地线的（分段）守恒量。本文通过对测地线拉格朗日量反向应用Noether定理，为这三个量提供自然的对称性解释，得到三个新的隐藏LRL对称变换。与Killing对称不同——后者是测地线构型变量上的点变换，且无需使用测地线方程即可闭合——这些新对称是动力学变换，本质上涉及测地线动量变量，并且仅在测地线方程的解上闭合。文章表明LRL对称的对易子结构取决于测地线是否有界以及是否穿越视界，其物理意义与它们对测地线能量和角动量的作用相关。它们与Killing对称及测地线拉格朗日量的重参数化对称一起，生成类时测地线方程的完整Noether对称群。

English: For the timelike geodesic equations in Schwarzschild spacetime, three hidden conserved quantities were found recently, which are analogues of dynamical quantities related to the well-known Laplace--Runge--Lenz (LRL) vector in Newtonian gravity. In particular, the geodesic equations possess an LRL angle, an LRL Killing-vector time and an LRL proper time, each of which is a (piecewise) conserved quantity for all timelike geodesics. The present work provides a natural symmetry interpretation for these three quantities by applying Noether's theorem in reverse to the geodesic Lagrangian. This yields three new (hidden) LRL symmetry transformations. Unlike the Killing symmetries, which constitute point transformations on the geodesic configuration variables and close without the use of the geodesic equations, the new symmetries are dynamical transformations which essentially involve the geodesic momenta variables and close only on solutions of the geodesic equations. The commutator structure of the LRL symmetries is shown to depend on whether a geodesic is bounded or not, and horizon-crossing or not, while their physical meaning is connected to their action on the geodesic energy and angular momentum. Together with the Killing symmetries and re-parameterization symmetries of the geodesics Lagrangian, they generate the complete Noether symmetry group of the timelike geodesic equations.

Irengbam Roshila Devi, Ningthoujam Media, Yenshembam Priyobarta Singh, Telem Ibungochouba Singh · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：本文研究静态球对称带整体单极子黑洞的强场偏折角、透镜观测量与黑洞阴影，发现单极子参数η和λ增大使偏折角与阴影半径增大；分析类时测地线、圆轨道与ISCO，指出ISCO半径随η单调增大，并用Lyapunov指数讨论稳定性；计算电磁扰动下的QNM，发现η增大使振荡衰减更慢，并通过时域演化验证准正规模振铃与晚期幂律尾；最后用EHT对M87*和Sgr A*的观测限制η与λ组合并讨论强透镜观测量前景。

English: In this paper, we investigate various key aspects of a static and spherically symmetric black hole with a global monopole. Firstly, we analyze the deflection angle in the strong field limit of a spacetime with a global monopole. It shows that the angle of deflection increases when the two characteristic parameters for the monopole configuration, $\eta$ and $\lambda$, increase. The influence of the global monopole parameter on the lensing observables and the black hole shadow is studied. This shows that a larger monopole parameter corresponds to larger shadow radii. The dynamics of timelike geodesics is also investigated in the spacetime. General circular orbits and the innermost stable circular orbits (ISCO) of timelike particles are discussed, highlighting that the monopole parameter significantly affects the circular orbits and the ISCO. In particular, it is observed that the radius of ISCO rises monotonically with $\eta$. In addition, the Lyapunov exponent is used to analyze the stability of timelike geodesics. We also determine the quasinormal modes under electromagnetic perturbations for different values of $\eta$. Our findings indicate that increasing the monopole parameter gives rise to electromagnetic perturbations with more slowly damped oscillations. To further validate the derived quasinormal mode spectrum, we discuss the time-domain evolution of the perturbation, confirming the presence of the characteristic quasinormal ringing followed by late-time power-law tails. Finally, comparison with the EHT observations of M87* and Sgr A* determines the parameter combinations of $\eta$ and $\lambda$ compatible with current observations, and the observational prospects of the strong-lensing observables are discussed.

中文摘要：脉冲星自转突变（glitch）中自转频率的突然变化可能由内部机制驱动，并在多个时间尺度上发射引力波。随着探测器灵敏度提高，探测“类连续波”和“类爆发”两种发射的潜力也随之增强。本文旨在考察未来探测器进行这种联合测量的能力。通过分析ATNF星表中的历史glitch事件，我们量化了当前和下一代引力波探测器网络的双探测前景，并以2024年Vela脉冲星glitch的外推作为示例，探讨在双非探测情况下可给出的天体物理限制。我们发现，包含至少一个下一代探测器的网络会显著提高许多已知glitch脉冲星的双探测概率，并将glitch能量探测阈值相对现有LIGO探测器改善近两个数量级。此外，包含至少一个下一代探测器的网络在双非探测时，可对脉冲星性质给出显著改进的限制。

English: The internal mechanisms that drive the sudden change in rotation frequency in pulsar glitches could emit gravitational waves (GWs) at multiple time scales. The potential for GW analyses to detect both long and short forms of emission ("tCW-like" and "burst-like") improves as the detectors increase in sensitivity. We aim to examine how future detectors fare in making this joint measurement. By examining past glitches from the ATNF catalog, we quantify the double-detectability prospects of current- and next-generation GW detector networks. We further explore what astrophysical constraints could be placed following a double non-detection using extrapolations from the 2024 Vela pulsar glitch as a stand-in example. We find that a network with at least one next-generation detector greatly increases the probability of double-detection for many known glitching pulsars and improves the detection threshold in glitch energy by nearly two orders of magnitude over existing LIGO detectors. Additionally, double non-detections with networks with at least one next-generation detector could place dramatically improved limits on properties of the pulsar.

Horndeski理论中暗物质晕的解析与数值研究

Analytic and numerical study of dark matter halos in the Horndeski theory

Kohei Onoda, Shun Arai, Daisuke Yamauchi, Shuichiro Yokoyama, Shogo Masaki, Kenji Hasegawa · astro-ph.CO, astro-ph.GA, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：能够解释宇宙晚期加速膨胀的修改引力模型必须通过局部引力实验，并引入屏蔽机制以在恒星尺度压制额外的第五力。暗物质晕由于尺度延展，可能在小尺度上出现屏蔽转变，从而成为检验修改引力和晚期加速起源的探针。本文对Horndeski理论中具有Vainshtein屏蔽的暗物质晕进行综合研究。在冷暗物质和球对称暗晕假设下，我们解析澄清了Vainshtein屏蔽有效发挥作用的暗晕轮廓条件。我们发现，当暗晕中心附近的轮廓趋近于核状结构时，即使在Vainshtein半径内，Vainshtein屏蔽也较不有效；这促使我们推测，由第五力导致的一些特征可能在暗晕动力学演化中存活。我们通过对孤立暗晕的N体模拟数值检验该推测，假设牛顿两体相互作用并加上球对称外部第五力。我们使用流体静力学、Jeans方程和引力透镜三种质量代理；在作为广义相对论弱场近似的牛顿引力情形下，它们必须完全相同。我们发现，在（准）平衡时这些代理彼此之间可以存在偏置，定量表明基准引力模型不是牛顿引力。我们的结果肯定地表明，来自观测的多个质量代理能够在暗晕尺度上检验引力。

English: The models of modified gravity that can explain the late-time accelerated expansion of the Universe must pass the local tests of gravity, introducing a screening mechanism so that any additional fifth force in gravity is suppressed at stellar scales. Dark matter halos, in contrast, by their extendedness in scale, may exhibit a transition of screening to small scales, providing a probe of modified gravity and the origin of the late-time acceleration. We perform comprehensive studies of dark matter halos with Vainshtein screening in the Horndeski theory. Given that dark matter is cold and a dark matter halo is spherically symmetric, we analytically clarify the conditions for the halo profile under which the Vainshtein screening works effectively. We find that the Vainshtein screening is less effective even within the Vainshtein radius as the profile approaches a core-like structure around the center of a halo, which motivates us to postulate that some features owing to the fifth force can survive during the dynamical evolution of a halo. We numerically examine our postulate by a $N$-body simulation for an isolated halo with the assumption of Newtonian two-body interactions with the spherical external fifth force. We make use of three proxies of the mass through hydrostatic dynamics, the Jeans equation, and gravitational lensing, all of which must be identical in the case of Newtonian gravity as a weak-field approximation to General Relativity. We find that these proxies can be biased relative to each other at a (quasi) equilibrium, quantitatively indicating that the fiducial model of gravity is not Newtonian. Our result affirmatively suggests that multiple mass proxies from observations are capable of testing gravity on halo scales.

一句话导读：解析与N体模拟表明，Horndeski理论中Vainshtein屏蔽在核状暗晕中心可能失效，且不同质量代理可产生可观测偏置。

模拟尘埃坍缩：规范选择对原初黑洞形成的影响

Robyn L. Munoz, Christian T. Byrnes, Marco Bruni, Ian Hawke · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO · v1 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：我们研究物质主导时期尘埃坍缩的数值相对论模拟为何常在原初黑洞形成前因数值限制和不恰当规范选择而失败。利用三维全非线性尘埃流体模拟，我们详述先进数值方法的优势以及 lapse 和 shift 演化方程的影响。挑战有两方面：1）传统 lapse 切片演化方程在典型黑洞模拟中非常有效，但在宇宙学语境中必须调整；我们展示不同提议的 lapse 演化方程的表现，从而进行公平比较，并提出我们自己的方案。2）shift 演化方程的作用是分散数值网格观测者以稳定模拟，但 Gamma-driver 演化在尘埃流体壳层聚焦时失败。我们表明 shift damping 选择依赖于壳层聚焦区域的分辨率，提示未来工作应采用空间变化的 damping。改进的规范选择使模拟能显著推进更远，并有可能达到黑洞形成；表现最好的模拟接近黑洞，但还需进一步研究规范选择才能稳定。

English: We investigate why numerical relativity simulations of dust collapse in a matter-dominated era frequently fail before primordial black hole formation due to numerical limitations and inappropriate gauge choices. Using 3-dimensional fully non-linear simulations of a dust fluid, we detail the advantages of advanced numerical methods and the impact of the lapse and shift evolution equations. The challenge is twofold: 1) conventional lapse slicing evolution equations, highly effective in typical black hole simulations, must be adapted in a cosmological context. We demonstrate how different proposed lapse evolution equations perform, enabling fair comparison, and propose our own. 2) The shift evolution equation's role is to spread out the numerical grid observers for a stable simulation. However, the Gamma-driver evolution fails when confronted with shell-focussing of the dust fluid. We show how the shift damping choice depends on the resolution of the shell-focusing region, suggesting that future work should have spatially varying damping. Our improved gauge choices allow simulations to evolve significantly further and potentially reach black hole formation. The best-performing simulations reach close proximity to a black hole; however, further work on the gauge choice is required for this to be stable.

Uniqueness of Static Black Holes in Lovelock Gravity

Chanchal Sharma, Sudipta Sarkar · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：黑洞唯一性是广义相对论的基本预言之一：球对称 Schwarzschild–Tangherlini 时空是 Einstein 方程唯一规则、渐近平直、静态真空黑洞解。本文证明 Lovelock 引力中微扰意义下有类似结果。在适当的正质量刚性假设下，任何位于允许关于广义相对论做规则 Taylor 展开的 generic 分支上的规则、渐近平直、静态真空 Lovelock 黑洞解，在固定 ADM 质量下，由相应的球对称 Lovelock 黑洞解唯一确定。特别地，Einstein–Gauss–Bonnet 引力不存在与 Schwarzschild–Tangherlini 微扰连接的非球对称静态分支，唯一解为 Boulware–Deser。同样的递归机制可推广到完整 Lovelock 类。结果表明静态黑洞唯一性可超越广义相对论，并非 Einstein 方程特有。

English: Black hole uniqueness is one of the fundamental predictions of general relativity: the spherically symmetric Schwarzschild--Tangherlini spacetime is the unique regular, asymptotically flat, static vacuum black hole solution of Einstein's equations. We show that an analogous result holds perturbatively in Lovelock gravity. Assuming the appropriate positive-mass rigidity statement, any regular, asymptotically flat, static vacuum black hole solution of Lovelock gravity on a generic branch admitting a regular Taylor expansion about general relativity is uniquely determined, at fixed ADM mass, by the corresponding spherically symmetric Lovelock black hole solution. In particular, Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet gravity admits no distinct nonspherical static branch perturbatively connected to Schwarzschild--Tangherlini, and the unique solution is Boulware--Deser. The same recursive mechanism extends to the full Lovelock class. Our result shows that static black hole uniqueness can extend beyond general relativity and is not a property peculiar to the Einstein equations.

Dongjun Li, Hao-Jui Kuan, Colin Weller, Chaoyi Yang, Kelvin Ka-Ho Lam, Patrick Bourg, Adrian Ka-Wai Chung, Yanbei Chen, Nicol\'as Yunes, Huan Yang · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v1 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：极端质量比旋近是探测大质量黑洞及其环境的强有力工具，但解读其信号需要准确的轨道动力学与辐射模型。本文汇集黑洞微扰论进展，建立统一相对论框架，用于微扰天体物理环境中的绝热旋近。该框架基于修改的Teukolsky形式，不需要后牛顿近似或慢转近似。作为首个应用，我们计算了围绕被同步超轻标量云包围的旋转黑洞、沿圆轨道赤道面旋近时的领头云致引力波通量修正与保守轨道动力学修正，并将这些修正与先前计算的标量响应结合。在基准系统中，包含黑洞质量10^{-4}的云在两年内产生约-57.3弧度的轨道退相位。引力波通量修正与背景致轨道移动的相位贡献在幅度上各自超过标量贡献，并部分抵消，凸显了耦合物质-引力建模的必要性。该框架可推广到其他环境和修改引力理论，为评估探测损失与参数偏差、以及利用未来空间引力波观测探测黑洞环境本质提供所需的相对论输入。

English: Extreme mass-ratio inspirals offer a powerful probe of massive black holes and their environments, but interpreting their signals requires accurate models of orbital dynamics and radiation. Here we bring together advances in black-hole perturbation theory to establish a unified relativistic framework for adiabatic inspirals in perturbative astrophysical environments. Built on the modified Teukolsky formalism, the framework requires neither post-Newtonian nor slow-rotation approximations. As a first application, we calculate the leading cloud-induced corrections to gravitational-wave fluxes and conservative orbital dynamics for circular, equatorial inspirals around a rotating black hole surrounded by a synchronized ultralight scalar cloud, combining these corrections with the previously calculated scalar response. In our fiducial system, a cloud containing $10^{-4}$ of the black-hole mass produces about $-57.3$ radians of orbital dephasing over two years. The phase contributions from gravitational-wave flux corrections and background-induced orbital shifts each exceed the scalar contribution in magnitude and partially cancel, highlighting the need for coupled matter-gravity modeling. Extensible to other environments and modified gravity theories, our framework provides the relativistic inputs needed to assess detection losses and parameter biases, and to probe the nature of black-hole environments with future space-based gravitational-wave observations.

Geodesics in Black-Hole Spacetimes: A Qualitative Classification Using Vieta's Formulae

Oliver F. Piattella · gr-qc, math-ph, math.MP · v1 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：本专著在不求解转折点的情况下，对 Schwarzschild、Kerr 和 Schwarzschild-de Sitter 黑洞的测地线进行分类。三种时空中径向与极角运动由多项式控制，其系数只依赖运动常数，测地线的定性行为由根的模式决定。作者利用韦达公式、判别式、笛卡尔符号法则以及多项式在视界和无穷远处的取值，直接从系数读出根的模式。文中给出 Schwarzschild 时空中非径向测地线径向根倒数之和为 1/(2M)、束缚轨道第三根的闭式以及分界线 p=6+2e；在 Kerr 时空中讨论径向束缚轨道的条件、涡旋测地线无径向转折点、球轨道稳定性、赤道 ISCO、光环和光子壳；在 Schwarzschild-de Sitter 时空中讨论五次径向多项式、束缚分支条件以及边际稳定圆轨道位于 6M 之外。作者指出多数结果已知，目的是展示一条初等代数路径可统一得到这些结果，面向修过广义相对论入门课程的研究生，每章附有例题。

English: This monograph classifies the geodesics of the Schwarzschild, Kerr and Schwarzschild-de Sitter black holes without solving for their turning points. In all three spacetimes, the radial and polar motions are governed by polynomials whose coefficients depend only on the constants of motion, and the qualitative behavior of a geodesic is fixed by the pattern of their roots. We read this pattern directly off the coefficients, using Vieta's formulae together with the discriminant, Descartes' rule of signs, and the values of the polynomials at the horizons and at infinity. In Schwarzschild spacetime, the reciprocals of the radial roots of every non-radial geodesic add up to $1/(2M)$, which gives the third root of a bound orbit in closed form and the separatrix $p=6+2e$. In Kerr spacetime, the signs of the coefficients show that no radially bound orbit has $\varepsilon^2\geq1$ and that vortical geodesics, timelike or null, have no radial turning point; a positive discriminant is necessary but not sufficient for bound motion, and Descartes' rule applied at the event horizon gives the exact criterion. Spherical orbits and their stability, the equatorial ISCO and light rings, and the photon shell follow from the same relations. In Schwarzschild-de Sitter spacetime, the timelike radial polynomial is a quintic with exactly one negative root, a bound branch requires $\varepsilon^2+\Lambda L^2/3<1$, and both marginally stable circular orbits lie beyond $6M$. Most of these results are known; the aim is to show that a single, elementary algebraic route leads to all of them. The text is meant for graduate students who have taken a first course in general relativity, and each chapter ends with worked examples.

一句话导读：用韦达公式、判别式和符号法则对 Schwarzschild、Kerr 与 Schwarzschild-de Sitter 黑洞测地线作统一的定性代数分类。

引力波作为多流体宇宙学的探针：一般形式与宇宙学停滞情形

Gravitational Waves as a Probe of Multi-Fluid Cosmologies: General Formalism and the Case of Cosmological Stasis

Keith R. Dienes, Fazlollah Hajkarim, Lucien Heurtier, Fei Huang, Kuver Sinha, Brooks Thomas, Tao Xu · astro-ph.CO, hep-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：标量诱导引力波可用于探测大爆炸之前宇宙的膨胀历史，其产生依赖早期宇宙一阶标量扰动的演化，传播则依赖背景状态方程。本文将相关讨论推广到包含多种流体的宇宙学，指出多流体宇宙学中的引力波信号会受到两类修正：一是存在单流体情形没有的新速度效应，二是进入视界早于多流体时代结束的模式在后续红移中发生显著改变。因此，标量诱导引力波不仅能探测整体膨胀速率，也能探测多流体组成。作为示例，文章考虑宇宙学停滞时期产生的引力波；该时期不同状态方程能量组分的丰度保持恒定，从而给出恒定的有效状态方程，但宇宙仍是多流体。作者发现，尽管状态方程恒定，这类停滞宇宙学仍产生张量功率谱和今日引力波丰度，且与标准辐射主导宇宙的预期显著不同。

English: Scalar-induced gravitational waves (SIGWs) provide a powerful probe of the expansion history of the universe prior to the Big Bang. Indeed, the production of such gravity waves depends on the evolution of first-order scalar perturbations within the early universe, while their subsequent propagation depends on the background equation of state. In this paper we extend previous discussions by studying SIGWs in cosmologies containing multiple fluids. As we shall demonstrate, the gravitational-wave signal within such multi-fluid cosmologies is modified in two distinct ways: not only are there new velocity effects which have no single-fluid analogues, but there are also significant alterations to the subsequent redshifting of modes that enter the horizon before the multi-fluid era ends. Thus SIGWs provide a probe of not only the overall expansion rate within such cosmologies, but also their internal multi-fluid composition. As an example, we then consider the case of gravitational waves arising during an epoch of cosmological stasis. During such an epoch, the abundances of energy components with different equations of state remain constant, thereby giving rise to a universe with a constant effective equation of state which nevertheless remains genuinely multi-fluid despite cosmological expansion. Despite their constant equations of state, we find that such stasis cosmologies also give rise to tensor power spectra and present-day gravitational-wave abundances which are significantly different from those expected within a standard radiation-dominated universe.

一句话导读：研究多流体宇宙学中标量诱导引力波的产生与红移，并以宇宙学停滞期为例表明其张量谱和今日丰度显著偏离辐射主导情形。

LazyTB：含多种相互作用流体的扩展 LTB 解

LazyTB: Extended LTB-solutions with Multiple Interacting Fluids

Kimmo Kainulainen, Enrico D. Schiappacasse, Linda Tenhu, Olli V\"ais\"anen · astro-ph.CO, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-16

中文摘要：我们提出了一个低使用门槛的数值代码 LazyTB，它在 ADM 表述下求解 Einstein 方程，用于处理具有任意数量流体的广义球对称问题；这些流体具有用户定义的状态方程，并可选地通过 drag-vector 介导相互作用。我们以精心选择的无量纲变量给出 ADM 方程，通过解析消去潜在发散项来避免一些数值不稳定性。我们通过若干示例展示该代码，包括标准 LTB 模型、包含辐射和暗物质的模型、具有非零声速的多方暗能量模型，以及耦合相互作用的暗物质和暗能量模型。我们还实现了一套诊断工具，包括光线追踪算法，使得能够从模拟中提取物理可观测量，例如任意位置观测者对应的光度距离。该代码被设计为易于扩展，也可用于本文示例之外的晚宇宙应用。LazyTB 可在 https://github.com/ollijvaisanen/LazyTB 获取。

English: We present a low entry barrier numerical code LazyTB that solves the Einstein equations in the ADM-formulation for a general spherically symmetric problem with an arbitrary number of fluids with user defined equations of state and optional interactions between the fluids mediated by drag-vectors. We present the ADM equations in terms of carefully chosen dimensionless variables that avoid some numerical instabilities by analytic cancellation of potentially diverging terms. We demonstrate the code by applying it to a number of examples including the standard LTB model, a model with radiation and dark matter, a polytropic dark energy model with a non-vanishing sound speed and a model with coupled interacting dark matter and dark energy. We also implement a suite of diagnostic tools, including ray-tracing algorithms, that allow extracting physical observables such as luminosity distances for observers at arbitrary locations from the simulations. The code is built to be easy to extend also beyond the late-universe applications considered in the examples of this paper. LazyTB is available at https://github.com/ollijvaisanen/LazyTB.

一句话导读：LazyTB 是一个求解 ADM 形式 Einstein 方程的数值代码，用于具有多种相互作用流体的球对称 LTB/宇宙学模型。

大质量双星中通过稳定质量转移形成并合黑洞

The formation of merging black holes via stable mass transfer in massive binary stars

Xiao-Tian Xu, Norbert Langer, Jakub Klencki, Chen Wang, Xiang-Dong Li · astro-ph.SR, astro-ph.HE, gr-qc · v4 · 更新 2026-10-16

中文摘要：宇宙中绝大多数大质量双星系统显然不适合产生并合双黑洞。然而，最近已经识别出若干条通向此目标的孤立大质量双星窄演化路径。由于先前对这些路径的建模高度简化并采用假设，结论迄今仍不明确。对于其中一条路径——稳定质量转移通道——我们现在构建了详细的双星演化模型，包括内部较差自转以及恒星之间的质量和角动量转移，从零龄主序一直到黑洞形成，仅跳过快速晚期燃烧阶段。这使我们能够追踪吸积质量组分的质量和化学结构演化；结果表明，该组分对反向质量转移阶段有关键影响，使得所得到的黑洞自旋和质量比自然落入在 10--25M⊙ 主黑洞质量范围内观测到的引力波源区域。对于这一通道，也已知大量祖先双星，因此我们得出结论：它可能对观测到的引力波源族群有贡献。

English: The vast majority of massive binary systems in the universe is evidently unsuited to produce merging binary black holes. However, several narrow evolutionary paths of isolated massive binaries towards this goal have recently been identified. Due to the high degree of simplification and assumptions applied in previous modelling of these paths, conclusions remained vague so far. For one of these paths, the stable mass transfer channel, we now construct detailed binary evolution models which include internal differential rotation as well as mass and angular momentum transfer between the stars, all the way from the zero-age main sequence to the formation of the black holes, only skipping the rapid late burning stages. This allows us to follow the mass and chemical structure evolution of the mass accreting component, which turns out to have a key influence on the phase of reverse mass transfer, that allows the obtained black hole spins and mass ratios to naturally fall into the regime observed for the gravitational-wave source in the 10--25$M_\odot$ primary black hole mass range. As for this channel, also a large number of progenitor binaries are known, we conclude that it likely contributes to the observed population of gravitational wave sources.

一句话导读：详细双星演化模型表明，稳定质量转移通道能产生与观测相符的黑洞自旋和质量比，并可能贡献引力波源族群。

高维带电正则黑洞：麦克斯韦极限、拉格朗日量的支点与热力学

Electrically charged regular black holes in higher dimensions: Maxwellian limit, branch point of the Lagrangian, and thermodynamics

Bobir Toshmatov, Bobomurat Ahmedov, Nozima Isamadinova, Ozodbek Rahimov, Chengxun Yuan · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-16

中文摘要：在广义相对论与非线性电动力学耦合中，带电正则黑洞已知需要双值拉格朗日密度 L(F)，其支点位于电磁不变量取极值的半径处。我们将此类黑洞构造推广到任意时空维度 D≥4，得到用单个非线性参数 γ 统一 Bardeen 与 Hayward 黑洞的新解析解族。证明当且仅当 γ=D-3 时恢复弱场麦克斯韦极限，因此四维中不具备该极限的 Bardeen/Hayward 黑洞，分别在五维和六维中变为麦克斯韦型。物质部分用对偶 P 框架写成仅含固定耦合常数的哈密顿密度 H(P)，黑洞质量和电荷成为固定理论的积分常数；正则解构成质量与电荷相联系的单参数子族。我们以闭式定位 L(F) 的支点，发现四维中支点总隐藏在事件视界内，而 D≥5 时对于近极端电荷支点可从视界露出并被远处观测者看到。零能量条件与弱能量条件处处满足，强能量条件仅在视界内被破坏，主能量条件仅在 γ>D-3 时于大距离处被破坏。最后，由于理论固定，黑洞热力学第一定律保持标准形式；我们给出闭式的视界势、以耦合为热力学变量的扩展第一定律及相应的 Smarr 公式。

English: Electrically charged regular black holes in general relativity coupled to nonlinear electrodynamics are known to require a double-valued Lagrangian density $L(F)$, with a branch point at the radius where the electromagnetic invariant attains its extremum. We extend the construction of such black holes to an arbitrary number of spacetime dimensions $D\geq4$ and obtain a new family of solutions that unifies the Bardeen and Hayward black holes in a single analytic form, with a single nonlinearity parameter $\gamma$. We show that the Maxwellian weak-field limit is recovered if and only if $\gamma=D-3$, so that the Bardeen and Hayward black holes, which lack this limit in four dimensions, become Maxwellian in five and six dimensions, respectively. The matter sector is written in the dual $P$ framework as a Hamiltonian density $H(P)$ that contains only fixed coupling constants, so that the mass and the charge of the black hole appear as integration constants of a fixed theory; the regular solutions form a one-parameter subfamily in which the mass is tied to the charge. We locate the branch point of $\L(F)$ in closed form and find that it is always hidden inside the event horizon in four dimensions, whereas for $D\geq5$ it emerges from the horizon for near-extremal charges and becomes visible to a distant observer. The null and weak energy conditions are satisfied everywhere, the strong energy condition is violated only inside the horizon, and the dominant energy condition is violated at large distances only for $\gamma>D-3$. Finally, since the theory is fixed, the first law of black hole thermodynamics holds in its standard form; we derive the horizon potential in closed form, the extended first law with the couplings as thermodynamic variables, and the corresponding Smarr formula.

一句话导读：将带电正则黑洞推广到高维，用单一参数统一 Bardeen/Hayward 解并分析麦克斯韦极限、拉格朗日支点与热力学。

准圆轨道、自旋、非对称双星中的四极矩与自旋二次效应

Quadrupole and quadratic-in-spin effects in quasicircular, spinning, asymmetric binaries

Mostafizur Rahman, Misbah Shahzadi, Adam Pound, Josh Mathews · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-16

中文摘要：下一代引力波探测器将要求对当前理论波形模型作出显著改进，尤其是在非对称质量双星情形。为此，我们通过计算小质量比下的完全相对论有限尺寸效应——主要是能量通量——提供了一项此类改进，其中包括次天体自旋二次项、自旋诱导四极矩项和潮汐诱导四极矩项，针对一个小伴星沿准圆轨道旋入 Kerr 黑洞的情形。我们在自引力理论的多尺度波形生成框架内进行这些计算；结合我们推导的能量平衡定律，该框架可用于为涉及恒星绕黑洞运动的非对称双星构建自洽的波形模型。我们的结果还可用于改进所有质量比下的其他类型波形模型。我们以 Chebyshev 网格上的完整数值数据集，以及解析后牛顿展开（相对于通量中每一项的领头项到六阶后牛顿阶）的形式给出结果。

English: Next-generation gravitational-wave detectors will require significant improvements in current theoretical waveform models, particularly in the case of asymmetric-mass binaries. Here we provide one such improvement by calculating fully relativistic finite-size effects for small mass ratios -- primarily, fluxes of energy -- including quadratic-in-secondary-spin terms, spin-induced quadrupole terms, and tidally induced quadrupole terms, for quasicircular inspirals of a small companion into a Kerr black hole. We formulate these calculations within a multiscale waveform-generation framework in self-force theory, which could be used, with an energy-balance law we derive, to develop self-contained waveform models for asymmetric binaries involving stars orbiting black holes. Our results could additionally be used to improve other families of waveform models across all mass ratios. We present results both as complete numerical data sets on a Chebyshev grid and as analytical post-Newtonian expansions (to sixth PN order relative to the leading term in each contribution to the flux).

一句话导读：计算小质量比非对称双星中自旋二次、自旋诱导四极与潮汐诱导四极的完全相对论能量通量，以改进引力波波形模型。

用于 GW250114 铃宕分析的扩展参数化自旋展开形式

Extended parameterized spin expansion formalism for ringdown analysis with GW250114

Jia-Ning Chen, Liang-Bi Wu, Zong-Kuan Guo · gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-10-16

中文摘要：黑洞准正规模谱的参数化描述对于利用铃宕观测检验引力至关重要。我们扩展了参数化自旋展开系数（ParSpec）形式，同时采样特征长度尺度 $\tilde{\ell}$ 和标度指数 $\tilde{p}$，而不是将 $\tilde{p}$ 固定为理论动机的整数并约束 $\tilde{\ell}$。物理上，这一扩展将来自高阶曲率算符的谱修正标度提升为可观测量。方法上，它使我们能够研究扩大的 ParSpec 参数空间，并识别由有效耦合 $\gamma$ 条件所诱导的先验几何。我们使用 220 和 220+221 铃宕模型、不同起始时间，并对 GW250114 的质量和光度采用信息先验，考察该框架的稳健性，还进一步研究了与 GW231123 的联合约束。我们指出，在所考虑的耦合规定中，$\gamma<1$ 可避免 $\tilde{p}$ 与 $\tilde{\ell}$ 之间的人为相关性，并且在 ParSpec 框架中铃宕起始时间和 QNM 模式内容的选择应与数据的信息量和分辨能力相匹配。需要更高信噪比的铃宕和更大事件样本的层级分析来打破 $\tilde{p}$-$\tilde{\ell}$ 简并，并直接探测对 GR 修正的标度结构。

English: Parameterized descriptions of black-hole quasinormal-mode spectra are essential for testing gravity with ringdown observations. We extend the Parameterized Spin Expansion Coefficients (ParSpec) formalism by simultaneously sampling the characteristic length scale $\tilde{\ell}$ and the scaling index $\tilde{p}$, rather than fixing $\tilde{p}$ to a theory-motivated integer and constraining $\tilde{\ell}$. Physically, this extension promotes the scaling of the spectral corrections coming from higher-curvature operators to an observable quantity. Methodologically, it enables us to investigate the enlarged ParSpec parameter space and identify the prior geometry induced by conditions on the effective coupling $\gamma$. We examine the robustness of the framework by using the $220$ and $220+221$ ringdown models over different start times with informative priors on mass and luminosity for GW250114, and further study a joint constraint with GW231123. We pointed out that $\gamma<1$ avoids an artificial correlation between $\tilde{p}$ and $\tilde{\ell}$ among the coupling prescriptions considered, and the choices of ringdown starting time and QNM mode content in the ParSpec framework should be matched to the information content and resolving power of the data. Higher-SNR ringdowns and hierarchical analyses of a larger event population will be required to break the $\tilde{p}$-$\tilde{\ell}$ degeneracy and directly probe the scaling structure of corrections to GR.

一句话导读：扩展 ParSpec 形式，将高阶曲率修正的标度指数与长度尺度同时作为可观测量，用于 GW250114 铃宕检验引力。

浸没在精质流体和弦云中的带电黑弦

Charged black string immersed in a quintessence fluid and string cloud

Leonardo G. Barbosa, Franciele M. da Silva · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-16

中文摘要：我们提出了一个描述浸没在 Kiselev 型精质流体和弦云中的带电黑弦的新静态解。对一般的精质状态参数求解了度规和场方程，并对物理上相关的 w_q = -2/3 情形给出了显式结果。我们分析了事件视界结构和 Kretschmann 标量，检验了能量条件约束，并推导了热力学性质，包括 Hawking 温度、热容和 Helmholtz 自由能。最后，我们研究了圆轨道零测地线的外部光子柱的存在性，发现在这里采用的参数假设下，外视界之外不存在这样的光子柱。该解通过同时包含精质和弦云参数，推广了已知的带电黑弦时空。

English: We present a new static solution describing a charged black string immersed in a Kiselev-type quintessence fluid and a string cloud. The metric and field equations are solved for a general quintessence state parameter, with explicit results provided for the physically relevant case $w_q = -2/3$. We analyze the event-horizon structure and the Kretschmann scalar, verify energy-condition constraints, and derive thermodynamic properties including the Hawking temperature and heat capacity and the Helmholtz free energy. Finally, we investigate the existence of an exterior photon cylinder for circular null geodesics, finding that, under the parameter assumptions adopted here, no such cylinder occurs outside the outer horizon. The solution generalizes known charged black-string spacetimes by simultaneously including quintessence and a string-cloud parameter.

Damour-Solodukhin 虫洞周围类时轨道的解析解

Analytical solutions for timelike orbits around Damour-Solodukhin wormholes

Shao-Chen Ho, Yo-Chung Ko, Tien Hsieh, Da-Shin Lee · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-16

中文摘要：我们研究 Damour-Solodukhin 虫洞周围的类时测地线，这类虫洞是 Schwarzschild 型几何，由形变参数 λ 刻画，该参数决定喉部半径 r_th。径向势有四个根，其中包括喉部半径本身，使得喉部可以与其他根合并，形成二重、三重和四重简并。与喉部相关的三重根构型原则上可以确定最内稳定圆轨道（ISCO），这提供了与 Schwarzschild 黑洞潜在观测区分。使用 Mino 时间参数化，我们推导了束缚和非束缚运动的粒子轨迹，以不完全椭圆积分的闭式解析解表示。我们关注喉部处二重或三重根的位置，此时当粒子接近喉部时，轨道运动的方位角和坐标时间表现出对数或幂律发散。相反，当喉部对应单根时，轨迹保持正则，允许粒子在两个渐近平坦区域之间平滑穿越。我们还推导了与喉部相关的精确同宿解，并计算了相应的 Lyapunov 指数。此外，分析了穿过喉部的旋近和落入轨迹。这些结果为粒子动力学和虫洞可能的观测特征提供了分析洞见。

English: We investigate timelike geodesics around Damour-Solodukhin wormholes, which are Schwarzschild-like geometries characterized by a deformation parameter $\lambda$ that determines the radius of the throat, $r_{\rm th}$. The radial potential admits four roots, including the throat radius itself, allowing the throat to merge with other roots and form double, triple, and quartic degeneracies. Triple-root configurations associated with the throat, in principle, can determine the innermost stable circular orbit (ISCO), which provides a potential observational distinction from Schwarzschild black holes. Using the Mino-time parametrization, we derive particle trajectories with closed-form analytical solutions in terms of incomplete elliptic integrals for both bound and unbound motion. Our focus is on the location of double or triple roots at the throat, where the azimuthal angle and coordinate time of orbital motion show logarithmic or power-law divergence as the particle approaches the throat. By contrast, trajectories remain regular when the throat corresponds to a simple root, allowing particles to traverse smoothly between the two asymptotically flat regions. We also derive exact homoclinic solutions associated with the throat and compute the corresponding Lyapunov exponent. In addition, inspiral and plunge trajectories through the throat are analyzed. These results provide analytic insights into the particle dynamics and possible observational signatures of the wormholes.

一句话导读：本文给出 Damour-Solodukhin 虫洞周围类时测地线的解析解，并分析喉部简并、ISCO、同宿轨道与 Lyapunov 指数。

黏性恒星的径向振荡

Radial Oscillations of Viscous Stars

Lennox S. Keeble, Jaime Redondo-Yuste · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v3 · 更新 2026-10-16

中文摘要：中子星的振荡模式是第三代引力波探测器的关键目标，编码了其组成核物质的关键信息。在本工作中，我们研究黏性对冷、多方、球对称中子星振荡的影响。我们聚焦纯径向振荡，并在两个流体力学框架内微扰到线性阶：Eckart提出的Navier-Stokes方程的非因果协变推广，以及Bemfica、Disconzi、Noronha和Kovtun（BDNK）提出的因果推广。我们发现黏性在毫秒时标上阻尼径向模式，并引起振荡频率的分数偏移；该偏移随恒星的紧致度和黏性增加而增大，对于基本模式，当体黏性 ζ∼10^30 g/cm/s 时可达百分之一量级。对于黏性更大的恒星，振荡频率减小，当 ζ≳10^31 g/cm/s 时变为零（即过阻尼模式）。我们还研究了引力坍缩的线性阈值。与最近在零热导率极限下的解析结果一致，我们发现Eckart理论中的黏性无法稳定一个不稳定的无黏恒星。我们提供数值证据表明BDNK理论中的黏性同样无法阻止引力坍缩，但会略微修改坍缩阈值。总体而言，我们的结果推进了对黏性如何影响中子星振荡模式的理解，这是下一代引力波探测器时代黏性星震学的一个关键组成部分。

English: Oscillation modes of neutron stars, a key target for third-generation gravitational wave detectors, encode key information about their constituent nuclear matter. In this work, we study the effect of viscosity on oscillations of cold, polytropic, spherically symmetric neutron stars. We focus on purely radial oscillations and work perturbatively to linear order within two hydrodynamic frameworks: the acausal covariant generalization of the Navier-Stokes equations proposed by Eckart, and the causal generalization formulated by Bemfica, Disconzi, Noronha, and Kovtun (BDNK). We find that viscosity damps the radial modes on millisecond timescales and induces fractional shifts in the oscillation frequency which increase both with the compactness and viscosity of the star, reaching up to the percent level for the fundamental mode with bulk viscosities $\zeta\sim10^{30}\mathrm{g}/\mathrm{cm}/\mathrm{s}$. For more viscous stars, the oscillation frequency decreases, becoming zero (i.e., an overdamped mode) for $\zeta\gtrsim10^{31}\mathrm{g}/\mathrm{cm}/\mathrm{s}$. We also study the linear threshold of gravitational collapse. Consistent with recent analytic results in the zero heat conductivity limit, we find that viscosity in Eckart theory cannot stabilize an unstable inviscid star. We provide numerical evidence that viscosity in BDNK theory is similarly unable to prevent gravitational collapse, but it slightly modifies the threshold of collapse. Overall, our results advance our understanding of the impact of viscosity on the oscillation modes of neutron stars, a key component of viscous asteroseismology with next-generation gravitational wave detectors.

一句话导读：研究黏性对冷中子星径向振荡的阻尼与频率偏移，并论证Eckart和BDNK框架下黏性不能阻止引力坍缩。
