通过四点关联器寻找脉冲星计时阵列中的非高斯性

Looking for non-gaussianity in Pulsar Timing Arrays through the four point correlator

Adrien Kuntz, Clemente Smarra, Massimo Vaglio · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO, astro-ph.HE, hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：脉冲星计时阵列最近报告了随机引力波背景的强证据。在标准分析中，它通过依赖于脉冲星的傅里叶系数建模，并假定服从高斯统计，因此信号完全由两点函数表征。然而，如果该背景来自有限数量的旋进超大质量黑洞双星，则可能出现非高斯特征，使得确定高阶关联器变得必要。在本工作中，我们计算了四个任意脉冲星位置下随机引力波背景傅里叶系数的完整四点关联器，并确认它是非高斯性的首要探针。结果分为高斯贡献（正比于两点函数的平方）和真正非高斯的连通分量，其非平凡角依赖将 Hellings and Downs 关联推广到四颗脉冲星。该角结构仅依赖于天线方向图函数乘积的平均值，因此预计与背景的具体物理起源无关。我们进一步提出通过推导一个微扰地考虑非高斯效应的边缘化似然，将四点关联器纳入参数估计流程。我们的结果为在脉冲星计时阵列数据中寻找非高斯特征提供了理论框架，为更完整地刻画引力波背景开辟了道路。

English: Pulsar Timing Arrays have recently reported strong evidence for a stochastic gravitational wave background. In standard analyses, it is modeled through pulsar-dependent Fourier coefficients assumed to follow gaussian statistics, so that the signal is fully characterized by its two-point function. However, if the background arises from a finite population of inspiralling supermassive black hole binaries, non-gaussian features may emerge, making the determination of higher-order correlators essential. In this work, we compute the complete four-point correlator of the stochastic gravitational wave background Fourier coefficients for four arbitrary pulsar positions, identifying it as the leading probe of non-gaussianity. The result separates into a gaussian contribution, proportional to the square of the two-point function, and a genuinely non-gaussian connected component, whose non-trivial angular dependence generalizes the Hellings and Downs correlation to four pulsars. This angular structure depends only on averages of products of antenna pattern functions, and is therefore expected to be independent of the specific physical origin of the background. We further propose to incorporate the four-point correlator into the parameter-estimation pipeline by deriving a marginalized likelihood that perturbatively accounts for non-gaussian effects. Our results provide the theoretical framework to search for non-gaussian features in pulsar timing array data, opening the way to a more complete characterization of gravitational-wave backgrounds.

一句话导读：计算随机引力波背景的四点关联器并给出边缘化似然，为脉冲星计时阵列中搜寻非高斯性提供理论框架。

有限温度下含超子致密物质的多体效应

Many-body effects on dense matter with hyperons at finite temperature

Rafael B\'an Jacobsen, Ricardo Luciano Sonego Farias, Veronica Dexheimer · nucl-th, astro-ph.HE, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：在这项工作中，我们首次将多体力（MBF）模型推广到有限温度。MBF 模型在相对论量子强子动力学形式体系中描述核物质，并通过核相互作用耦合常数的场依赖性来考虑多体力。假设核物质电荷中性、β 平衡，且由重子八重态、电子、μ 子和中微子组成，我们研究了模型中控制多体力的参数、三种不同的超子耦合方案（此处也首次引入 MBF 模型）以及温度效应，以描述核物质的基本性质，包括声速、压缩率和绝热指数。我们还通过求解零温和有限温度下的 Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff 方程，研究中子星和原中子星的质量-半径关系，包括每重子熵和轻子分数固定的情形。我们发现，不同的超子耦合方案在不同程度上软化状态方程，需要不同程度的多体作用力效应来重现观测，尽管这些效应从不为零。我们结果的多维表格已可在 CompOSE 仓库获取，可供天体物理模拟使用。

English: In this work, we present the first extension of the Many-Body Forces (MBF) Model to finite temperature. The MBF Model describes nuclear matter in a relativistic quantum hadrodynamics formalism that takes many-body forces into account through a field dependence of the nuclear interaction coupling constants. Assuming nuclear matter to be charge neutral, beta-equilibrated, and populated by the baryon octet, electrons, muons, and neutrinos, we explore the parameter of the model that controls many-body forces, three different hyperon coupling schemes (also introduced here for the first time in the MBF Model), and temperature effects to describe basic properties of nuclear matter, including the speed of sound, compressibility, and adiabatic index. We also investigate the mass-radius relation of neutron and protoneutron stars by solving the Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff equations at zero and finite temperature, including scenarios with fixed entropy per baryon and lepton fraction. We find that different hyperon coupling schemes soften the equation of state to different degrees, requiring different degrees of many-body force effects to reproduce observations, although they are never zero. Multidimensional tables with our results are available in the CompOSE repository, ready to be used in astrophysical simulations.

一句话导读：首次将 MBF 模型推广到有限温度，考察超子耦合、多体效应与温度对致密物质状态方程及中子星/原中子星质量-半径关系的影响。

相关度：medium — 论文属于核天体物理/致密物质，非全息；但通过 TOV 方程研究经典中子星与原中子星质量-半径关系，匹配经典引力/广义相对论支线。

幽灵机制——早期物质主导时期对标量诱导引力波的增强

The poltergeist mechanism - Enhancement of scalar-induced gravitational waves with early matter-dominated era -

Keisuke Inomata, Kazunori Kohri, Takahiro Terada · astro-ph.CO, gr-qc, hep-ph, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：由原初密度扰动诱导的引力波为宇宙热历史提供了强有力的探针，其中可能包括由动机充分的粒子物理模型所预言的早期物质主导（eMD）时期。当宇宙从eMD时期突然过渡到有压时期（如辐射或动能主导时期）时，诱导引力波可以显著增强。这种增强源于eMD期间密度扰动的增长以及它们在压时期中的快速振荡。该现象被称为poltergeist机制。在这篇综述中，我们解释poltergeist机制的本质，并探讨可能发生这种增强的具体场景。

English: Gravitational waves induced by primordial density perturbations provide a powerful probe of the Universe's thermal history, which may include an early matter-dominated (eMD) era predicted by well-motivated particle-physics models. The induced GWs can be significantly enhanced when the Universe undergoes a sudden transition from an eMD era to an era with pressure, such as a radiation or kination era. This enhancement arises from the growth of density perturbations during the eMD era and their rapid oscillations during the era with pressure. This phenomenon is called the poltergeist mechanism. In this review, we explain the essence of the poltergeist mechanism and explore concrete scenarios in which such an enhancement can occur.

一句话导读：综述：早期物质主导到有压时期的突然转变可通过poltergeist机制显著增强标量诱导引力波。

动态背景上热环境中的引力扰动集体性质

Collective Properties of Gravitational Perturbations in Thermal Environments on a Dynamical Background

Atsuhisa Ota · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO, hep-ph, hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：热等离子体会修饰软规范场，使其成为具有等离子体频率隙和朗道阻尼的集体模式。本文追问热辐射等离子体是否对引力扰动产生类似效应。对引力而言，热软标度与哈勃速率重合，因此任何这类能隙都位于视界尺度，此时背景膨胀不可忽略。我们用共形标量描述辐射，并直接在平坦 FLRW 背景上计算其对度规扰动的线性响应。我们利用微分同胚 Ward 恒等式检验该响应。绝热色散关系给出一个有隙集体模式，ω_p² = 8ℋ²/5，其中 ℋ 是共形哈勃速率。然而其频率虚部由背景膨胀主导，并不代表朗道阻尼。在辐射背景中，张量模满足一个实时积分微分方程，可重现 Weinberg 对引力波的阻尼。尽管存在能隙，推迟响应的初始时间边界仍使超视界模在再进入视界前保持冻结。早期分析中发现的超视界增长，源于丢弃推迟响应的记忆以及使用了违反 Ward 恒等式的局域平衡态规定。更一般地，Ward 恒等式禁止超出无碰撞核的任何局域态响应。

English: A thermal plasma dresses soft gauge fields, turning them into collective modes with a plasmon gap and Landau damping. In this paper, we ask whether a thermal radiation plasma does the same to gravitational perturbations. For gravity, the thermal soft scale coincides with the Hubble rate. Any such gap therefore lies at the horizon scale, where the expansion of the background cannot be neglected. We model radiation by a conformal scalar and compute its linear response to metric perturbations directly on a flat FLRW background. We test this response against the diffeomorphism Ward identities. The adiabatic dispersion relation yields a gapped collective mode with $\omega_p^2 = 8\mathcal{H}^2/5$, where $\mathcal{H}$ is the conformal Hubble rate. The imaginary part of its frequency, however, is dominated by the background expansion and does not represent Landau damping. In the radiation background, the tensor modes obey a real-time integro-differential equation that reproduces Weinberg's damping of gravitational waves. The initial-time boundary of the retarded response keeps superhorizon modes frozen until horizon reentry despite the gap. The superhorizon growth found in earlier analyses arises from discarding the memory of the retarded response and from a local-equilibrium state prescription that violates the Ward identities. More generally, the Ward identities forbid any local state response beyond the collisionless kernel.

一句话导读：在 FLRW 辐射背景上，热等离子体使引力扰动获得视界尺度能隙，但不产生 Landau 阻尼；张量模的实时积分微分方程重现 Weinberg 阻尼，且 Ward 恒等式排除超出无碰撞核的局域响应。

重新评估度规-仿射引力的基础

Reassessing the foundations of Metric-Affine Gravity

J. Fran\c{c}ois, L. Ravera · gr-qc, hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们基于Dressing Field Method重新评估度规-仿射引力（MAG）的基础方面，Dressing Field Method是一种能够系统构造规范不变场变量的工具。为使MAG成立，必须处理“规范平移”问题。我们首先回顾Cartan几何是引力规范理论的恰当数学基础，并且在该框架中这一问题从不出现，这仍有助于澄清规范平移的几何地位。随后，我们展示如何以技术上更简洁的方式通过dressing得到MAG运动学，并强调它约化为Cartan几何运动学。

English: We reassess foundational aspects of Metric-Affine Gravity (MAG) in light of the Dressing Field Method, a tool allowing to systematically build gauge-invariant field variables. To get MAG started, one has to deal with the problem of "gauge translations". We first recall that Cartan geometry is the proper mathematical foundation for gauge theories of gravity, and that this problem never arises in that framework, which still allows to clarify the geometric status of gauge translations. Then, we show how the MAG kinematics is obtained via dressing in a technically streamlined way, which highlights that it reduces to a Cartan-geometric kinematics.

一句话导读：用Dressing Field Method重新审视度规-仿射引力，表明其运动学可通过dressing构造得到并约化为Cartan几何运动学。

AdS 中零弦全息的局域 BRST 下降

Null string holography in AdS from local BRST descent

Sarthak Duary, Sourav Maji · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们证明，在 Poincaré AdS_D 中的 Carroll-Weyl 规范零弦的径向部分在 BRST 上同调中局域平凡。在适配商化的 BFV 基中，径向坐标、其共轭动量以及相应的鬼场构成一个可收缩四重态。一个显式的收缩同伦将这一约化延拓到局域空间 jet 的全代数，恰好留下 (D-1) 维 ILST BRST 复形。同一四重态携带零净 Virasoro 中心荷，因此母理论的异常条件 D=27 下降为 ILST 条件 d=26。

English: We show that the radial sector of a Carroll-Weyl gauged null string in Poincar\'e $\mathrm{AdS}_D$ is locally trivial in BRST cohomology. In a quotient-adapted BFV basis, the radial coordinate, its conjugate momentum, and the associated ghosts form a contractible quartet. An explicit contracting homotopy extends this reduction to the full algebra of local spatial jets, leaving precisely the $(D-1)$-dimensional ILST BRST complex. The same quartet carries zero net Virasoro central charge, so that the anomaly condition of the parent theory, $D=27$, descends to the ILST condition $d=26$.

一句话导读：该文展示 AdS 中 Carroll-Weyl 零弦的径向 BRST 扇区可局部消去，并约化为 (D-1) 维 ILST BRST 复形，使 D=27 异常条件降为 d=26。

从粘合一致性到量子引力：从 AdS/CFT 到自旋泡沫

Quantum Gravity from Gluing Consistency: AdS/CFT to Spin-Foams

Chethan Krishnan · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们论证，具有 SO(d+1,1) 规范群的 BF 理论提供了一个 SymTFT“骨架”，通过作为 bootstrap 原理的粘合一致性来构建 AdS_{d+1}/CFT_d 对，粗略类似于紧致 Chern-Simons 理论是有理 CFT 的 TQFT 骨架。这是一个非微扰的体量子引力框架。bootstrap 被表述为：在一个普适的、对缺陷封闭的 BF 缝合演算中，物理振幅的表示无关性；该演算包括 Wilson 线、余二维单值缺陷及其连接点。平坦 BF 联络编码边界的共形几何，而 Wilson 线路径积分构造候选的量子引力微观态和电荷扇区。当 bootstrapped 谱具有应力张量时，Ward 恒等式自然将其与 B 场联系起来，我们将此关系称为广义简单性。在大 N、大能隙且允许引力 EFT 的区域中，这促使引入 B 场的有效概念。在 Einstein 极限下，这变成自旋泡沫模型中使用的“简单性”关系。传统自旋泡沫模型试图通过约束 BF 理论来获得引力。我们反而建议 BF 理论是柏拉图式的缝合骨架，理论应从中 bootstrap 出来。尽管骨架具有拓扑性质，微扰局部体场可以通过 multi-trace 原初算符的 Wilson 塔涌现，再现其单圈行列式。我们指出 BF Fourier 核是 modular-S 结构的一个暗示性高维类比。由于体粘合原理本身不需要边界描述，该框架在概念上比 AdS/CFT 更广。我们勾画 de Sitter 空间如何可能纳入这一图像，其中观察者可扮演自然角色。我们的方法将粘合一致性提升为量子引力理论背后的普适体原理。

English: We argue that BF theory with $SO(d+1,1)$ gauge group provides a SymTFT ''skeleton'' for building AdS$_{d+1}$/CFT$_d$ pairs via gluing consistency as the bootstrap principle, loosely analogous to how compact Chern-Simons theory is a TQFT skeleton for rational CFTs. This is a non-perturbative $bulk$ framework for quantum gravity. The bootstrap is formulated as presentation independence of physical amplitudes within a universal, defect-closed BF sewing calculus, which includes Wilson lines, codimension-two monodromy defects, and their junctions. The flat BF connection encodes the conformal geometry of the boundary, while Wilson-line path integrals construct candidate quantum-gravity microstates and charge sectors. When the bootstrapped spectrum has a stress tensor, Ward identities naturally connect it to the $B$-field, a relation we call generalized simplicity. In large-$N$, large-gap regimes admitting a gravitational EFT, this motivates the introduction of an effective notion of the $B$-field. In the Einstein limit, this becomes the ''simplicity'' relation used in spin-foam models. Conventional spin-foam models try to obtain gravity by constraining BF theory. We suggest instead that BF theory is the Platonic sewing skeleton, from which theories are to be bootstrapped. Despite the topological nature of the skeleton, perturbative local bulk fields can emerge via Wilson-towers of multi-trace primaries, reproducing their one-loop determinants. We note that the BF Fourier kernel is a suggestive higher-dimensional analogue of the modular-$S$ structure. Because the bulk gluing principle in itself does not require a boundary description, the framework is conceptually broader than AdS/CFT. We sketch how de Sitter space may fit into this picture, with a natural role for observers. Our approach elevates gluing consistency to a universal bulk principle underlying theories of quantum gravity.

一句话导读：该文提出以 BF 理论的粘合一致性作为非微扰量子引力的普适骨架，并将 AdS/CFT bootstrap、自旋泡沫与 de Sitter 图景联系起来。

Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet 精质暴胀：从超暴胀到涌现温暴胀

Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet quintessential inflation: From super-inflation to emergent warm inflation

Omar Chahboun, Rachid Ahl Laamara, El Hassan Saidi · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：本文在 Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet 引力中耦合三个标量场，构建了一个统一的暴胀与晚期宇宙学模型，整个宇宙历史由单一势和耦合函数控制。作者允许 Gauss-Bonnet 耦合依赖于场内容，而非任意指定，由此产生两阶段暴胀：高阶曲率项最初驱动膨胀，随后变为次主导。初始超暴胀阶段在瀑布场由几何诱导的稳定化失效时动态结束，该场值由组合 (n-1)Q 决定。瀑布凝聚体的相干振荡作为初始辐射源，取代传统重加热，并为后续温暴胀阶段建立热浴。采用 Γ_φ ∝ T^3 的两阶段耗散机制，在保留 Gauss-Bonnet 贡献的情况下推导标量和张量谱，表明暴胀子涨落的增长受热浴剪切黏滞调节，这对模型可行性至关重要。此前在冷暴胀场景中被排除的四次势变得可行，n_s 落在 Planck 1σ 范围内且 r 被压低。与谱指数的符合具有普遍性，而内部一致性将模型限制在 (n-1)Q 的狭窄带内。最后，第三个标量场在物质-辐射相等附近释放，通过一种与 seesaw 机制相反的逻辑，将极小的质量标度转化为极大的耦合。在晚期，暴胀子持续作为暗能量。

English: This work presents a unified inflationary and late-time cosmology, developed within Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet gravity coupled to three scalar fields, governed by a single potential and coupling function throughout cosmic history. Permitting the Gauss-Bonnet coupling to depend on the field content, rather than assigning it arbitrarily, produces a two-phase inflationary scenario: the higher-curvature term initially drives expansion and later becomes a subdominant. The initial super-inflationary stage ends dynamically when the geometrically induced stabilization of the waterfall field fails, at a field value determined by the combination $(n-1)Q$. Coherent oscillations of the waterfall condensate serve as the initial radiation source, replacing conventional reheating and establishing the thermal bath necessary for the subsequent warm phase. Utilizing a two-stage dissipation mechanism with $\Gamma_\phi\propto T^3$, the scalar and tensor spectra are derived while retaining Gauss-Bonnet contributions, demonstrating that the growth of inflaton fluctuations is regulated by the shear viscosity of the bath, which is essential for model viability. A quartic potential, previously excluded in the cold scenario, becomes viable, with $n_s$ within the Planck $1\sigma$ band and $r$ suppressed. Agreement with the spectral index is generic, while internal consistency confines the model to a narrow band in $(n-1)Q$. Finally, the release of the third scalar near matter-radiation equality transforms a very small mass scale into a very large coupling by a logic inverse to the seesaw mechanism. At late times, the inflaton persists as dark energy.

一句话导读：在 Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet 引力与三标量场框架下构建从超暴胀、温暴胀到晚期暗能量的统一宇宙学模型，并分析谱与参数约束。

正整简并模谱中的大能隙与 BTZ 熵

Large gaps and BTZ entropy in modular spectra with positive integer degeneracies

Chi-Ming Chang, Reiko Liu, Wen-Jie Ma · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们构造了具有唯一真空、离散能级和正整数简并的模不变环面配分函数，方法是对 Virasoro 真空的 Maloney--Witten--Keller 模完成进行递归修复。精确模修复与有限矩匹配将相继的谱带离散化，同时保持先前能级并控制收敛。对于 c_L=c_R=c 和 a=(c-1)/12，该构造在任意足够大的实 c 下实现主征维数间隙 Δ_1=(1+κ)a（充分小的固定 κ>0），以及 Δ_1=a+δ（任意固定 δ≥0）。每个非真空主征满足 h、\bar h≥(c-1)/24。在固定 δ 家族中，可选择谱，使其态密度（用固定非负归一化紧支撑光滑核平滑后）逐固定有限阶在 1/c 中匹配单个微扰 BTZ 鞍点的相应平滑预言。计数包括所有自旋和 Virasoro 后代。其对数在每个固定正 E/c 下重现 Bekenstein--Hawking 熵及其修正，其中 E=Δ-c/12。这包括 0<E<c/12，其中热 AdS 在正则系综中占主导。

English: We construct modular-invariant torus partition functions with a unique vacuum, discrete energy levels and positive integer degeneracies by recursively repairing the Maloney--Witten--Keller modular completion of the Virasoro vacuum. Exact modular repairs and finite moment matching discretize successive spectral bands while preserving earlier levels and controlling convergence. For $c_L=c_R=c$ and $a=(c-1)/12$, the construction realizes primary dimension gaps $\Delta_1=(1+\kappa)a$ for sufficiently small fixed $\kappa>0$, and $\Delta_1=a+\delta$ for any fixed $\delta\ge0$, at every sufficiently large real $c$. Every nonvacuum primary satisfies $h,\bar h\ge(c-1)/24$. In the fixed-$\delta$ family, spectra can be chosen whose densities of states, smoothed with a fixed nonnegative normalized smooth kernel of compact support, match the correspondingly smoothed prediction of a single perturbative BTZ saddle through every fixed finite order in $1/c$. The count includes all spins and Virasoro descendants. Its logarithm reproduces the Bekenstein--Hawking entropy and its corrections at every fixed positive $E/c$, where $E=\Delta-c/12$. This includes $0<E<c/12$, where thermal AdS dominates the canonical ensemble.

一句话导读：构造模不变二维 CFT 谱，具备大 primary 间隙与正整数简并，并在大 c 下匹配 BTZ 鞍点的 Bekenstein--Hawking 熵及修正。

中文摘要：我们为纠缠熵发展了一个上同调框架，统一信息论、算子代数和非交换几何。熵是信息上同调中的 1-余循环；我们通过 Hochschild 和循环上同调将其推广到量子情形。对于 von Neumann 代数包含 N⊂M，带有忠实正规态 w 且存在循环分离向量，以及条件期望 E:M→N（其存在性由 Takesaki 定理等价于 N 的模不变性），我们构造纠缠复形为相对循环复形上的 transgression 映射 τ_w 的像，其中 A 是 M 的稠密 *-子代数，B=A∩N。我们的主要结果将纠缠上同调识别为限制映射 HC*(A)→HC*(B) 的核，直到配对 (A,B) 的长正合序列的连接同态 d；当 d=0 时，该识别是精确的。当 E 不是 w-不变时，相对模余循环 u_t=(Dw:D(w|_N)∘E)_t 生成显式纠缠类，Araki 相对熵为其无穷小生成元。该框架容纳 Type III von Neumann 代数，其中不存在局部密度矩阵，并导向一个全息提议：H^1_ent 的一个子空间被猜想对偶于体纠缠楔的线性化模哈密顿扰动。我们在有限维、type II_1 和 type III_1 例子中验证了该构造。

English: We develop a cohomological framework for entanglement entropy that unifies information theory, operator algebras, and noncommutative geometry. Entropy is a 1-cocycle in information cohomology; we generalize this to the quantum setting via Hochschild and cyclic cohomology. For an inclusion of von Neumann algebras N contained in M with a faithful normal state w admitting a cyclic and separating vector, and a conditional expectation E: M -> N (whose existence is equivalent to modular invariance of N by Takesaki's theorem), we construct the entanglement complex as the image of the transgression map tau_w on the relative cyclic complex, where A is a dense *-subalgebra of M and B = A intersect N. Our main result identifies entanglement cohomology with the kernel of the restriction map HC*(A) -> HC*(B), up to the connecting homomorphism d of the long exact sequence of the pair (A,B); when d = 0, the identification is exact. The relative modular cocycle u_t = (Dw : D(w|_N) o E)_t generates explicit entanglement classes when E is not w-invariant, with the Araki relative entropy as its infinitesimal generator. The framework accommodates Type III von Neumann algebras, where no local density matrix exists, and leads to a holographic proposal: a subspace of H^1_ent is conjecturally dual to linearized modular Hamiltonian perturbations of the bulk entanglement wedge. We verify the construction in finite-dimensional, type II_1, and type III_1 examples.

一句话导读：论文建立纠缠熵的上同调框架，统一信息论、算子代数与非交换几何，并猜想 H^1_ent 子空间对偶于体纠缠楔的线性化模哈密顿扰动。

English: We establish coefficientwise equality between the refined supersymmetric indices of ABJM theory and the BMN matrix model in the plane-wave limit at every fixed positive Chern-Simons level k. At the index level, the associated Higgs residues yield a diagonal-holonomy integral for the ABJM plane-wave contribution, whose monopole-harmonic kernel agrees with the BMN matrix-harmonic kernel up to the finite BMN upper-spin cutoff. At finite momentum, the full index difference splits into the non-plane-wave remainder and the harmonic tail above this cutoff. Increasing k shifts the former to higher fugacity grade without changing the surviving kernel or the cutoff contribution. 一句话导读：该文证明了平面波极限下 ABJM 与 BMN 矩阵模型精炼超对称指标的逐系数匹配，并推广到多膜扇区。

中文摘要：面积度规理论已在若干量子引力方案中被提出作为有效描述：作为有效自旋泡沫的连续极限、作为弦论的有效描述，以及在全息语境中。面积度规作用量允许非拓扑的宇称破坏项，这为观测确定 Barbero-Immirzi 参数提供了可能。我们考虑洛伦兹号差下线性化面积度规理论的平移对称版本，它特别出现在自旋泡沫和修正 Plebanski 理论中，并避免了引力子扇区中的鬼场和快子不稳定性。我们讨论该理论的类引力波解，并通过分析其与电磁学的耦合，推导出引力波探测器中的信号。在此类干涉仪中使用偏振光原则上可以测量面积度规导致的双折射。对于伴随引力波的非长度激发，这种双折射结果与 Barbero-Immirzi 参数无关；该参数反而编码在有质量非长度波的极化结构中，在那里它旋转诱导双折射的轴。假设面积度规中的普朗克质量非长度激发，所得信号仍然极其微弱。

English: Area metric theories have been proposed as effective descriptions in a number of quantum gravity approaches: as continuum limit of effective spin foams, as an effective description for string theory and in the context of holography. Area metric actions allow for non-topological parity violating terms, which opens the possibility of observationally determining the Barbero-Immirzi parameter. We consider the shift symmetric version of linearized area metric theory in Lorentzian signature, which arises in particular from spin foams and modified Plebanski theory, and avoids ghost and tachyonic instabilities in the graviton sector. We discuss the gravitational wave like solutions of this theory and through an analysis of the coupling to electro-magnetism, deduce the signals in gravitational wave detectors. Using polarized light in such interferometers allows in principle to measure area metric induced birefringence. For the non-length excitations that accompany a gravitational wave this birefringence turns out to be independent of the Barbero-Immirzi parameter; the parameter is instead encoded in the polarization structure of the massive non-length waves, where it rotates the axes of the induced birefringence. Assuming Planck massive non-length excitations in the area metric the resulting signals are however extremely weak.

一句话导读：在线性化面积度规引力中，引力波与电磁场耦合会产生双折射；Barbero-Immirzi 参数编码在有质量非长度激发的极化中，但预期探测器信号极弱。

English: We investigate how the sewing operations familiar from topological quantum field theory provide a useful organizational framework for semiclassical AdS/BCFT path integrals. Our purpose is not to identify AdS/BCFT with a topological field theory: the bulk geometry, the end-of-the-world brane, and the on-shell action remain intrinsically metric-dependent. Rather, we use the TQFT language of state preparation, orientation reversal, and gluing to separate interface data from local geometric contributions. For AdS$_3$/BCFT$_2$, we review how the Euclidean on-shell action and the Ryu--Takayanagi prescription reproduce the Affleck--Ludwig boundary entropy $\log g$ after holographic renormalization. We then formulate the Complexity=Action calculation in the presence of an end-of-the-world brane, carefully distinguishing bulk, brane, joint, and null-boundary contributions. We emphasize that finite terms in a relative Wheeler--DeWitt action depend on the choice of regulator matching and on the null-boundary counterterm scheme unless their scheme independence is established explicitly. Finally, we extend the geometric construction to a planar BTZ background and derive the brane embedding from the Neumann boundary condition. The resulting framework clarifies which aspects of holographic complexity are sensitive to boundary conditions and which require further renormalization input before they can be interpreted as universal boundary data.

一句话导读：本文用 TQFT 缝合框架组织 AdS/BCFT 半经典路径积分，并在世界末端膜存在时讨论 Complexity=Action 对边界熵和重整化方案的依赖。

中文摘要：我们研究 AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$ 中全局淬火后的全息热化过程中，多体纠缠如何被动力学地重组。我们首先使用 $n$ 分信息 $(-1)^n I_n$ 来探测全息构型中的集体多体纠缠；在这些构型中，完整的 $n$ 区域纠缠楔是连通的，而所有涉及更少子区域的纠缠楔是断开的，从而排除更少子区域的贡献。随着系统趋近晚期局域热态，多体纠缠的空间范围先扩展后收缩。涉及不同数量子区域的纠缠在可比较的早期时间尺度上发展，而涉及更多子区域的纠缠弛豫得更慢，揭示出从较短到较长空间距离的瞬态传播。我们进一步计算 Markov gap 和真正的三分 multi-entropy，作为三分纠缠的互补探针。Markov gap 在局域热化之后仍可保持增强，而真正的三分 multi-entropy 经历非单调演化，并对本工作考虑的相邻三分划分返回到其真空值。这些结果表明，全局淬火在空间尺度上重新分配纠缠并重组其多体结构。

English: We study how multipartite entanglement is dynamically reorganized during holographic thermalization following a global quench in AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$. Entanglement involving different numbers of parties develops on comparable early-time scales, while the entanglement that involves more parties relaxes more slowly, revealing a transient propagation from shorter to longer spatial distances. We further compute the Markov gap and the genuine tripartite multi-entropy as complementary probes of tripartite entanglement. The Markov gap can remain enhanced after local thermalization, whereas the genuine tripartite multi-entropy undergoes a nonmonotonic evolution and returns to its vacuum value for the adjacent tripartition considered in this work. These results show that a global quench redistributes the entanglement across spatial scales and reorganizes its multipartite structure.

一句话导读：在 AdS$_3$-Vaidya 全局淬火热化中，多体纠缠的空间范围先扩张后收缩，且涉及更多子区域的纠缠弛豫更慢；Markov gap 与三分 multi-entropy 提供互补诊断。

中文摘要：我们询问：在固定重整化方案中，量子场论的球面自由能在减除其局部抵消项之后，何时会沿重整化群（RG）流单调递减。抵消项固定了减除多项式的必需零点，但仅谱数据的正性并不能决定单调性。对于高斯行列式，一个重标度后的积分热迹的完全单调性就足够了。该条件证明了每个球面 S^p, p≥2 上 Robin 边界流的单调性。一个相关恒等式证明奇数球面 S^d, d≥3 上大质量 Dirac 场的单调性。反之，在所述端点与衰减假设下，从下方趋近红外值排除了每一种保持端点的有限多项式减除。对于这里考虑的双迹族，由球面表面缺陷上的 O^2 驱动，并在大 N 领头阶由 S^3 上的 O^2 驱动，单调减除存在当且仅当 O 的维数分别至少为 1/2 和 (3 - sqrt(37/13))/2。低于这些阈值没有减除是单调的，尽管谱仍为正。相同的行列式描述了 AdS_3 和 AdS_4 中自由大质量标量的双迹边界流，其中这些分类可以照搬。最后，在接触项固定后，从三维共形场论流向有能隙相的流的领头红外球面系数，正比于非负应力张量谱矩之差。在大质量临界 O(N) 模型中，该差值在领头阶消失，并在 N^0 阶为负。

English: We ask when the sphere free energy of a quantum field theory, after subtraction of its local counterterms in a fixed renormalization prescription, decreases monotonically along the renormalization-group (RG) flow. The counterterms fix the required zeros of the subtraction polynomial, but positivity of the spectral data alone does not determine monotonicity. For Gaussian determinants, complete monotonicity of a rescaled integrated heat trace is sufficient. This condition proves monotonicity for Robin boundary flows on every sphere $S^p$, $p\ge2$. A related identity proves monotonicity for massive Dirac fields on odd spheres $S^d$, $d\ge3$. Conversely, under the stated endpoint and decay assumptions, an approach to the infrared value from below excludes every endpoint-preserving finite polynomial subtraction. For the double-trace families considered here, driven by $\mathcal O^2$ on spherical surface defects and, at leading order in large $N$, on $S^3$, a monotone subtraction exists exactly when the dimension of $\mathcal O$ is at least $1/2$ and $(3-\sqrt{37/13})/2$, respectively. Below these thresholds no subtraction is monotone, although the spectra remain positive. The same determinants describe double-trace boundary flows of a free massive scalar in AdS$_3$ and AdS$_4$, where the classifications carry over. Finally, with contact terms fixed, the leading infrared sphere coefficient of a flow from a three-dimensional conformal field theory to a gapped phase is proportional to a difference of nonnegative stress-tensor spectral moments. In the massive critical $O(N)$ model this difference vanishes at leading order and is negative at order $N^0$.

A Horizon-to-Boundary Dictionary Linking Smooth Horizon Continuation, Pole-Skipping, and $SL(2,\mathbb R)$ Lowest-Weight Structure

Yoon-Seok Choun, Ki-Seok Kim · hep-th · v5 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们研究 JT/AdS2 黑洞背景中标量场的极点跳越。先前工作建立了局域机制：在极点跳越点，近视界递推关系退化，并留下一个额外正规展开系数未定。我们以这种局域退化为起点，追踪两个在 AdS 边界归一化的独立解，分别记为 R1 和 R2，对应源支和响应支。令 \widehat A 和 \widehat B 表示去掉共同奇异因子后的源系数和响应系数，并令 \chi_\mu 表示普适入射视界因子。我们发现 \[ \widehat A=0 \Longleftrightarrow \frac{R_2}{\chi_\mu}\in C^\infty, \qquad \widehat B=0 \Longleftrightarrow \frac{R_1}{\chi_\mu}\in C^\infty . \] 因此，源零点和响应零点分别对应去掉入射因子后两个边界归一化解的视界光滑性。在整数共振处，局域正规解包含一个额外系数 a_N。在 JT/AdS2 模型中，非共振入射解的延拓固定 a_N=0，从而在共振处选出唯一推迟值，尽管参数空间中的无限制趋近仍路径依赖。在极点跳越格点的端点，响应支是背景 SL(2,R) 对称性的最低权态。一个静态全息超导例子进一步表明，如果两个边界支线性相关，同时的视界光滑性并不充分。因此，双支极点-零点相交要求 \[ W[R_1,R_2]\neq0. \] 这些结果将已知的局域视界退化与边界支及共振视界解空间之间的整体关系区分开来。

English: We study pole-skipping for a scalar field in the JT/AdS$_2$ black-hole background. Previous work established the local mechanism: at a pole-skipping point, a near-horizon recurrence relation becomes degenerate and an additional regular expansion coefficient is left undetermined. We take this local degeneracy as the starting point and track two independent solutions normalized at the AdS boundary, denoted by $R_1$ and $R_2$ for the source and response branches, respectively. Let $\widehat A$ and $\widehat B$ denote the source and response coefficients after their common singular factor is removed, and let $\chi_\mu$ denote the universal ingoing horizon factor. We find \[ \widehat A=0 \Longleftrightarrow \frac{R_2}{\chi_\mu}\in C^\infty, \qquad \widehat B=0 \Longleftrightarrow \frac{R_1}{\chi_\mu}\in C^\infty . \] Thus the source and response zeros correspond separately to horizon smoothness of the two boundary-normalized solutions after the ingoing factor is removed. At integer resonance the local regular solution contains an additional coefficient $a_N$. In the JT/AdS$_2$ model, continuation of the nonresonant ingoing solution fixes $a_N=0$ and thereby selects a unique retarded value at resonance, although unrestricted approaches in parameter space remain path dependent. At the endpoint of the pole-skipping lattice, the response branch is a lowest-weight state of the background $SL(2,\mathbb R)$ symmetry. A static holographic-superconductor example further shows that simultaneous horizon smoothness is insufficient if the two boundary branches are linearly dependent. A two-branch pole-zero intersection therefore requires \[ W[R_1,R_2]\neq0. \] These results distinguish the known local horizon degeneracy from the global relation between boundary branches and the resonant horizon solution space.

一句话导读：在 JT/AdS2 黑洞中，极点跳越的源/响应零点对应去入射因子后边界归一化解的光滑性；共振需非零 Wronskian，端点响应支为 SL(2,R) 最低权态。

八维爱因斯坦引力的共形重整化

Conformal Renormalisation of 8D Einstein Gravity

Giorgos Anastasiou, Ignacio J. Araya, Nicolas Boulanger, Rodrigo Olea, Davide Rovere · hep-th, gr-qc, math.DG · v2 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们证明，八维中的全息重整化（HR）被编码在唯一一个允许具有常负曲率的爱因斯坦扇区的共形引力理论中。我们明确地将 HR 与拓扑正规化（TR）联系起来；后者规定在 Einstein-Hilbert 拉氏密度中加入 Euler 项，并取一个精确系数，以确保所得密度是反 de Sitter（AdS）曲率的多项式。该多项式仍然是渐近发散的。我们发现，上述八维中唯一的共形引力作用量再现了该多项式，并附带额外的边界项，这些边界项抵消了作用量中的发散项。我们猜想，在任意偶数维中，HR 等价于用负宇宙学常数对 Einstein-Hilbert 作用量做共形完备化，再加上由 TR 规定的固定耦合的 Euler 项。

English: We show that Holographic Renormalisation (HR) in eight dimensions is encoded in the unique conformal gravity theory that admits an Einstein sector with constant negative curvature. We explicitly relate HR to Topological Regularisation (TR), where the latter prescribes to add the Euler term to the Einstein-Hilbert Lagrangian density, with a precise coefficient so as to ensure that the resulting density is polynomial in the anti de Sitter (AdS) curvature. The polynomial is still asymptotically divergent. We find that the aforementioned, unique conformal gravity action in 8D, reproduces the polynomial, together with extra boundary terms that cancel the divergent terms in the action. We conjecture that, in arbitrary even dimension, HR is equivalent to conformally completing the Einstein-Hilbert action with negative cosmological constant, plus the Euler term with fixed coupling prescribed by TR.

一句话导读：八维全息重整化可由唯一共形引力作用量编码，并与引入 Euler 项的拓扑正规化等价；作者猜想该等价性推广到任意偶数维。

相关度：medium — 论文属于全息重整化与 AdS/CFT 字典的形式方法，主要涉及经典引力作用量的共形完备化与拓扑正规化，与用户重点标签中的经典引力/广义相对论支线有形式上的关联，但不涉及全息超导、相变、QNM、探针膜等具体支线。

O(G^4) 的引力波散射：Murua 构造与椭圆函数

Gravitational wave scattering at $\mathcal{O}(G^4)$: Murua construction and elliptics

Yilber Fabian Bautista, Mathias Driesse, Kays Haddad, Gustav Uhre Jakobsen · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们使用世界线量子场论形式，计算了引力波被无自旋点粒子散射的振幅至牛顿常数四阶。对主积分的分解引入 Murua 系数，使我们能够完全绕过将散射振幅转换为 Magnusian 所需的割线减除；后者在分波空间中直接对应散射相移。在此阶次，该过程的动量空间首次出现椭圆函数。为了与黑洞微扰论给出的相移比较，我们提出一种解析方法，可将新的椭圆扇区投影到任意分波阶 ℓ，并验证 Magnusian 与相移的等价性。这表明点粒子世界线量子场论在 O(G^4) 以内准确描述 Schwarzschild 黑洞。

English: We compute the amplitude for the scattering of a gravitational wave off of a spinless point particle at fourth order in Newton's constant, using the worldline quantum field theory formalism. A decomposition of our master integrals incorporating Murua coefficients allows us to entirely bypass the cut subtraction needed to convert the scattering amplitude into the Magnusian, the latter mapping directly onto the scattering phase shift in partial wave space. Elliptic functions appear in momentum space for the first time for this process at this order. To compare to the phase shift from black hole perturbation theory, we present an analytical method for performing the partial wave projection of the new elliptic sector to any partial wave order $\ell$, and verify the equivalence of the Magnusian and the phase shift. This demonstrates that point-particle worldline quantum field theory accurately describes Schwarzschild black holes up to $\mathcal{O}(G^4)$.

一句话导读：在 O(G^4) 用世界线量子场论计算引力波-点粒子散射，并证明其结果与 Schwarzschild 黑洞微扰论相移一致。

从 CFT 得到精确且有限的 de Sitter QFT

Exact and Finite de Sitter QFT from CFT

Haitang Yang · hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：与 \cite{Yang:2026AdS} 中的 AdS Scale-Space 构造平行，我们直接从 d 维 CFT 数据构造 (d+1) 维 de Sitter QFT。dS 几何是有向球的模空间，提升算符通过共形族 Casimir 完备化得到。欧几里得母 CFT 给出有限的波函数表示，而 Minkowski 母 CFT 给出双时间表示，该表示在母时间极化下是酉的。这为重新审视 dS 和双时间 QFT 的疑难提供了一个基于 CFT 的框架。

English: Parallel to the AdS Scale-Space construction in \cite{Yang:2026AdS}, we construct a $(d+1)$-dimensional de Sitter QFT directly from $d$-dimensional CFT data. The dS geometry is the moduli space of oriented balls, and the lifted operators are obtained by conformal-family Casimir completion. The Euclidean parent CFT gives a finite wavefunction representation, while the Minkowski parent CFT gives a double-time representation that is unitary in the parent-time polarization. This provides a CFT-based framework for reexamining puzzles of dS and double-time QFT.

一句话导读：从 d 维 CFT 数据构造出精确且有限的 (d+1) 维 de Sitter QFT，并给出欧几里得与 Minkowski 母 CFT 的表示。

态依赖的原面积何时定义一个体几何？

When does a state-dependent proto-area define a bulk geometry?

Ruiliang Li · hep-th, math-ph, math.MP, quant-ph · v3 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：全息码为每个边界区域赋予一个态依赖的熵余项，但这些余项不必是任何一个体度规的极值长度。我们针对校准恢复的原面积研究这一同源问题，即边界区域的熵减去从该区域恢复出的物质的熵。在第零阶，参考值必须在固定重整化方案下与一个参考几何的长度匹配，这种匹配也决定了熵-长度因子。在具有固定最小割腔的图上，数据导数必须位于割关联矩阵的像中，其左零向量是见证。在双曲圆盘上，重整化长度的第一变分是秩二测地 X 射线变换，在一个适配数据空间中具有闭值域，而由受迫 Jacobi 方程确定的测地位移在二阶进入。由此得到的法向 Hessian 给出一个规范不变的判据，对于一对正则响应系数是否来自一个度规二喷流是充分必要的。对于由边界重参数化生成的常曲率族，Hessian 具有非零的秩四模，因此长度映射的像是弯曲的。对于固定恢复，原面积 Hessian 是恢复中丢失的 Bogoliubov-Kubo-Mori 信息的负值；Petz 映射在乘积参考处正交分解该信息；在具有正最小保留比例的有限维逻辑方向空间上，它至多是保留信息的一个尖锐倍数。几何实现要求这种损失在每个区间上重现法向长度 Hessian。两个码表明，精确的区域面积算符可能无法缝合成一个图几何，并且一个第一响应为零的匹配参考可能在二阶失效。所有判据都涉及一个恢复分支和一个极值面分支。

English: A holographic code assigns a state-dependent entropy remainder to every boundary region, but such remainders need not be the extremal lengths of any one bulk metric. We study this common-source question for the proto-area of a calibrated recovery, the entropy of a boundary region minus that of the matter recovered from it. At zeroth order the reference values must match the lengths of one reference geometry in a fixed renormalization scheme, and this matching also determines the entropy-to-length factor. On a graph with a fixed minimum-cut chamber the data derivatives must lie in the image of the cut-incidence matrix, whose left null vectors are witnesses. On the hyperbolic disk the first variation of renormalized length is the rank-two geodesic X-ray transform, with closed range in an adapted data space, and the geodesic displacement, fixed by a forced Jacobi equation, enters at second order. The resulting normal Hessian gives a gauge-invariant criterion, necessary and sufficient, for a regular pair of response coefficients to come from one metric two-jet. For the constant-curvature family generated by a boundary reparametrization the Hessian has a nonzero rank-four mode, so the image of the length map is curved. For a fixed recovery the proto-area Hessian is minus the Bogoliubov-Kubo-Mori information lost in recovery, which the Petz map decomposes orthogonally at a product reference, and which, on a finite-dimensional space of logical directions with positive minimum retained fraction, is at most a sharp multiple of the retained information. Geometric realization requires this loss to reproduce the normal length Hessian on every interval. Two codes show that exact regional area operators can fail to sew into one graph geometry, and that a matched reference with vanishing first response can fail at second order. All criteria refer to one recovery branch and one extremal-surface branch.

一句话导读：该文给出全息码中态依赖熵余项/原面积能否由单一整体几何实现的判据，并分析图与双曲圆盘上的必要充分条件及信息损失障碍。

破坏平移对称性背景中的全息重夸克势、自由能与跑动耦合：区分有限密度与动量弛豫

Holographic heavy quark potential, free energy, and running coupling in backgrounds with broken translational symmetry: Separating finite density from momentum relaxation

Wenxing Cheng, Yunxianghui Wang, Zi-qiang Zhang · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们研究了重夸克观测量，即静态夸克间势、热自由能和跑动耦合，在五维渐近反德西特（AdS）且平移对称性破缺的时空中。Einstein-Maxwell-axion（EMa）几何包含两个独立标度：控制有限重子密度的化学势 μ，以及控制动量弛豫的平移对称性破缺参数 β。利用有限温度和零温度下的高精度数值计算，我们表明两个标度都会削弱色相互作用并促进强耦合夸克胶子等离子体中的夸克偶素解离，尽管其底层机制不同。化学势主导色屏蔽，并强烈修改重夸克势和跑动耦合，而 β 主要改变等离子体熵，因此给出热自由能的主要修正。在零温度下，热贡献消失，重整化自由能约化为受介质修正的静态势，其形式近似库仑型。在所有温度下，有限重子密度对夸克-反夸克（Q\bar{Q}）对束缚的压制都比动量弛豫强得多。我们提取色屏蔽长度和解离标度，并讨论对重离子碰撞中夸克偶素产生的意义。这些结果表明，静态色相互作用和热力学观测量由不同的介质标度控制，这为稠密耗散等离子体中的重夸克探针提供了一个统一图像。

English: We study heavy quark observables, namely the static interquark potential, the thermal free energy, and the running coupling, in a five dimensional asymptotically anti-de Sitter (AdS) spacetime with broken translational symmetry. The Einstein-Maxwell-axion (EMa) geometry contains two independent scales: the chemical potential $\mu$, which controls finite baryon density, and the translational symmetry breaking parameter $\beta$, which controls momentum relaxation. Using high precision numerical calculations at finite temperature and at zero temperature, we show that both scales weaken color interactions and promote quarkonium dissociation in a strongly coupled quark gluon plasma, although the underlying mechanisms differ. The chemical potential dominates color screening and strongly modifies the heavy quark potential and running coupling, whereas $\beta$ mainly changes the plasma entropy and therefore gives the leading correction to the thermal free energy. At zero temperature, thermal contributions vanish and the renormalized free energy reduces to a static potential modified by the medium, with an approximately Coulombic form. At all temperatures, a finite baryon density suppresses the binding of quark antiquark ($Q\bar{Q}$) pairs much more strongly than momentum relaxation. We extract the color screening length and dissociation scale, and discuss implications for quarkonium production in heavy ion collisions. These results show that static color interactions and thermodynamic observables are controlled by different medium scales, which offers a unified picture of heavy quark probes in dense dissipative plasmas.

一句话导读：在带平移对称性破缺的全息 EMa 背景中，化学势主导色屏蔽，而 β 主要通过熵修正自由能，两者均促进夸克偶素解离。

有效场论中五维黑弦的非线性演化

Non-linear evolution of five-dimensional black strings in effective field theory

Pau Figueras, \'Aron D. Kov\'acs, Shunhui Yao · hep-th, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们使用数值相对论研究 Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet 引力中五维黑弦的非线性不稳定性。黑弦演化为由更细的弦状片段连接的一系列黑洞，但动力学的关键特征取决于 Gauss-Bonnet 耦合的符号。对于正耦合（紫外考虑所偏好），曲率不变量的增长在有效场论（EFT）有效范围内受到限制，暗示了一种恢复弱宇宙监督的机制。对于负耦合，这一上限不存在，曲率可能增长直到 EFT 失效。

English: We use numerical relativity to study the non-linear instability of five-dimensional black strings in Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet gravity. Black strings evolve into a series of black holes joined by thinner string-like segments, but key features of the dynamics depend on the sign of the Gauss-Bonnet coupling. For positive coupling, favored by UV considerations, the growth of curvature invariants is limited within the validity of effective field theory (EFT), suggesting a mechanism for restoring weak cosmic censorship. For negative coupling this cap is absent and curvatures may grow until the EFT breaks down.

一句话导读：五维 Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet 黑弦的数值相对论演化表明，正耦合可在 EFT 范围内限制曲率增长并可能恢复弱宇宙监督，负耦合则无此上限。

三维带量子修正的黑洞：以 Lindblad 中的 Page 曲线、灰体因子和 Lyapunov 指数为例

Black holes with quantum corrections in $3d$: The case of Page curve in Lindblad, greybody factor, and Lyapunov exponent

Mahdis Ghodrati · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：在这项工作中，我们首先把带有量子修正的黑洞作为开放量子系统来讨论，并应用 Lindblad 形式来解释 Hawking-Page 曲线和辐射过程中的“zig-zag”行为，特别考虑例外点的效应。然后，我们计算了三维 Cotler-Jensen 理论（带重参数化模式的 AdS3）中各种参数的量子修正。在每一步计算中，我们将结果与 JT 情形进行比较。接着，我们计算了各种黑洞解、特别是 Cotler-Jensen 理论情形的量子修正灰体因子。最后，我们研究量子修正对 Lyapunov 指数、势以及黑洞量子信息结构的影响。

English: In this work, first we discuss black holes with quantum corrections as an open quantum system and apply Lindblad formalism to explain the ``zig-zag" behavior in the Hawking- Page curve and radiation process, specially by considering the effects of exceptional points. Then, we calculate quantum corrections for various parameters of $3d$ Cotler-Jensen theory which is $\text{AdS}_3$ with reparametrized modes. At each step of the calculations, we compare the results with the case of JT. We then calculate quantum-corrected greybody factor for various black hole solutions, and specially for the case of Cotler-Jensen theory. Finally, we study the effects of quantum corrections on Lyapunov exponent, potential, and quantum information structure of black holes.

一句话导读：研究三维量子修正黑洞作为开放量子系统，并用 Lindblad 形式、Cotler-Jensen 理论及与 JT 的对比分析 Page 曲线、灰体因子与 Lyapunov 指数。

AdS/CFT 中的精确全息运动学

Exact Holographic Kinematics in AdS/CFT

Haitang Yang · hep-th, gr-qc, hep-ph · v2 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们提出全息包含一个精确的运动学扇区，区别于全息动力学。该扇区的合适背景是 Weyl 框架中开实心环面上的 CFT。开实心环面引入内禀尺度，Weyl 框架使该尺度表现为额外体方向。由此得到的体-边对是精确且有限的：不需要截断、大 N 极限、强耦合假设或重算子近似。这个扇区中出现的 AdS 几何应被理解为运动学几何；只有在特殊 CFT 和适当极限下才提升为动力学半经典体。标准边界锚定字典条目仅作为奇异极限恢复。作为一个显著演示，我们展示 Weyl 框架两点函数给出无需 replica 的纠缠熵定义。

English: We propose that holography contains an exact kinematic sector distinct from holographic dynamics. The appropriate setting for this sector is a CFT on an open solid torus in the Weyl frame. The open solid torus introduces an intrinsic scale, and the Weyl frame makes this scale manifest as an extra bulk direction. The resulting bulk-boundary pairs are exact and finite: no cutoff, large-$N$ limit, strong-coupling assumption, or heavy-operator approximation is required. The AdS geometry appearing in this sector should be understood as a kinematic geometry; only in special CFTs and appropriate limits is it promoted to a dynamical semiclassical bulk. The standard boundary-anchored dictionary entries are recovered only as singular limits. As a striking demonstration, we show that Weyl-frame two-point functions provide a replica-free definition of entanglement entropy.

English: This work investigates the relevance of Euclidean and complex axion wormholes to the AdS/CFT factorization problem. We use a framework that defines bulk gravitational path integrals by integrating over a real Lorentz-signature contour and then, as needed, perhaps further analytically continuing the resulting functions of boundary conditions. For technical reasons we focus on the case of 2+1 bulk dimensions. The AdS boundary conditions (in any dimension) require us to impose Dirichlet boundary conditions on the standard Euclidean axion $\chi_E$. Fixing its asymptotic values on two boundary spheres to $\pm \chi_{E,\infty}$, we find such wormholes to be subdominant to a UV-sensitive endpoint contribution for $\chi_{E, \infty}$ near the real axis, and that (with our conventions) they become dominant only for $\chi_{E, \infty}$ near the negative imgainary axis. Furthermore, such wormholes are irrelevant to our computation for ${\rm Im} \chi_{E, \infty} >0$ (in the sense that the associated ascent contour fails to intersect the contour of integration). The relevance of the wormhole saddle for real positive $\chi_{E, \infty}$ is in fact a matter of choice, as the saddle then lies on a Stokes' line at which the relevant intersection number changes from zero to one.

中文摘要：我们为自旋网络引入一种受张量网络构造启发的富化纠缠结构，其中内部链接可以携带受控且离散的纠缠量。在自旋网络图景中，顶点对偶于单形（更一般地，对偶于多面体），链接对偶于它们的面。标准自旋网络粘合对应于沿一个面完全识别两个单形，由相应链接上的最大纠缠、规范不变的单态实现，而未粘合的面则对应于不携带纠缠的链接。在完全图上工作时，我们通过允许每条链接携带可变纠缠量，将这一二元选择提升为受控且可调的结构，在乘积态与完全纠缠单态之间插值。因此，附加链接变量不仅控制纠缠量，还控制内部链接处规范不变性被保持或破坏的程度，可解释为涌现的边缘模类自由度。在此框架内，自旋网络收缩定义了一个从链接纠缠数据到边界态的体-边界映射。借鉴随机张量网络中发展的技术，我们证明在合适的大自旋区域，该映射在期望值意义下是余等距的，即其伴随在平均意义上保持边界内积，至多相差整体标度因子。限制到由链接有效粘合或打开、并带有围绕此模式的小涨落的构型所定义的码子空间，该映射成为等距映射，修正项在大自旋极限下消失。这在自旋网络希尔伯特空间内给出了全息与纠错特征的离散且具有几何意义的实现。

English: We introduce an enriched entanglement structure for spin networks, inspired by tensor-network constructions, in which internal links can carry a controlled and discrete amount of entanglement. In the spin-network picture, vertices are dual to simplices (more generally, to polyhedra) and links are dual to their faces. Standard spin-network gluing corresponds to fully identifying two simplices along a face, implemented by a maximally entangled, gauge-invariant singlet state on the corresponding link, while unglued faces correspond to links carrying no entanglement. Working on a complete graph, we promote this binary choice to a controlled and tunable structure by allowing each link to carry a variable amount of entanglement, interpolating between product states and the fully entangled singlet. The additional link variables therefore control not only the amount of entanglement but also the extent to which gauge invariance at internal links is preserved or broken, admitting an interpretation in terms of emergent edge-mode-like degrees of freedom. Within this framework, spin-network contraction defines a bulk-to-boundary map from link-entanglement data to boundary states. Adapting techniques developed in random tensor networks, we show that in a suitable large-spin regime the map is a co-isometry in expectation value, meaning that its adjoint preserves boundary inner products on average, up to the overall scale. Restricting to a code subspace defined by configurations in which links are either effectively glued or open, with small fluctuations around this pattern, the map becomes an isometry up to corrections that vanish in the large-spin limit. This yields a discrete and geometrically meaningful realization of holographic and error-correcting features within the spin-network Hilbert space.

English: Motivated by the pseudo-entropy program, we study timelike subregion complexity within the holographic Complexity=Volume framework, extending previous spatial constructions to Lorentzian boundary intervals. We generalize the analysis to AdS black brane geometries, where the extremal-surface configurations considered may either remain outside the horizon or penetrate it, with the horizon-to-turning-point segment being timelike in the exterior case and spacelike in the interior case. In both configurations, the complexity exhibits the same leading UV-divergence structure as the spacelike case and receives no imaginary contribution when the horizon terms are combined with a common regulator. This reality contrasts with the potentially complex-valued pseudo-entropy and reflects the chosen Lorentzian volume prescription, while a precise boundary interpretation of the proposed complexity remains conjectural.

中文摘要：给定两个原本解耦且具有共同（有限）对称子范畴的 D 维共形场论（CFT），可以考虑其 (D+1) 维 SymTFT 的纠缠边界态。这大致对应于对两个 CFT 的张量积进行规范操作（gauging），我们称此现象为“SymTFT 纠缠”（简称“S-纠缠”）。当这些 CFT 具有半经典全息对偶时，S-纠缠将两个原本不相连的反德西特（AdS）时空中的体规范荷联系起来，我们在若干自顶向下的例子中强调这一点。我们表明，对此类 S-纠缠态取偏迹可得到一种在弦论中制备系综平均 CFT 的简洁方法。该系综平均与婴儿宇宙希尔伯特空间中由 α-态产生的平均一致，我们提出通过广义整体对称性对该希尔伯特空间作对称性增强的推广。我们定量说明这种由对称性支配的平均如何破坏全息因子化，并导致体整体对称性的涌现。我们还考虑永恒（双侧）AdS 黑洞几何；我们的 SymTFT 纠缠讨论意味着通常的热场二重态制备存在若干精细化。我们表明，可以将系统制备成总 CFT 数据不因子化为左右两份的方式。正如 Marolf 和 Wall 所预期，我们强调此类考虑对于定义永恒黑洞的规范荷是必要的，并且在某些情形下可意味着存在横跨虫洞的延展体对象，而它们不能表示为左右 CFT 算符的乘积。

English: Given two otherwise decoupled $D$-dimensional CFTs which possess a common (finite) symmetry subcategory, one can consider entangled boundary states of their $(D+1)$-dimensional SymTFTs. This roughly corresponds to performing a gauging of the tensor product of two CFTs, and we call this phenomena ``SymTFT entanglement" (or ``S-entanglement" for short). In the case when these CFTs have semiclassical holographic duals, the S-entanglement relates the bulk gauge charges between two otherwise disconnected AdS spacetimes as we highlight in several top-down examples. We show that taking partial traces of such S-entangled states leads to a streamlined approach to preparing ensemble-averaged CFTs in string theory. This ensemble averaging coincides with that generated by $\alpha$-states in the baby universe Hilbert space, and we propose a symmetry-enriched generalization of this Hilbert space via generalized global symmetries. We quantify how this symmetry-governed averaging violates holographic factorization and leads to the emergence of bulk global symmetries. We also consider the eternal (two-sided) AdS black hole geometries, where our SymTFT entanglement considerations imply that there exist refinements of the usual theromofield double state preparation of the system. We show that one may prepare the system in such a way that the total CFT data does not factorize into left and right copies. As anticipated by Marolf and Wall \cite{Marolf:2012xe}, we highlight that such considerations are necessary to define the gauge charges of eternal black holes, and in certain cases, can imply that there exist extended bulk objects stretching across the wormhole which cannot be expressed in terms of a product of left and right CFT operators.

Gabriel Luz Almeida · gr-qc, hep-ph, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：当辐射从其源的质单极场散射两次时，会出现引力 tail-of-tail 修正。在多极有效场论中，贡献于此过程的两圈拓扑之一涉及真正耦合的圈动量，无法通过嵌套的一圈积分来计算。经过张量约化，这种非因子化结构导致一族特别困难的标量积分，且随着多极阶数升高，分子幂次无界。我们对整个相关整数分子域推导出精确闭式表达式，适用于一般维度，并通过一致的解析延拓相容 Feynman、推迟和超前 prescription。在 d=3+ε 附近，我们还得到至 O(ε) 的显式 Laurent 展开，保留了高阶辐射计算所需的次领头信息。虽然这些展开确定维度极点，但要识别其紫外（UV）或红外（IR）起源，需要另外分析动量区域。我们在整个积分域进行该分析，并直接应用于任意电、磁多极的耦合 tail-of-tail 发射图。由此，我们独立确定 UV 与 IR 留数，并显式验证完整的红外极点结构（包括双极点和单极点）与一圈引力 tail 的指数化一致。将硬动量区域直接算得的 UV 留数与其余图的已知贡献结合，可重现已建立的多极反常维度。

English: Gravitational tail-of-tail corrections arise when radiation scatters twice from the mass-monopole field of its source. In the multipolar effective field theory, one of the two-loop topologies contributing to this process involves genuinely coupled loop momenta, preventing its evaluation through nested one-loop integrations. After tensor reduction, this nonfactorizing structure leads to a particularly challenging family of scalar integrals with unbounded numerator powers as the multipole rank increases. We derive exact closed-form expressions for the entire relevant integer numerator domain, valid in generic dimension and accommodating Feynman, retarded, and advanced prescriptions through consistent analytic continuation. Near $d=3+\epsilon$, we also obtain explicit Laurent expansions through $O(\epsilon)$, retaining the subleading information needed in higher-order radiative calculations. While these expansions determine the dimensional poles, identifying their ultraviolet (UV) or infrared (IR) origin requires a separate analysis of momentum regions. We carry out this analysis throughout the integral domain and apply it directly to the coupled tail-of-tail emission diagram for arbitrary electric and magnetic multipoles. In this way, we independently determine the UV and IR residues, and explicitly verify that the complete infrared pole structure, including both double and simple poles, agrees with the exponentiation of the one-loop gravitational tail. The UV residues, calculated directly from hard-momentum regions, reproduce the established multipole anomalous dimensions when combined with the known contributions of the remaining diagrams.

Linear Response to Black Hole Deformations

Stefan Hohenegger · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：超越真空广义相对论的引力修正会对黑洞周围物理产生微妙影响。然而，在不同观测量中描述这些效应先验地强烈依赖于具体模型。几何的有效描述能高效捕捉相对基准预测的偏离，但有时缺少通向（有效）新物理的清晰途径。受线性响应理论启发，本文提出一种形式体系，可计算相对于 Schwarzschild 黑洞、在时空中（视界外）任意位置的观测量的领头修正：修正阶数由 Einstein 张量的本征值 E 固定，该本征值被等同于产生几何形变的外部能动张量。这样，E 就可以联系到有效物理模型。作者聚焦球对称静态黑洞，并用视界附近的一系列观测量说明该方法，例如绕黑洞运动粒子的特征量（如黑洞阴影或最内稳定圆轨道半径），或标量准正规模谱。反过来，作者认为这些观测量的知识会对 E 给出非平凡约束，从而提供关于黑洞附近有效物理的洞见。

English: Modifications of gravity beyond (vacuum) General Relativity have a subtle impact on the physics around black holes. Describing these effects across different observables is, however, a priori strongly model dependent. While effective descriptions of the geometry allow to efficiently capture deviations from benchmark predictions, they sometimes lack a clear passage towards (effective) new physics. Inspired by linear response theory, in this work I therefore propose a formalism that allows to calculate leading corrections of observables relative to the Schwarzschild black hole anywhere in space-time (outside of the horizon): the order of corrections is fixed through an eigenvalue $\mathcal{E}$ of the Einstein tensor, which is identified with an external energy momentum tensor that generates the deformation of the geometry. In this ways, $\mathcal{E}$ can be linked to effective physics models. Focusing on spherically symmetric and static black holes, I illustrate the approach at the hand of a number of observables in the vicinity of the horizon, such as characteristic quantities of particles moving around the black hole (e.g. the black hole shadow or the radius of the innermost stable circular orbit) or the spectrum of scalar quasi-normal modes. Reversing the logic, I argue that the knowledge of such observables provides non-trivial constraints on $\mathcal{E}$, which in turn grant insights into the effective physics in the vicinity of the black hole.

一句话导读：提出用 Einstein 张量本征值刻画黑洞形变，并通过阴影、ISCO、标量 QNM 等观测量约束有效新物理。

相关度：medium — 与经典引力/QNM/黑洞形变重点标签直接相关，但不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶。

Kerr-Newman 黑洞洛夫数的消失

Vanishing Love Numbers of Kerr-Newman Black Holes

Sumanta Chakraborty, Takuya Katagiri, Paolo Pani, Jun-Xi Shi · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：潮汐洛夫数刻画致密天体对外部扰动的保守响应，是探测其本质的有力工具。尽管 Schwarzschild、Kerr 和 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞的静态洛夫数显著为零，一般 Kerr-Newman 黑洞的潮汐响应由于引力与电磁扰动之间的内禀耦合一直未被探索。利用这些扰动可分离性方面的最新突破，我们解析地确定了四维 Einstein-Maxwell 理论中最一般稳态黑洞的静态潮汐响应。对于任意多极阶、电荷和自旋，我们证明了整个守恒洛夫数矩阵为零，包括混合的引力-电磁耦合。我们还计算了由参考系拖曳引起的非零静态耗散响应。

English: Tidal Love numbers characterize the conservative response of compact objects to external perturbations and provide a powerful probe of their nature. While the static Love numbers of Schwarzschild, Kerr, and Reissner--Nordstr\"om black holes remarkably vanish, the tidal response of a generic Kerr--Newman black hole has remained unexplored due to the intrinsic coupling between gravitational and electromagnetic perturbations. Exploiting a recent breakthrough in the separability of these perturbations, we analytically determine the static tidal response of the most general stationary black hole in four-dimensional Einstein--Maxwell theory. For arbitrary multipole order, charge, and spin, we show that the entire matrix of conservative Love numbers vanishes, including the mixed gravito-electromagnetic couplings. We also compute the nonvanishing static dissipative response induced by frame dragging.

一句话导读：利用引力-电磁扰动可分离性，证明一般 Kerr-Newman 黑洞的所有静态守恒洛夫数（包括混合引力-电磁耦合）为零，并给出参考系拖曳导致的静态耗散响应。

Palatini 引力中的共形耦合在哪里？

Where is the conformal coupling in Palatini gravity?

Alexandros Karam, Sotirios Karamitsos · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们研究无挠 Palatini 表述中、标量具有普通动能项时的共形耦合。调整曲率耦合不能恢复 Weyl 不变性：在独立且惰性的联络下，标量-曲率项本身是 Weyl 不变的，因此没有有限的曲率耦合可以抵消动能项的 Weyl 变分。这一点可通过在标量运动方程上计算能动张量迹来证明，该迹显式不依赖于 Palatini 耦合。消去联络后，我们构造了曲率耦合与等效度规理论有效耦合之间的映射，并表明即使约化动能系数为零，标量仍会传播。我们还表明，只有在重标度的无穷大耦合极限下，它才成为具有标度不变势的 Weyl 补偿子；在四维中，这与 Palatini R^2 引力直接相关。我们计算了一圈耦合跑动，发现在度规-曲率耦合 beta 函数中的共形移动会在固定度规-仿射背景上产生度规-曲率耦合，而独立曲率耦合则均匀跑动。此外，我们遵循另一种规定，即允许联络响应标量涨落，这导致不同的标量 Hessian，因此 beta 函数不同。尽管如此，我们发现，在正微扰四次耦合情况下，两种规定都通过原始耦合的不同极限，允许形式红外极限 (ξ_eff, λ_eff)→(1/6,0)。最后，我们注意到，从正引力分支出发的轨迹会在该终点之前的有限标度处遇到引力系数消失。

English: We study the conformal coupling in the torsion-free Palatini formulation with an ordinary scalar kinetic term. Tuning the curvature coupling cannot restore Weyl invariance in a Palatini theory with an ordinary scalar kinetic term because, for an independent and inert connection, the scalar-curvature term is separately Weyl-invariant, and no finite curvature coupling cancels the Weyl variation of the kinetic term. This can be demonstrated by evaluating the energy-momentum trace on the scalar equation of motion and noting that it is explicitly independent of the Palatini coupling. Eliminating the connection, we construct a map between the curvature coupling and the effective coupling for the equivalent metric theory, and demonstrate that the scalar continues to propagate even if the reduced kinetic coefficient vanishes. We also show that it becomes a Weyl compensator with a scale-invariant potential only in the rescaled infinite-coupling limit, which in four dimensions is directly related to Palatini ${\cal R}^2$ gravity. We calculate the running of the couplings at one loop, and we find that the conformal shift in the metric-curvature coupling's beta function generates a metric-curvature coupling on a fixed metric-affine background, whereas the independent-curvature coupling runs homogeneously. Furthermore, we follow an alternate prescription in which the connection is allowed to respond to the scalar fluctuations, which results in a different scalar Hessian and therefore different beta functions. Nonetheless, we find that both prescriptions admit the formal infrared limit $(\xi_{eff},\lambda_{eff})\to(1/6,0)$ through different limits of the original couplings in the case of positive perturbative quartics. Finally, we note that trajectories starting on the positive gravitational branch encounter a vanishing gravitational coefficient at a finite scale before this endpoint.

一句话导读：在无挠 Palatini 引力中，普通标量动能项无法通过调节曲率耦合恢复 Weyl 不变性；文章给出等效度规映射、一圈 beta 函数及红外共形极限。

无校准 DESI DR2 BAO-超新星约束对距离对偶倾斜的敏感性

Sensitivity of calibration-free DESI DR2 BAO--supernova constraints to a distance-duality tilt

St\'ephane Fay, Mikel Artola, Leandros Perivolaropoulos · astro-ph.CO, gr-qc, hep-ph, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：最近来自 DESI 重子声学振荡（BAO）的测量报告了对动力学暗能量的中等偏好，这对标准 ΛCDM 范式构成了挑战。然而，这种趋势也可能反映当前 BAO 与 Ia 型超新星（SN）数据所预言的哈勃图在形状与偏移之间的张力，而该张力可能暗示连接光度距离 D_L 与角直径距离 D_A 的宇宙距离对偶关系（CDDR）存在破缺。我们通过将对该关系的偏离参数化为 η(z) ≡ D_L / [(1+z)^2 D_A] = α(1+z)^ε 来探索这一可能性，并研究一旦允许 ε ≠ 0，对 Chevallier-Polarski-Linder（CPL）动力学暗能量的偏好会如何改变。使用 DESI DR2 与未校准 SN 数据（Pantheon+、DES-Dovekie、Union3 和 Union3.1），我们发现，在 ΛCDM 和 CPL 中允许 ε 自由变化，会使 CPL 相对于 ΛCDM 的偏好降低，其降低幅度大于加入空间曲率 Ω_k；只有 Union3.1 表现出可比程度的降低。我们还发现，这种偏好降低对替代的 η(z) 参数化是稳健的，并且对于 Pantheon+，在移除 BAO 示踪物或低红移截断后，η(z) 约束仍保持稳定；而对于 DES-Dovekie，一旦移除 z < 0.1 的 SN，该偏好便基本消失。在一项单独的校准分析中，示意性的 Planck 声视界与 SH0ES 绝对星等先验给出 α ≈ 0.942 ± 0.014，量化了在这些假设下的归一化失配。我们还将 CDDR 破缺映射到光子损失与变化 G 情景，结论是宇宙学约束远弱于对这些物理机制已有的约束。

English: Recent measurements from DESI baryon acoustic oscillations (BAO) have reported a moderate preference for dynamical dark energy, challenging the standard $\Lambda$CDM paradigm. Nonetheless, such a trend could reflect a tension between the shape and the offset of the Hubble diagrams predicted by current BAO and Type Ia supernovae (SN) data, which may underpin a possible breakdown of the cosmic distance duality relation (CDDR) linking luminosity distances $D_{\rm L}$ and angular-diameter distances $D_{\rm A}$. We explore this possibility by parametrizing deviations from this relation as $\eta(z) \equiv D_{\rm L} / [{(1+z)}^2 D_{\rm A}] = \alpha{(1+z)}^\varepsilon$, and investigate how the preference for a Chevallier-Polarski-Linder (CPL) dynamical dark energy is modified once $\varepsilon \!\neq\! 0$ is allowed. Using DESI DR2 and uncalibrated SN data (Pantheon$+$, DES-Dovekie, Union3, and Union3.1), we find that allowing $\varepsilon$ to vary freely in both $\Lambda$CDM and CPL reduces the CPL preference with respect to $\Lambda$CDM by a larger amount than the addition of spatial curvature $\Omega_k$; only Union3.1 exhibits comparable reductions. We also find that the preference reduction is robust to alternative $\eta(z)$ parametrizations, and that the $\eta(z)$ constraints remain stable under the removal of BAO tracers or low-redshift cutoffs for Pantheon$+$, whereas the DES-Dovekie preference largely disappears once $z < 0.1$ SN are removed. In a separate calibrated analysis, illustrative Planck sound-horizon and SH0ES absolute-magnitude priors give $\alpha \simeq 0.942 \pm 0.014$, quantifying the normalization mismatch under those assumptions. We also map the CDDR violation onto photon-loss and varying-$G$ scenarios, concluding that the cosmological constraints are much weaker than existing constraints on these physical mechanisms.

一句话导读：利用 DESI DR2 与未校准超新星数据检验距离对偶关系偏离如何削弱 CPL 动力学暗能量相对 ΛCDM 的偏好。

广义相对论中的非定常虫洞与物质源重构

Non-Stationary Wormholes and Matter Source Reconstruction in General Relativity

Geov\'a Alencar, Tiago Crispim, Roberta D\'arlla, Ricardo Landim · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们研究嵌入演化宇宙学背景中的广义相对论非定常虫洞几何。我们采用类似 Simpson-Visser 的时间坐标正则化，对 (n+1) 维 FLRW 度规的时间坐标进行处理，并结合均匀 Cuscuton 场，构造标度因子在原本会出现的初始奇点处保持有限且非零的宇宙学背景。随后考虑两种具体动力学虫洞几何：四维缺陷虫洞和拓扑荷 Perry-Mann 型虫洞。我们表明前者可由势为零的正则标量场支撑，而后者需要模仿物质扇区来支撑其空间结构，二者中 Cuscuton 均支配宇宙学演化。然后我们将分析推广到可分离非定常时空，并推导出一个强烈限制可容许物质源的标度条件。特别地，对最小耦合标量场和非线性电动力学场，该条件消除了静态重构方案中存在的函数自由度。我们表明，在此框架内，无法在同时满足所需光滑性和反射对称性条件的情况下获得规则、渐近平坦的虫洞几何。我们的结果既说明在规则宇宙学背景中构造特定非定常虫洞的可能性，也说明将此类构造推广到任意空间几何时出现的限制。

English: We investigate non-stationary wormhole geometries in General Relativity embedded in evolving cosmological backgrounds. We employ a Simpson-Visser-like regularization of the temporal coordinate of the $(n+1)$-dimensional FLRW metric, together with a homogeneous Cuscuton field, to construct cosmological backgrounds in which the scale factor remains finite and non-zero at the would-be initial singularity. We then consider two specific dynamical wormhole geometries: the four-dimensional defect wormhole and the topologically charged Perry-Mann type wormhole. We show that the former can be supported by a canonical scalar field with vanishing potential, while the latter requires a mimetic matter sector to support its spatial structure, with the Cuscuton governing the cosmological evolution in both cases. We subsequently generalize the analysis to a separable non-stationary spacetime and derive a scaling condition that strongly constrains the admissible matter sources. In particular, for minimally coupled scalar and nonlinear electrodynamics fields, this condition removes the functional freedom available in static reconstruction schemes. We show that, within this framework, regular, asymptotically flat wormhole geometries cannot be obtained while simultaneously satisfying the required smoothness and reflection symmetry conditions. Our results illustrate both the possibility of constructing specific non-stationary wormholes in regular cosmological backgrounds and the restrictions that arise when attempting to generalize such constructions to arbitrary spatial geometries.

一句话导读：在广义相对论中构造并限制嵌入规则宇宙学背景的非定常虫洞，并表明向任意空间几何推广会受到物质源标度条件的严格约束。

中文摘要：我们在 Einstein-aether 理论中数值求解了缓慢运动的 Schwarzschild 黑洞解。利用这些解，我们计算了敏感度参数，该参数在点粒子有效理论中描述黑洞与 aether 场的耦合。我们导出了敏感度对 Einstein-aether 参数依赖的简单解析近似。

English: We numerically find the solutions for slowly moving Schwarzschild black holes in Einstein--aether theory. We use these solutions to compute the sensitivity parameter which describes the coupling of the black hole to the aether field within point-particle effective theory. A simple analytic approximation for the dependence of the sensitivity on the Einstein--aether parameters is derived.

dS 中来自 EAdS 圈的晚期电屏蔽

Late-time electric screening in dS from EAdS loops

Ernesto Bianchi, Sacha Ployet, Charlotte Sleight, Massimo Taronna · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们在 dS_{d+1} 上的标量 QED 中，对一般维数和标量质量，利用 in-in 形式的 EAdS 重构（arXiv:2007.09993），解析计算了单圈规范场两点函数。Dirichlet EAdS 规范场获得 Schwinger 型质量，其纵向模式由满足相反边界条件的带电标量复合而成，而 Neumann 模仍受规范不变性保护。在 dS 中，Dirichlet 修正为边界流诱导出反常维度 γ_J，并改变电场的晚期衰减。该体计算复现了 arXiv:2509.18888 的边界多重态重组结果。对 in-in 围道各分支求和给出延迟 dS 气泡核，从而与 Bros-Moschella 框架直接联系。我们建立一条谱 Cutkosky 规则，将该核在 Casimir 平面主系列割线上的不连续性表示为双粒子割，其中两条内标量线均在上壳。虽然完整气泡系数涉及一个 7F6 超几何函数，但该割线坍缩为 Gamma 函数的闭合乘积，并通过色散关系决定核的完整非局域部分。对同一割线作解析延拓可复现 γ_J 的完整单圈结果。在复 Casimir 平面中，圈修正后的 Dirichlet 光子表现为第二叶上的极点，因此自然可解释为一个 dS 共振或准正模，其频率在单圈阶发生移动。

English: We compute the one-loop gauge-field two-point functions analytically in scalar QED on dS$_{d+1}$ for general dimension and scalar mass, using the EAdS reformulation of the in-in formalism arXiv:2007.09993. The Dirichlet EAdS gauge field acquires a Schwinger-type mass, with its longitudinal mode supplied by a composite of charged scalars obeying opposite boundary conditions, while the Neumann mode remains protected by gauge invariance. In dS, the Dirichlet correction induces an anomalous dimension $\gamma_J$ for the boundary current and modifies the late-time falloff of the electric field. This bulk calculation reproduces the boundary multiplet-recombination result of arXiv:2509.18888. Summing over the in-in contour branches gives the retarded dS bubble kernel, making direct contact with the Bros-Moschella framework. We establish a spectral Cutkosky rule that expresses the discontinuity of this kernel across the principal-series cut in the Casimir plane in terms of a two-particle cut, with both internal scalar lines placed on shell. Although the full bubble coefficient involves a ${}_7F_6$ hypergeometric function, the cut collapses to a closed product of Gamma functions and determines the complete non-local part of the kernel through a dispersion relation. Analytic continuation of the same cut reproduces the complete one-loop result for $\gamma_J$. In the complex Casimir plane, the loop-corrected Dirichlet photon appears as a pole on the second sheet and is therefore naturally interpreted as a dS resonance, or quasinormal mode, whose frequency is shifted at one loop.

一句话导读：在 dS 标量 QED 中利用 EAdS/in-in 重构完成单圈规范场两点函数，Dirichlet 模给边界流带来反常维度并改变电场晚期行为，圈修正光子表现为 dS 准正模共振。

虚部 HTEE：探测临界性与相干性

Imaginary HTEE: Probing Criticality and Coherence

M. Ali-Akbari, M. M. Daryaei Goki · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：我们研究了带电渐近 AdS5 黑洞背景中全息类时纠缠熵（HTEE）的虚部，该背景的对偶场论在化学势 μ 和温度 T 存在时表现出临界点。通过将 HTEE 的虚部等同于赝熵的虚部，我们推导出该量的解析表达式，并研究了它在稳定和不稳定热力学分支上的行为。我们发现，虚部 HTEE 在无电荷极限下消失，且完全由非零化学势诱导，标志着初态与末态之间量子相干性的出现。当无量纲比值 μ/T 趋近其临界值时，我们得到虚部 HTEE 导数的逆平方根型发散，并解析提取出临界指数 θ_I=1/2。我们进一步表明，同一指数支配固定化学势下的温度响应。我们的结果确立了 HTEE 的虚部作为强耦合系统中临界性的非局域量子信息探针，并意味着初态和末态在临界点处变得最大相干。

English: We study the imaginary part of the holographic timelike entanglement entropy (HTEE) in a charged asymptotically AdS$_5$ black-hole background whose dual field theory exhibits a critical point in the presence of a chemical potential $\mu$ and temperature $T$. Identifying the imaginary part of the HTEE with the imaginary part of the pseudoentropy, we derive an analytical expression for this quantity and investigate its behavior on the stable and unstable thermodynamic branches. We find that the imaginary HTEE vanishes in the uncharged limit and is induced entirely by a nonzero chemical potential, signaling the emergence of quantum coherence between the initial and final states. As the dimensionless ratio $\mu/T$ approaches its critical value, we obtain an inverse-square-root divergence in the derivative of the imaginary HTEE and extract the critical exponent $\theta_I = 1/2$ analytically. We further show that the same exponent governs the temperature response at fixed chemical potential. Our results establish the imaginary part of the HTEE as a non-local quantum-information probe of criticality in strongly coupled systems, and they imply that the initial and final states become maximally coherent at the critical point.

一句话导读：在带电 AdS5 黑洞的全息对偶中，类时纠缠熵的虚部由化学势诱导，并在临界点以 θ_I=1/2 的指数发散，可作为量子相干性的非局域探针。

Namely, it consists of copies of the linear quiver along $x_1$ dual to the U(1)-invariant solutions of the class, one for each interval along $x_2$, with ranks given by the D1 and D5 charges of the corresponding cell. Along $x_2$ we interpret the fundamental strings stretched between the colour branes and the additional D3 and D7 branes as baryon vertices. Finally, we extend this proposal from the non-Abelian T-duals to the solutions of the class whose defining functions factorise in $x_1$ and $x_2$, including those in which the AdS$_2$ and S$^2$ factors have the same warp factor.

中文摘要：我们研究了半BPS表面缺陷对四维和六维SCFT中超对称Casimir能量以及超对称Rényi熵的普适对数项的贡献。利用缺陷反常多项式的等变积分及其到超对称Rényi背景的推广，我们得到这些可观测量用缺陷't Hooft反常表示的闭合表达式。对于四维N=4超Yang-Mills中保持横向旋转的Gukov-Witten缺陷，两个可观测量都依赖于单个R对称反常。对于六维N=(1,0)理论中的N=(0,4)缺陷，额外项来自引力反常。我们提供使用手征代数、五维局域化以及大N全息探针膜的互补检验，而局域手征费米子重现引力反常贡献。该框架也重现六维N=(2,0)理论中的Wilson面结果。

For $\mathcal{N} = (0, 4)$ defects in six-dimensional $\mathcal{N} = (1, 0)$ theories, additional terms arise from the gravitational anomaly. We provide complementary checks using chiral algebras, five-dimensional localization, and holographic probe branes at large $N$, while localized chiral fermions reproduce the gravitational-anomaly contributions. The framework also recovers Wilson-surface results in six-dimensional $\mathcal{N} = (2, 0)$ theories.

English: In this work we construct three-dimensional Chern--Simons gravity theories for the six resonant $JPZ$ algebras generated by the Lorentz generators $J_a$, translations $P_a$, and an additional Lorentz-like generator $Z_a$. Our main result is that three of them, $B_4$, $\widetilde C_4$, and $C_4$, are isomorphic to $iso(2,1)\oplus so(2,1)$, although they yield different gravitational realizations when we keep the original $JPZ$ field identification fixed. For each case $JPZ$, we determine the invariant tensors, gauge curvatures, Chern--Simons action, field equations, and the corresponding maximal-rank coupling sectors. The field equations can be written in the compact form $\Omega_\sigma\mathbf F=0$, which makes explicit how the additional field $h^a$ contributes to the curvature, torsion, and the remaining gauge-curvature components. We use the direct-sum isomorphisms to classify the local metric sectors and to relate them to known global and asymptotic solutions, while keeping the gravitational interpretation tied to the original $(\omega,e,h)$ fields.

初环之爱：近极端黑洞的量子可变形性

Love at First Loop: Quantum Deformability of Near-Extremal Black Holes

Pablo A. Cano, Marina David, Roberto Emparan, Stefano Trezzi · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-14

中文摘要：在经典的四维渐近平坦广义相对论中，黑洞的静态 Love 数消失。我们研究近极端 Reissner–Nordström 黑洞对最小耦合无质量标量的响应，在近地平 throat 的 Schwarzian 模式强烈涨落的能量尺度下如何改变。此时黑洞作为具有态谱的量子系统响应。其静态响应是一个极化率，由这些态之间的虚跃迁给出。对于 ℓ=0，静态 Love 数因标量的平移对称性而消失，但对于多极 ℓ≥1，静态 Love 数非零：自旋 ℓ 中间态的有限转动能破坏了导致经典结果的抵消。由于 throat 不再具有可供读出潮汐响应的经典几何，我们通过推迟格林函数来定义它，并在 r_+ω 领头阶计算其完整频率依赖。其保守部分需要重整化：近地平理论固定其对数项的系数，并由此产生任何局域项都无法消除的能量依赖，而其有限局域项是四维理论的匹配数据。耗散部分有限且与方案无关。对于 ℓ≥1，当能量低于转动间隙时它在低频消失，而在间隙阈值处对频率变为非解析，并产生晚期 t^{-3/2} 尾。

English: The static Love numbers of black holes vanish in classical, four-dimensional, asymptotically flat General Relativity. We study how this changes for the response of near-extremal Reissner--Nordstr\"om black holes to a minimally coupled massless scalar, at energies where the Schwarzian mode of the near-horizon throat fluctuates strongly. The black hole then responds as a quantum system with a spectrum of states. Its static response is a polarizability, given by virtual transitions between them. For $\ell=0$ the static Love number vanishes, by the shift symmetry of the scalar, but for multipoles $\ell\geq1$ the static Love numbers are nonzero: the finite rotational energy of the spin-$\ell$ intermediate states spoils the cancellation responsible for the classical result. Since the throat no longer has a classical geometry from which to read off a tidal response, we define it through the retarded Green's function, and compute its full frequency dependence at leading order in $r_+\omega$. Its conservative part requires renormalization: the near-horizon theory fixes the coefficient of its logarithm, and with it a dependence on the energy that no local term can remove, while its finite local terms are matching data of the four-dimensional theory. The dissipative part is finite and scheme independent. For $\ell\geq1$, it vanishes at low frequencies when the energy is below the rotational gap, while at the gap threshold it becomes non-analytic in frequency and produces a late-time $t^{-3/2}$ tail.

一句话导读：近极端 Reissner–Nordström 黑洞的静态 Love 数在量子近地平响应下不再全为零，ℓ≥1 由中间态转动能破坏经典抵消，耗散响应在转动间隙阈值产生晚期 t^{-3/2} 尾。

中文摘要：通过 Rindler 方法，我们研究 AdS3/CFT2 与平直3/CCFT2 中一般类时间隔的全息时间类纠缠熵（TEE）。TEE 是类时间隔的伪熵。在体时空中，TEE 的虚部来自一条类时测地线，但在 Rindler 图像中该测地线尚未被识别。经过 Rindler 变换到旋转 BTZ 黑洞后，两条类空极值曲线分别位于内视界和外视界上，交换 l_u ↔ ℓ l_φ 可将其中一条变为另一条。我们找到了类时极值曲线的几何意义：一条伸展于两个视界之间的测地线。其长度为 iπℓ，与间隔无关，并且单独产生虚部 iπc/6。我们在平直空间全息中遵循同样步骤，其中类空曲线位于宇宙学视界上，而类时曲线位于宇宙学视界与类时无穷远之间。评估平面上的 CCFT2 中类时间隔的全息 TEE，我们发现与柱面上的情形相反，实部与虚部相等。

English: Via the Rindler method, we study holographic timelike entanglement entropy (TEE) for a general timelike interval in AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$ and flat$_3$/CCFT$_2$. The TEE is the pseudo entropy of a timelike interval. In the bulk, the imaginary part of the TEE comes from a timelike geodesic, but in the Rindler picture this geodesic has not been identified. After a Rindler transformation to a rotating BTZ black hole, the two spacelike extremal curves lie on the inner and outer horizons, and exchanging $l_u\leftrightarrow \ell l_\phi$ takes one to the other. We find the geometric meaning of the timelike extremal curve: a geodesic stretched between the two horizons. Its length, $i\pi\ell$, is independent of the interval, and it alone produces the imaginary part $i\pi c/6$. We follow the same procedure in flat space holography, where the spacelike curve sits on the cosmological horizon and the timelike curve lies between the cosmological horizon and timelike infinity. Evaluating the holographic TEE for a timelike interval in CCFT$_2$ on the plane, we find that, in contrast with the cylinder, the real and imaginary parts are equal.

中文摘要：类时纠缠熵为全息理论提供了有用探针，但迄今缺乏对其类时极值曲线构造背后模流的显式体实现。我们在 AdS3/CFT2 中构造与类空间隔和类时间隔相关的模流，并将该框架推广到 flat3/CCFT2。从边界对称生成元出发，我们显式推导边界模流并将其延拓到体内部，提供了一种将体模流与极值曲线及全息（类时）纠缠熵联系起来的系统程序。对于类空间隔，所得体模流确定极值曲线，其积分线元重现标准全息纠缠熵。随后我们推广到类时间隔，显式构造模流，其不动点重现给出全息类时纠缠熵的极值类空和类时曲线。据我们所知，这是首次显式构造与类时间隔类时极值曲线相关的模流。相同程序随后被应用于 flat3/CCFT2，得到全息（类时）纠缠熵。最后，我们表明本文所得平直空间结果可在平直空间极限下从 AdS3 对应结果恢复。

English: Timelike entanglement entropy provides a useful probe of holographic theoris, yet an explicit bulk realization of the modular flow underlying its timelike extremal curve construction has so far been lacking. We construct modular flows associated with spacelike and timelike intervals in AdS$_{3}$/CFT$_{2}$ and extend this framework to flat$_{3}$/CCFT$_{2}$. Beginning with the boundary symmetry generators, we explicitly derive the boundary modular flows and extend them into the bulk, providing a systematic procedure that relates bulk modular flows to the extremal curves and holographic (timelike) entanglement entropy. For spacelike intervals, the resulting bulk modular flows determine the extremal curves, whose integrated line elements reproduce the standard holographic entanglement entropy. We then generalize this approach to timelike intervals, explicitly constructing the modular flows whose fixed points reproduce the extremal spacelike and timelike curves which gives the holographic timelike entanglement entropy. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first explicit construction of the modular flow associated with a timelike extremal curve for a timelike interval. 中文摘要：流体力学作为有效场论（EFT）在长时、大尺度区域预测时序关联函数方面非常成功。本文分析流体力学对由非时序关联函数（OTOC）探测的扰乱（scrambling）的预测。为此，我们考虑将流体力学的 Schwinger-Keldysh EFT 推广到全导数阶，并扩展到捕捉 OTOC 所需的四重时间轮廓。构造中的关键要素是局域 SL(2,R) 对称性，此前曾被提出作为扰乱机制。我们还从 SYK 晶格最大混沌低温极限的微观表述推导出这一精确 EFT，从而确定该模型的所有输运系数。作为一个新应用，我们计算能量流的 OTOC，发现其指数增长饱和混沌上限，并与基于冲击波（或 scramblon）有效描述的预期相符。我们的工作表明，流体力学自由度的普适性超越了传统时序关联函数，扩展到 OTOC 等更复杂的可观测量。

In this paper, we analyse the predictions of hydrodynamics for scrambling as probed by out-of-time order correlators (OTOCs). To do so, we consider an all-derivative order generalisation of the Schwinger-Keldysh EFT of hydrodynamics extended to a four-fold time contour required to capture OTOCs. A crucial ingredient of the construction is a local SL(2,R) symmetry, which has previously been suggested as a mechanism for scrambling. We also derive this exact EFT from the microscopic formulation of the maximally chaotic low-temperature limit of the SYK lattice, thereby determining all transport coefficients for this model. As a novel application, we compute the OTOC of energy currents, find that its exponential growth saturates the chaos bound, and match it to expectations based on a shockwave (or scramblon) effective description. Our work shows that the universality of hydrodynamics degrees of freedom extends beyond traditional time-ordered correlators to more complex observables such as OTOCs.

English: We study the role of momentum fractionation in the development of chaos on smooth 3-charge supergravity solutions of D1-D5 theory, specifically momentum-fractionated superstrata. English: We give a microscopic derivation of the semi-classical entropy of the black holes of 3d Lovelock gravity with an infinite tower of regularized Lovelock corrections, which include the regular BTZ black holes found recently. Working in the mini-superspace formalism, we show that the reduced action and its boundary term can be obtained in closed form at all orders in terms of the generating function of the couplings. Assuming the ground state is described by the soliton obtained from the static black hole by a double Wick rotation, we compute the soliton mass and reproduce the semi-classical entropy from the Cardy formula without central charges for arbitrary couplings. 中文摘要：面积度规作为若干量子引力方法（包括弦论、全息和圈量子引力）在中间尺度上的有效描述而出现。最近已表明，面积度规作用量可以在线性化层面从修改的 Plebanski 框架导出。令人惊讶的是，这些作用量避免了有效长度动力学传播子中的额外极点，因此构成线性化 Einstein 引力的有趣形变。为了研究该性质是否在完整理论中持续存在，我们在此从修改的 Plebanski 作用量构造非线性面积度规动力学。我们提供不依赖微扰论的面积度规几何工具，并允许系统构造和研究一般非线性面积度规作用量：一种从面积度规提取长度度规的算法，以及一个由面积度规唯一确定的二形式联络，连同其曲率和曲率不变量。我们导出一阶和二阶版本中由修改 Plebanski 作用量给出的面积度规作用量。我们还发现面积度规作用量可以重新表述为 Poincaré 规范理论。我们确定有效长度度规作用量，其在平直背景上描述一个引力子以及一个带有由 Barbero–Immirzi 参数设定的宇称破坏耦合的大质量自旋二场。此外我们讨论宇宙学背景以及物质耦合的作用，它们共同为宇宙学应用开辟道路。

English: Area metrics arise as effective description at intermediate scales in a number of approaches to quantum gravity, including string theory, holography and loop quantum gravity. Recently, it has been shown that area metric actions can be derived from the modified Plebanski framework on the linearized level. Surprisingly these actions avoid extra poles in the propagator for the effective length dynamics, and hence constitute interesting deformations of linearized Einstein gravity. To be able to study whether this property persist for the full theory, we construct here non-linear area metric dynamics from modified Plebanski actions. We provide the geometric tools for area metrics that do not rely on perturbation theory and allow a systematic construction and study of general non-linear area metric actions: an algorithm that extracts a length metric from an area metric and a connection on two-forms that is uniquely determined by the area metric, together with its curvature and curvature invariants. We derive area metric actions from modified Plebanski actions in first and second order versions. We also find that area metric actions can be reformulated as Poincare gauge theories. We determine the effective length metric action, which on a flat background describes a graviton and a massive spin-two field with parity-violating couplings set by the Barbero--Immirzi parameter. Additionally we discuss cosmological backgrounds and the role of the matter coupling, which together open the way to cosmological applications.
