中文摘要：我们研究在 n 个 Majorana 模上带 k-体相互作用的 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) 哈密顿量 H_SYK，并证明对于超常数 k≤o(√n)，有 E||H_SYK||_op = (1 - o(1))·√(2n)/k，其中期望对哈密顿量中的无序变量取。这证实了 Garcia-Garcia、Jia 和 Verbaarschot 的预测，并回答了 Feng、Tian 和 Wei 提出的问题。我们的结果可推广到稀疏 SYK 哈密顿量。作为推论，对于所有 k < √n/4，Basso、Chen 和 Dalzell 的耗散量子算法可证明以 O(1) 乘法因子计算 SYK 哈密顿量的基态能量。关键技术思想是找到一个显式的确定性线性算子 x，使得 x^{2ℓ} 的某个固定二次型对每个 n 和 k 都恰好等于 SYK 哈密顿量的期望迹矩。该线性算子可自然视为超图超边空间上玻色子的扭曲模型。于是问题归结为确定 x 的谱边缘；我们证明它由 Johnson 方案中一个自然的 {n choose k} 维矩阵的谱主导，并可用已知结果直接计算。为说明界是尖锐的，我们构造一个在 x 上具有大二次型的见证态，并将其转化为 H_SYK 上最大二次型下界的证书。除 SYK 哈密顿量外，我们的技术也适用于 k-局域量子自旋玻璃 (QSG)，得到对所有 1≤k≤√n/2，E||H_{k-QSG}||_op ≤ O(√(n/k))，从而将标准 O(√n) 界改进了因子 √k。

English: We study the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) Hamiltonian $H_{\operatorname{SYK}}$ on $n$ Majorana modes with $k$-body interactions, and prove that $\mathbb{E}\|H_{\operatorname{SYK}}\|_{\operatorname{op}} = (1 - o(1))\cdot\sqrt{2n}/k$ for super-constant $k\leq o(\sqrt{n})$, where the expectation is over the disorder variables in the Hamiltonian. This confirms predictions due to Garcia-Garcia, Jia and Verbaarschot and answers a question posed by Feng, Tian, and Wei. Our results extend to the sparse SYK Hamiltonian. As a corollary, we obtain that a dissipative quantum algorithm due to Basso, Chen, and Dalzell provably computes the ground state energy of the SYK Hamiltonian up to an $O(1)$-multiplicative factor for all $k < \sqrt{n}/4$. Our key technical idea is identifying an explicit, deterministic linear operator $\mathsf{x}$ such that a fixed quadratic form of $\mathsf{x}^{2\ell}$ exactly equals the expected trace moments of the SYK Hamiltonian for every $n$ and $k$. This linear operator can be naturally viewed as a twisted model of bosons on the space of hyperedges of a hypergraph. The problem thus reduces to identifying the spectral edge of $\mathsf{x}$, which we show is dominated by the spectrum of a natural ${n \choose k}$-dimensional matrix from the Johnson scheme and is straightforward to compute using known results. To show that our bound is sharp, we construct a witness state with a large quadratic form on $\mathsf{x}$ and transform it into a certificate of a lower bound on the largest quadratic form on $H_{\operatorname{SYK}}$. Beyond the SYK Hamiltonian, our techniques also apply to the $k-$local quantum spin glass (QSG), yielding $\mathbb{E}\|H_{k-\operatorname{QSG}}\|_{\operatorname{op}}\leq O(\sqrt{n/k})$ for all $1\leq k\leq\sqrt{n}/2$, thus improving the standard $O(\sqrt{n})$ bound by a factor of $\sqrt{k}$.

English: We study cosmological stasis in coupled dark matter and dark energy models in which a scalar field drives the dark energy and sets the dark matter mass, with the Dark Dimension as the motivating realization. The constant abundance solutions are the stationary solutions of coupled quintessence, which we read as stasis epochs with computable lifetimes and exits. The stasis solutions provide analytic exclusions of the parameter space which do not depend on initial conditions.

中文摘要：在 Einstein 引力中，满足零能量条件的非静态 Bianchi I 时空的每条零测地线在 Bianchi I 区域内至少一个方向上不完备。我们证明更强的方向刚性定理：若一条零测地线沿自身以及每个时刻在一个横向零方向上的零曲率非负，则它在两个仿射方向都完备迫使时空静态。空间度规不必对角，膨胀率可正可负。证明使用无焦散的零测地线汇，其守恒空间余向量定义固定屏幕超平面。两个曲率条件允许沿测地线以及（当宇宙时完备时）沿共动世界线的平均替代。在非静态度规中，至多四个有向方向是光学饱和的；其他每条完备零测地线都有严格负的平均零曲率。周期与有限脉冲例子以违反 NEC 的源和非正的总能量密度达到该界。对有限脉冲，我们由固定宇宙时下的三个方向曲率预算导出度规偏移的界，并由固定仿射时下的平均零能量亏损导出一个自由、无质量、最小耦合试探标量场的模式混合的界。

English: In Einstein gravity, every null geodesic of a non-static Bianchi I spacetime satisfying the null energy condition is incomplete in at least one direction within the Bianchi I region. We prove a stronger directional rigidity theorem: a single null geodesic complete in both affine directions forces staticity if the null curvature is nonnegative along it and, at each time, in one transverse null direction. The spatial metric need not be diagonal, and the expansion rates may have either sign. The proof uses caustic-free null congruences whose conserved spatial covectors define fixed screen hyperplanes. The two curvature conditions admit averaged replacements along the geodesic and, when cosmic time is complete, along comoving worldlines. In a non-static metric, at most four oriented directions are optically saturated; every other complete null geodesic has strictly negative averaged null curvature. Periodic and finite-pulse examples attain this bound with NEC-violating sources and nonpositive total energy density. For finite pulses, we derive bounds on metric excursions from three directional curvature budgets at fixed cosmic duration, and on the mode mixing of a free, massless, minimally coupled test scalar field from the averaged null-energy deficit at fixed affine duration.

一句话导读：证明 Bianchi I 时空中零测地线完备性的方向刚性，并给出非静态宇宙中零曲率与模式混合的约束。

相关度：high — 论文直接属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究 Bianchi I 时空中的零测地线完备性、刚性定理与宇宙学约束，不涉及全息对偶。

引力拟涡能：局部几何起源与能量级联约束

Gravitational Enstrophy: Local Geometric Origin and Energy-Cascade Constraints

Luis Lehner · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE, hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-10-06

中文摘要：二维不可压缩流体在无粘极限下守恒能量和拟涡能。Fjørtoft 论证利用这一对量约束非线性能量转移。我们使用磁 Weyl 泛函 Z=∫ B_{ab}B^{ab}√γ d^3x 研究广义相对论中的对应问题。其横向辐射部分相对于引力波能量带有额外的频率平方权重：在辐射区 δZ_k≃ω_k^2 W_k，其中 W=8πG E_GW。我们从 Bianchi 恒等式推导其平衡律，得到代数相消、体源和边界通量。通过非线性转移守恒正能量和曲率范数，当它们的权重有序时给出 Fjørtoft 约束。共振弱波相互作用通常会改变曲率范数；2↔2 动力学则守恒能量和波作用量。我们考察 Kerr 和 AdS 背景中转移与线性损耗之间的竞争，其中长寿命或受限模式为非线性演化提供时间。在 AdS4 的流体力学区域，流体加权的磁 Weyl 泛函在无粘极限下继承流体拟涡能守恒。我们以领先梯度阶的闭合形式计算其与边界拟涡能的比例系数，为全息湍流提供体诊断。

English: Two-dimensional incompressible fluids conserve energy and enstrophy in the inviscid limit. Fj{\o}rtoft's argument uses this pair to constrain nonlinear energy transfer. We examine the corresponding question in General Relativity using the magnetic Weyl functional $\mathcal Z=\int B_{ab}B^{ab}\sqrt{\gamma}\,d^3x$. Its transverse radiativ e part carries an additional frequency-squared weight relative to gravitational-wave energy: $\delta\mathcal Z_k\simeq\omega_k^2W_k$ in the radiation zone, with $W=8\pi G E_{\rm GW}$. We derive its balance law from the Bianchi identities, obtaining the algebraic cancellations, bulk sources and boundary fluxes. Conservation of positive e nergy and curvature norm through nonlinear transfer gives a Fj{\o}rtoft constraint when their weights are ordered. Resonant weak-wave interactions generally change the c urvature norm; $2\leftrightarrow2$ dynamics instead conserves energy and wave action. We examine the competition between transfer and linear losses in Kerr and AdS backg rounds, where long-lived or confined modes provide time for nonlinear evolution. In the hydrodynamic regime of AdS$_4$, a fluid-weighted magnetic Weyl functional inherit s fluid enstrophy conservation in the inviscid limit. We compute its proportionality coefficient to boundary enstrophy in closed form at leading gradient order, giving a bulk diagnostic for holographic turbulence.

一句话导读：该文将二维流体的拟涡能与 Fjørtoft 约束推广到广义相对论，用磁 Weyl 泛函推导平衡律，并给出 AdS4 全息湍流的体诊断。

经典 F(R) 引力与量子广义相对论中对 Bekenstein-Hawking 面积公式修正的引力波约束：对理论参数的含义

Gravitational wave constraints on corrections to Bekenstein-Hawking Area Formula in classical F(R) gravity and quantum GR : implications for theory parameters

Parthasarathi Majumdar · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-06

中文摘要：本文利用双黑洞并合引力波数据，对黑洞熵的 Bekenstein-Hawking 面积公式可能修正施加约束。近期 LVK 对 GW250114 中最响信号（信噪比约 80）的分析似乎以约 5σ 精度确认了黑洞的 Hawking 面积定理。将这一结果与 Bekenstein 的黑洞熵思想及广义热力学第二定律结合，作者在 Wald 熵形式下约束经典 F(R) 引力大视界面积球对称黑洞解的首个反面积修正。文中引入“绝对一致性”概念，并与“相对一致性”对比；该绝对一致性判据可关联 F(R) 引力的某些参数。随后考虑量子广义相对论对面积公式的首个修正，分别来自非微扰、无物质的圈量子引力以及依赖物质的微扰纠缠熵方法。将两者在大面积下对数的领先修正结合，并要求其与面积定理的观测验证满足绝对一致性，会对超出标准模型粒子谱的自旋和种类数产生显著限制，其中一些常被假定为暗物质候选。

English: This contribution considers constraints from analyses of gravitational wave data from binary black hole coalescence, on possible corrections to the Bekenstein-Hawking Area Formula for black hole entropy. Most recent analyses of gravitational wave data from the LVK Consortium appear to confirm the Hawking Area Theorem for black holes at a $5 \sigma$ accuracy, for the `loudest' signal (SNR of the order of $80$) of binary black hole merger inherent in the recent observation GW250114. Amalgamating this result with Bekenstein's ideas of black hole entropy and the generalized second law of thermodynamics, we constrain leading inverse area corrections for large horizon area spherical black hole solutions of classical $F(R)$ gravity, using the Wald entropy function formalism. The implementation of the observational constraints entails the notion of `absolute consistency' which we introduce and contrast with `relative consistency'. This absolute consistency criterion is shown to relate some of the parameters of $F(R)$ gravity. Next we consider leading quantum general relativistic corrections to the Area formula, arising both from the non-perturbative matter-free Loop Quantum Gravity and matter-dependent, perturbative Entanglement entropy approaches. Combining the leading logarithmic corrections in horizon area (for large areas) from both approaches, and imposing absolute consistency with the observational validation of the Area Theorem, is shown to lead to significant restrictions on the spin and number of species of Beyond Standard Model spectrum of elementary particles, some of which are often assumed to be Dark Matter candidates.

一句话导读：用引力波对面积定理的检验约束 F(R) 引力与量子引力对黑洞熵面积律的修正，并进一步限制 BSM 粒子谱。

相关度：medium — 论文直接涉及经典引力、黑洞热力学与引力波观测约束，但不属于全息对偶研究；对经典引力/广义相对论支线有参考价值。

新改进的史瓦西黑洞及其热力学与拓扑分类

New Improved Schwarzschild Black Hole and Its Thermodynamics and Topological Classification

G. Alencar, T. M. Crispim, C. R. Muniz, M. Nilton · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-06

中文摘要：我们利用牛顿耦合的精确新方案跑动，构造了一个重整化群改进的类史瓦西黑洞几何。标度识别通过一个由插值参数 γ 控制的标准插值固有距离函数实现，该参数平滑连接紫外和红外区域。我们给出了由此得到的坐标依赖耦合和改进的度规函数，并分析了其渐近展开。大距离极限被证明可恢复经典史瓦西解，而对于 γ>0，短距离行为表现出规则的类 de Sitter 核心，从而导致中心奇点的正则化。我们还分析了该解的热力学性质，表明量子修正显著改变小半径行为，导致残遗构型和非平凡相结构。最后，我们研究了改进史瓦西黑洞的热力学拓扑，并表明量子引力修正正则化了霍金温度剖面，产生一个具有相反绕数的额外热力学缺陷，并将全局热力学-拓扑荷从经典史瓦西值 W=-1 改变为 W=0。

English: We construct a renormalization-group improved Schwarzschild-like black hole geometry using the exact new scheme running for the Newton coupling. The scale identification is implemented via a standard interpolating proper-distance function governed by an interpolation parameter $\gamma$ that smoothly connects the ultraviolet and infrared regimes. We present the resulting coordinate-dependent coupling and the improved metric function, analyzing its asymptotic expansions. The large-distance limit is shown to recover the classical Schwarzschild solution, while for $\gamma>0$ the short-distance behavior exhibits a regular de Sitter-like core, resulting in the regularization of the central singularity. We also analyze the thermodynamic properties of the solution, showing that quantum corrections significantly modify the small-radius behavior, leading to a remnant configuration and a nontrivial phase structure. Finally, we investigate the thermodynamic topology of the improved Schwarzschild black hole and show that the quantum-gravity corrections regularize the Hawking-temperature profile, giving rise to an additional thermodynamic defect with opposite winding number and changing the global thermodynamic-topological charge from the classical Schwarzschild value $W=-1$ to $W=0$.

一句话导读：利用牛顿耦合的精确重整化群跑动构造改进史瓦西黑洞，分析其正则化核心、热力学残遗与热力学拓扑荷从 W=-1 到 W=0 的改变。

相关度：medium — 非全息研究；属于量子修正黑洞与黑洞热力学/热力学拓扑，涉及相变结构与经典黑洞解，与用户重点标签中的“经典引力/广义相对论”和“相变与气泡成核”部分相关。

中子星的非线性相对论潮汐响应

Nonlinear Relativistic Tidal Response of Neutron Stars

Paolo Pani, Massimiliano Maria Riva, Luca Santoni, Nikola Savi\'c, Filippo Vernizzi · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-06

中文摘要：我们通过计算完全相对论的静态二次Love数，研究中子星的非线性潮汐响应。利用扩展引力体的世界线有效场论和相对论恒星模型的二阶微扰，我们推导了由外部引力电潮汐场诱导的直至二次阶的非线性潮汐形变。通过适当的匹配程序，我们首次给出了双星系统保守动力学和引力波信号的首个非线性潮汐修正。在低致密性极限下，二次Love数比线性Love数增强更多。因此，尽管以8后牛顿（PN）阶进入引力波相位，主导的二次Love数可以与7PN阶的次次领头阶线性潮汐修正同等重要，并且大于4PN阶的次领头阶点粒子贡献。特别地，在旋近晚期，二次Love数可以达到线性Love数的~10%。我们的方法提供了一个框架，也可计算由磁潮汐场和高阶多极矩诱导的（次领头）非线性效应，并为将非线性潮汐效应纳入高精度引力波建模奠定了基础。

English: We investigate the nonlinear tidal response of relativistic neutron stars by computing the fully relativistic, static, quadratic Love numbers. Using both the worldline effective field theory for extended gravitating bodies and second-order perturbations of relativistic stellar models, we derive the nonlinear tidal deformation induced by an external gravito-electric tidal field to quadratic order. Through a suitable matching procedure, we provide for the first time the leading nonlinear tidal corrections to the conservative dynamics and gravitational-wave signal of binary systems. Quadratic Love numbers are enhanced more than the linear ones in the small-compactness limit. Because of this, despite entering the gravitational-wave phase at 8th post-Newtonian (PN) order, the leading quadratic Love number can be as important as the next-to-next-to-leading order linear tidal correction, which enters at 7th PN order, and is larger than the subleading point-particle contribution entering at 4th PN order. In particular, quadratic Love numbers can be as large as ~10% of the linear Love numbers in the late inspiral phase. Our approach provides a framework to also compute the (subleading) nonlinear effects induced by magnetic tidal fields and higher multipole moments, and sets the foundations for incorporating nonlinear tidal effects in high-precision gravitational-wave modeling.

一句话导读：计算中子星完全相对论静态二次Love数，首次给出双星系统引力波信号中的非线性潮汐修正。

全息张量网络中的代数结构

Algebraic structure in holographic tensor networks

Abhisek Sahu, Jeremy van der Heijden, Mark Van Raamsdonk, Rana Zibakhsh · hep-th, gr-qc, quant-ph · v2 · 更新 2026-10-06

中文摘要：在先前工作 2511.21852 中，我们探讨了一个假设：在一般量子引力理论中，称为广义纠缠楔（由 Bousso 和 Penington 引入）的时空区域在半经典极限下具有相关联的可观测量子代数。我们定义了与这些子代数相关的熵，它满足与广义纠缠楔的广义引力熵相同的单调性和强次可加性。本文利用全息张量网络玩具模型检验这些想法。在此背景下，广义纠缠楔的类比是这样一个区域：没有任何包含它的区域具有更少的边界腿。在大键维极限（类比半经典极限）下，我们论证每个这样的区域都典范地关联着边界希尔伯特空间上全观测代数的一个子代数，以及一族幺正相关的 von Neumann 因子子代数。我们详细研究这些子代数上的各种代数运算（如交、并和交换子）如何与张量网络区域的相应几何运算相关。我们研究广义纠缠楔的广义熵的单调性和强次可加性在多大程度上可由我们的代数熵性质推出。我们还引入一个与子代数 A 相关的替代熵量 S(ω || ω ∘ E_{A'})，它在适当条件下也满足单调性和强次可加性。最后，我们说明如何基于键维不断增大的无限随机张量网络族定义一个 type II_1 von Neumann 代数，使得对应于广义纠缠楔的区域可关联到该全代数的精确子代数。

English: In a previous work 2511.21852, we explored the hypothesis that in general theories of quantum gravity, spacetime regions known as generalized entanglement wedges (introduced by Bousso and Penington) have an associated subalgebra of observables in a semiclassical limit. We defined an entropy associated with these subalgebras that obeys the same monotonicity and strong subadditivity properties as the generalized gravitational entropy of generalized entanglement wedges. Here, we test aspects of these ideas making use of tensor network toy models for holography. In this context, the analog of a generalized entanglement wedge is a region for which no region containing it has a smaller number of boundary legs. In the limit of large bond dimension (analogous to the semiclassical limit), we argue that each such region has a canonically associated subalgebra of the full algebra of observables on the boundary Hilbert space, as well as a family of unitarily related von Neumann factor subalgebras. We investigate in detail how various algebraic operations on these subalgebras (e.g. their intersections, joins, and commutants) are related to corresponding geometrical operations on the tensor network regions. We study to what extent the monotonicity and strong subadditivity properties of generalized entropy for generalized entanglement wedges follow from properties of our algebraic entropy. We also introduce an alternative entropic quantity $S(\omega || \omega \circ E_{\mathcal{A}'})$ associated with a subalgebra $\mathcal{A}$ that also obeys monotonicity and strong subadditivity properties with suitable conditions. Finally, we explain how to define a type $II_1$ von Neumann algebra based on an infinite family of random tensor networks with increasing bond dimension such that the regions corresponding to generalized entanglement wedges can be associated with exact subalgebras of this full algebra.

一句话导读：用全息张量网络检验广义纠缠楔对应的可观测代数结构及其熵性质。

相关度：medium — 论文属于全息张量网络与量子信息/代数方法，契合全息基础与纠缠主题，但不直接对应所列全息超流、p波、QNM、D3-D7 等重点支线。

arXiv 摘要 · PDF

到黑洞中心之旅

Journey to the Center of a Black Hole

Vyshnav Mohan · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-06

中文摘要：在三维 BTZ 黑洞中，标量场的入落两点函数（一个算符插入外部，另一个沿类时测地线插入）在入落插入点到达黑洞奇点时发散。在边界描述中，这一发散与双扭算符交换相关，而不是与在高维中编码曲率奇点的多应力张量扇区相关。我们表明，引入具有 Hagedorn 增长的塔状大质量粒子会给出圈修正，这些修正在奇点附近变得重要，并触发 Hagedorn 相变，使树级发散不再可靠。在边界理论中，相应的主算符塔导致探针算符在黑洞态中的广义自由场描述失效。对于大黑洞，这些修正只在奇点附近重要，在视界处保持指数压低。因此这些修正占主导的区域与视界存在参数化分离，正如黑洞互补性原理所预期。

English: An infalling two-point function of a scalar field in a three-dimensional BTZ black hole, with one operator inserted in the exterior and the other inserted along a timelike geodesic, diverges when the infalling insertion point reaches the black hole singularity. In the boundary description, this divergence is tied to the exchange of double-twist operators rather than to the multi-stress-tensor sector that encodes curvature singularities in higher dimensions. We show that the inclusion of a tower of massive particles with Hagedorn growth gives rise to loop corrections that become important near the singularity, where they trigger a Hagedorn transition that renders the tree-level divergence untrustworthy. In the boundary theory, the corresponding tower of primary operators leads to a breakdown of the generalized free field description of the probe operator in the black hole state. In a large black hole, these corrections become important only near the singularity and remain exponentially suppressed at the horizon. The region where these corrections dominate is therefore parametrically separated from the horizon, as anticipated by the principle of black hole complementarity.

一句话导读：通过 BTZ 黑洞中入落两点函数与边界双扭算符，讨论接近奇点时 Hagedorn 修正如何破坏树级发散与广义自由场描述。

相关度：low — 主题为黑洞内部/奇点与 AdS/CFT 边界描述，属于黑洞/量子引力理论；未直接匹配用户列出的全息凝聚态、p波、multi-trace、QNM、D3-D7、经典引力等研究支线。

arXiv 摘要 · PDF

AdS4×S7/Z_k 中 M2 膜 S^3/Z_k 瞬子配分函数：2 圈修正

M2 brane $S^3/\mathbb Z_k$ instanton partition function in ${\rm AdS}_4\times S^7/\mathbb Z_k$: 2-loop correction

Arkady A. Tseytlin · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-06

中文摘要：如 arXiv:2609.14497 所示，包裹 AdS4×S7/Z_k 内 AdS2×S^1 的 M2 膜配分函数的 2 圈 T^{-1}_2 修正为零，这与 ABJM 理论中 1/2-BPS 圆形 Wilson 圈在巨正则系综下的局域化预言一致（依据 arXiv:2505.21633 的猜想）。本文研究包裹 S^3/Z_k ⊂ S^7/Z_k、对偶于 ABJM 理论三维球面上自由能的领头非微扰大 N 贡献的 M2 膜瞬子的 T^{-1}_2 修正。arXiv:2307.14112 已表明 1 圈瞬子 M2 膜配分函数与局域化预言相符。2 圈计算因存在玻色子和费米子零模而变得复杂，需要对集体坐标积分。集体坐标的雅可比在 M2 膜作用量四次相互作用顶点贡献之外，还给出非平凡的 T^{-1}_2 贡献。我们发现对于 k>2，在使费米子零模与量子场分离并各自构成独立超多重态的选取下，四次顶点贡献被雅可比贡献抵消。假设对配对零模采用超对称规定，我们证明在集体坐标积分后抵消仍然成立。因此 T^{-1}_2 修正为零，与巨正则系综预言一致。对于 k=1，四次顶点贡献约化为运动方程项，如 arXiv:2511.22306 中 AdS3 ⊂ AdS7×S^4 的情形，后者通过形式解析延拓与 S^3 ⊂ AdS4×S^7 情形相联系。

English: As was shown in arXiv:2609.14497, the 2-loop $ {\rm T}^{-1}_2$ correction to the partition function of M2 brane wrapping $\mathrm{AdS}_2\times S^1$ inside $\mathrm{AdS}_4\times S^7/\mathbb{Z}_k$ vanishes. This is in agreement with the localization prediction for $\frac{1}{2}$-BPS circular Wilson loop in ABJM theory interpreted in the grand-canonical ensemble according to the conjecture of arXiv:2505.21633. Here we study the ${\rm T}^{-1}_2$ correction for the M2 brane instanton wrapping $S^3/\mathbb Z_k\subset S^7/\mathbb Z_k$ dual to the leading non-perturbative large $N$ contribution to the ABJM free energy on 3-sphere. The 1-loop instanton M2 brane partition function was shown in arXiv:2307.14112 to match the localization prediction. The 2-loop computation is complicated by the presence of bosonic and fermionic zero modes, which requires to integrate over the collective coordinates. The collective-coordinate Jacobian provides a non-trivial ${\rm T}^{-1}_2$ contribution in addition to the one of the quartic interaction vertex in the M2 brane action. We find that for $k>2$ the the quartic vertex contribution is cancelled by the Jacobian contribution for the choice of the separation of the fermionic zero modes from the quantum fields under which these form separate supermultiplets. Assuming the supersymmetric prescription for the paired zero modes we show that the cancellation persists after integration over the collective coordinates. Thus the ${\rm T}^{-1}_2$ correction vanishes, in agreement with the grand-canonical ensemble prediction. For $k=1$ the quartic vertex contribution reduces to equation-of-motion terms as in the case of ${\rm AdS}_3 \subset { \rm AdS}_7 \times S^4$ in arXiv:2511.22306 which is related to $S^3 \subset {\rm AdS}_4 \times S^7$ case by a formal analytic continuation.

一句话导读：计算 AdS4×S7/Z_k 中包裹 S^3/Z_k 的 M2 膜瞬子的 2 圈 T^{-1}_2 修正，发现在 k>2 时该修正因四次顶点与集体坐标雅可比贡献相消而为零，与 ABJM 巨正则系综预言一致。

相关度：medium — 该文属于 AdS/CFT 精确检验（M2 膜瞬子与 ABJM 局域化预言对比）这一全息理论的基础方向，但未落入用户列出的具体研究支线标签（如全息超流超导、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM、探针膜与 Floquet 等），因此相关性为中等。

零弦全息：零弦探测其靶空间的射影边界

Null String Holography, Null Strings Probe Projective Boundary of Their Target Spaces

M. M. Sheikh-Jabbari, H. Yavartanoo · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-06

中文摘要：我们证明，背景流形 $\mathcal{M}$ 上的最小零弦理论在经典意义上等价于其射影边界 $\mathcal{B}_{\text{P}}=\partial_{\text{P}}\mathcal{M}$ 上的 ILST 理论。我们猜想这种等价性在量子层面也成立，并将此对应称为零弦全息。特别地，我们表明 $D$ 维反德西特（AdS$_D$）背景的庞加莱片上的最小零弦理论由 $(D-1)$ 维闵可夫斯基背景上的 ILST 理论描述，与著名的 AdS/CFT 对应类似。dS$_D$ 宇宙学片上的最小零弦理论由 $(D-1)$ 维平坦欧几里得空间上的 ILST 理论支配。对于 $D$ 维闵可夫斯基空间 $\mathbb{M}_D$ 上的零弦，取决于用来覆盖 $\mathbb{M}_D$ 的坐标片，其射影边界包括 dS$_{D-1}$、渐近零无穷 $\mathcal{I}^\pm$ 以及双曲面 $\mathbb{H}^{D-1}$ 片。与每个片上的最小零弦对偶的 ILST 理论，则位于该片所采用坐标张成的射影边界部分上。我们评论零弦全息在黑洞视界上的可能应用。

English: We prove that the \textit{minimal null string theory} on a background manifold ${\mathcal M}$ is classically equivalent to the ILST theory on the projective boundary of $\mathcal M$, ${{\cal B}_{_{\text{P}}}}={\partial_{_{\text{P}}}\mathcal{M}}$. We conjecture that this equivalence also holds at quantum level, we dub this correspondence \textit{null string holography}. In particular, we show the minimal null string theory on the Poincar\'e patch of a $D$ dimensional Anti de Sitter (AdS$_D$) background is described by the ILST theory on $(D-1)$-dimensional Minkowski background, paralleling the celebrated AdS/CFT. The minimal null string theory on the cosmological patch of dS$_D$ is governed by the ILST theory on $(D-1)$-dimensional flat Euclidean space. For null strings on a $D$-dimensional Minkowski space $\mathbb{M}_D$, depending on the coordinate patches used to span $\mathbb{M}_D$, the projective boundary includes a dS$_{D-1}$, asymptotic null infinities ${\mathcal I}^\pm$ and the hyperboloid $\mathbb{H}^{D-1}$ patches. The ILST theory dual to the minimal null strings on each patch, then resides on the piece of the projective boundary spanned by the coordinates adopted in the patch. We comment on possible applications of null string holography to black hole horizons.

一句话导读：证明最小零弦理论与其靶空间射影边界上的 ILST 理论经典等价，并猜想量子零弦全息。

双荷 ISO(7) 规范超引力 G2 不变扇区中的微扰毛发黑膜

Perturbative Hairy Black Branes in the $G_{2}$-Invariant Sector of Dyonic ISO(7) Gauged Supergravity

Sangheon Yun · hep-th, gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-10-06

中文摘要：我们在四维双荷 N=8 ISO(7) 规范超引力的 G2 不变截断中构造带有中性标量毛发的微扰黑膜；该截断是 massive IIA 超引力在 S6 上的精确一致截断。以无量纲标量荷参数 eps 展开 G2 对称的 AdS4-Schwarzschild 黑膜，微扰层级逐阶化为嵌套的非齐次 Legendre 方程（展示到二阶）。一阶标量满足参数 nu(nu+1)=2/3 的 Pöschl-Teller 方程，nu=-1/2+sqrt(33)/6；一阶度规由同一函数代数地固定，A^(1)=-sqrt(7)/2 phi^(1)，因此整个 O(eps) 扇区是一个 Legendre 函数。恒等式 nu+1=Delta_+/3，其中 Delta_+=(3+sqrt(33))/2≈4.372 是对偶标量算符的共形维数，通过非线性 Fefferman-Graham 映射 z ∝ z_FG^3 将 Pöschl-Teller 参数与 AdS/CFT 字典联系起来。O(eps^2) 反作用给出固定温度下重整化自由能和 Bekenstein-Hawking 熵密度的显式修正，并满足第一定律；等价地，在固定熵或能量密度下，Hawking 温度降低 delta T/T=O(eps^2)。对领头输运系数，剪切粘滞满足 eta/s=1/(4pi)，Eling-Oz 视界公式给出非零体粘滞 zeta/eta=((Delta_+-3)/2)^2 eps^2=3(7-sqrt(33))/8 eps^2≈0.471 eps^2。由于 c_s^2=1/2-O(eps^2)<1/2，这表明状态方程软化。

English: We construct perturbative black-brane solutions carrying neutral scalar hair in the $G_{2}$-invariant truncation of four-dimensional dyonic $\mathcal{N}=8$ ISO(7) gauged supergravity, an exact consistent truncation of massive type~IIA supergravity on $S^{6}$. Expanding around the $G_{2}$-symmetric AdS$_{4}$-Schwarzschild black brane in powers of a dimensionless scalar-charge parameter $\eps$, we show that the perturbation hierarchy reduces, order by order, to a nested sequence of inhomogeneous Legendre equations (demonstrated through second order). The first-order scalar satisfies a P\"{o}schl--Teller equation with exact parameter $\nu(\nu+1)=2/3$, giving $\nu=-\frac{1}{2}+\frac{\sqrt{33}}{6}$, and the first-order metric is fixed algebraically by the same function, $A^{(1)}=-\tfrac{\sqrt{7}}{2}\phi^{(1)}$, so the entire $\mathcal{O}(\eps)$ sector is one Legendre function. An identity $\nu+1=\Delta_{+}/3$, with $\Delta_{+}=(3+\sqrt{33})/2\approx 4.372$ the conformal dimension of the dual scalar operator, relates the P\"{o}schl-Teller parameter to the AdS/CFT dictionary via the nonlinear Fefferman-Graham map $z \propto z_{\mathrm{FG}}^{3}$. The $\mathcal{O}(\eps^{2})$ back-reaction yields explicit corrections to the renormalized free energy and Bekenstein-Hawking entropy density at fixed temperature, consistent with the first law; equivalently, at fixed entropy or energy density it \emph{lowers} the Hawking temperature by $\delta T/T=\mathcal{O}(\eps^{2})$. For the leading transport coefficients the shear viscosity saturates $\eta/s=1/(4\pi)$, while the Eling-Oz horizon formula gives a nonzero bulk viscosity $\zeta/\eta=\bigl(\tfrac{\Delta_{+}-3}{2}\bigr)^{2}\eps^{2}=\tfrac{3(7-\sqrt{33})}{8}\eps^{2}\approx0.471\,\eps^{2}$. With $c_{s}^{2}=\tfrac12-\mathcal O(\eps^{2})<\tfrac12$, this indicates a softening of the equation of state.

一句话导读：在 ISO(7) 规范超引力 G2 不变扇区中构造微扰毛发黑膜，并计算其对 AdS/CFT 热力学与输运系数（含非零体粘滞）的 O(eps^2) 修正。

相关度：medium — 论文属于全息黑膜与输运方向，涉及 AdS/CFT 字典、热力学和体粘滞，并与经典引力/黑膜背景部分相关；但不直接对应全息超导、p波、畴壁、multi-trace、QNM、冷原子或 D3-D7 等具体重点支线。

AdS-Einstein-标量引力中的精确平面黑洞与红外涌现的近似共形流体

Exact Planar Black Hole in AdS-Einstein-Scalar Gravity with IR-Emergent Nearly Conformal Fluid

Sangheon Yun · hep-th, gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-10-06

中文摘要：我们研究四维中爱因斯坦引力与中性标量最小耦合的一个精确静态平面有毛黑洞，它出现在 IIA 型超引力在 AdS4×CP3 上的一个一致截断中，对偶于 ABJM 理论。对于非零毛，渐近区域为 hyperscaling violating 而非 AdS，对偶理论是一个三维 QFT，在 UV 被一个有效边际相关算符（具有对数跑动）形变，并在 IR 流向 ABJM 不动点。在引力侧，将毛参数视为独立变量会导向一个热力学中心荷 C_t 和一个由径向标度等距组织起来的广义第一定律。用 Hamilton-Jacobi 方法进行的全息重整化以闭式给出一点函数和迹 Ward 恒等式。固定源时，黑膜存在于最大温度 T_max≈0.19Λ 之下，并分为两支。稳定支的等离子体趋近共形 ABJM 流体，相对修正为 (T/Λ)^3 阶，这些修正来自边界坐标的态依赖重标度；另一支由 θ=9 的 hyperscaling violation 支配。一个标度不变的多迹边界条件固定毛参数而非源，所选解与第二个理论的热态相同；该理论的能量密度是体质量密度，且平衡热力学严格共形。由于源模不可归一化，第二个理论仅在平衡时建立，而固定源的理论才是这些解的对偶。

English: We study an exact static planar hairy black hole of Einstein gravity minimally coupled to a neutral scalar in four dimensions, which arises in a consistent truncation of type IIA supergravity on AdS$_4\times\mathbb{CP}^3$ dual to the ABJM theory. For nonzero hair the asymptotic region is hyperscaling violating rather than AdS, and the dual theory is a three-dimensional QFT deformed in the UV by an effectively marginally relevant operator with logarithmic running, which flows to the ABJM fixed point in the IR. On the gravity side, treating the hair parameter as an independent variable leads to a thermodynamic central charge $C_t$ and a generalized first law, organized by a radial scaling isometry. Holographic renormalization by the Hamilton--Jacobi method gives the one-point functions in closed form and the trace Ward identity. With the source held fixed, black branes exist below a maximal temperature $T_{\max}\simeq0.19\,\Lambda$ in two branches. On the stable branch the plasma approaches the conformal ABJM fluid with corrections of relative order $(T/\Lambda)^3$, which arise from a state-dependent rescaling of the boundary coordinates, while the other branch is governed by hyperscaling violation with $\theta=9$. A scale-invariant multi-trace boundary condition, which fixes the hair parameter instead of the source, selects the same solutions as the thermal states of a second theory, whose energy density is the bulk mass density and whose equilibrium thermodynamics is exactly conformal. Since the source mode is not normalizable, this second theory is established only in equilibrium, and the theory with fixed source is the dual of the solutions.

一句话导读：在 AdS-Einstein-标量引力中构造精确平面有毛黑洞，通过全息重整化与多迹边界条件揭示红外近共形 ABJM 流体及另一平衡共形理论。

Critical Lin-Lunin-Maldacena geometries

Prokopii Anempodistov, Vladimir Kazakov, Lev Senchukov · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-06

中文摘要：我们研究了 Lin-Lunin-Maldacena (LLM) 几何在 LLM 底空间中一个液滴形成尖点时的临界行为。该尖点是计算 N=4 SYM 理论中巨大 1/2-BPS 算符关联函数的对偶复矩阵模型 (CMM) 中复本征值密度的一个普遍特征。它也与描述纯二维量子引力行为的 CMM 中的临界性有关。其超引力对偶——尖点尖端附近的 LLM 度规——获得一个普适的 ISO(1,3)×SO(5) 对称形式，并沿一条半无限长线存在裸奇点。对于几乎任意碰撞参数，无质量和有质量粒子都会被这条线奇点俘获。终止于该奇异线上的一般轨迹在有限仿射时间内到达，而相应的观察者时间发散。一大类无质量轨迹的显式解析解，以及尖点附近不存在随机行为，暗示该问题具有某种可积性。

English: We study the critical behavior of the Lin-Lunin-Maldacena (LLM) geometry in the case when a droplet in the LLM base space develops a cusp. This cusp is a generic feature of the density of complex eigenvalues in the dual complex matrix model (CMM) computing the correlation functions of huge 1/2-BPS operators in $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM theory. It is also related to the criticality in CMM describing the pure $2D$ quantum gravity behavior. The supergravity dual -- LLM metric in the vicinity of the tip of the cusp -- acquires a universal $ISO(1,3)\times SO(5)$ symmetric form, with a naked singularity along a half-infinite line. Both massless and massive particles get trapped by this line singularity for almost any impact parameter. Generic trajectories ending on the singular line reach it in finite affine time, while the corresponding observer time diverges. An explicit analytic solution for a large class of massless trajectories together with the absence of stochastic behavior in the vicinity of the cusp hint on a certain integrability of the problem.

一句话导读：研究 LLM 液滴出现尖点时的临界几何，其超引力对偶带有裸线奇点并俘获粒子，与复矩阵模型和二维量子引力临界性相关。

Surprisingly, the cancellations persist in all examples with $h^{2,1}=0$, leading us to speculate this conclusion might hold more generally.

中文摘要：本文是 Guarino:2024gke 所给结果的扩展。我们研究最大规范超引力的 G_S-不变子扇区，并表明即使 G_S 不是原超引力的对称性，这类模型也可以提供相容截断。我们证明这一构造是围绕超对称 AdS_D 解构建纯超引力的关键。我们通过构建 D=4、N=8、[SO(6)×SO(1,1)]⋉R^12 规范超引力的一个相容 N=4 子扇区来说明该构造。我们利用这一结果构建 IIB 型中的多荷纺锤解的提升，并给出一个评估提升正则性的简单判据。我们表明纺锤的 IIB 型提升总是非正则的，具有八个余六维轨道折叠奇点。我们将同一判据应用于其他纺锤提升，复现已知结果，并对（准）正则 SE_7 流形上的纺锤正则性作出预测。

English: This paper is an extension of the results presented in \cite{Guarino:2024gke}. We show that this construction is key to building pure supergravities around a supersymmetric AdS$_D$ solution. We use this result to build the uplift of the multicharge spindle solutions in type IIB and we define a simple criterion for assessing the regularity of the uplift. We show that the type IIB uplift of the spindle is always non-regular, admitting eight codimension-six orbifold singularities. We apply the same criterion to other spindle uplifts, recovering known results and making predictions on the regularity of spindles on (quasi-)regular SE$_7$ manifolds.

中文摘要：我们研究一类 M2-膜理论中圆三球面配分函数的大 $N$ 微扰展开，包括带味道的 SYM 和 ABJM 理论，以及更一般的具有对偶 $(p,q)$ 五膜网描述的三维理论。利用费米气体形式和量子曲线技术，我们推导配分函数的 Airy 函数表示，并发现与 [1] 中提出的拓扑弦理论中等变常映射预测精确一致。特别地，我们对环面几何 $\mathbb{C} \times \mathcal{C}$（conifold）、Sasakian 空间 $Q^{1,1,1}$ 上的锥以及 $\mathbb{C} \times \mathrm{SPP}$（suspended pinch point）为该提议提供了肯定检验。受 [2] 中近期猜想的启发，我们进一步提出不同环面 Calabi-Yau 流形之间一种新的等变对应：形式为 $\mathrm{CY}_4 \leftrightarrow \mathbb{C} \times \mathrm{CY}_3$，源自相应量子曲线在特定约束下的关系。该对应暗示了一种等变扩展，并指向拓扑弦/谱理论 (TS/ST) 对应的几何起源，同时为全息对偶的结构提供新见解。

中文摘要：我们研究相对论量子场论中 N-算符的 Magnus 展开；该算符通过 S = e^{iN} 与 S-矩阵相联系。我们发展直接计算 N-算符矩阵元（称为 Magnus 振幅）的方法，完全绕开散射振幅。在树图阶，Magnus 振幅用推迟和超前传播子表示，每个图由我们识别为 Murua 系数的因子加权。在圈图阶，这一结构由 Hadamard 割函数增补，并且我们建立了圈图与树图 Magnus 振幅之间的显著关系。其中，我们发现 n 点单圈 Magnus 振幅完全由 (n+2) 点树图振幅前向极限的相空间积分决定，因此与 Murua 系数相关；并将此推广到一类更高圈贡献。此外，对于通过无质量媒介子相互作用的重粒子情形，我们猜想对经典极限有贡献的 Magnus 图总是由树图的前向极限给出，并在一个单圈例子中明确展示。我们通过研究具有三次相互作用的标量场理论得到这些结果，但方法也适用于一般理论以及引力波计算中出现的积分函数。鉴于 Magnus 振幅不含超经典项，以及已知的 Magnus 振幅与径向作用量之间的关系，我们的结果为从量子场论系统且高效地计算经典可观测量奠定了基础。

English: We investigate the Magnus expansion of the $N$-operator in relativistic quantum field theory, which is related to the $S$-matrix via $S = e^{iN}$. We develop direct methods to compute matrix elements of the $N$-operator, which we refer to as Magnus amplitudes, bypassing scattering amplitudes entirely. At tree level, Magnus amplitudes are expressed in terms of retarded and advanced propagators, with each diagram weighted by factors that we identify as Murua coefficients. At loop level this structure is augmented by the Hadamard cut function, and we establish remarkable relations between loop- and tree-level Magnus amplitudes. Among these, we find that $n$-point one-loop Magnus amplitudes are entirely determined by phase-space integrals of forward limits of $(n{+}2)$-point tree-level amplitudes, and hence related to Murua coefficients, and we generalise this to a class of higher-loop contributions. Furthermore, in the case of heavy particles interacting via massless mediators, we conjecture that Magnus diagrams that contribute to the classical limit are always given by forward limits of trees, and we show this explicitly in a one-loop example. We derive these results studying theories of scalar fields with cubic interactions, but our methods are applicable to general theories as well as to integral functions appearing in gravitational-wave computations. Given that Magnus amplitudes are free of hyper-classical terms, and the known relations between Magnus amplitudes and the radial action, our results lay the groundwork for systematic and efficient calculations of classical observables from quantum field theory.

Using the covariant phase space formalism, we show that the Hamiltonian charges associated with the two asymptotic regions are finite under appropriate scalar boundary conditions. By performing a double Wick rotation to Euclidean signature, we demonstrate that the conformal class of the resulting metric admits an ambi-K\"ahler structure.

Ayanendu Dutta, Nabanita Sarkar · quant-ph, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-06

中文摘要：SU(N) 矩阵模型势 V=-(g^2/4)∑_{I,J}Tr[X_I,X_J]^2 是 BFSS/BMN 家族的相互作用，其热力学大 N 态对偶于黑洞。该势在坐标基下是对角的，文献中将其编译为相位多项式，每个 Trotter 步需要 O(d^2N^4Q^4) 个旋转。对于其所处门类，这一代价接近最优：我们证明，对于一般 Trotter 步，Walsh 支撑 m_min 同时下界任何使用 {CNOT,CZ,CPhase,R_ZZ,SWAP,X,R_z}（包括辅助比特）的电路的旋转数和双量子比特门数，并构造出达到 1.01–1.10 m_min 的奇偶网络。因此改进需要该门类之外的门，而将 V 精确分解为平方对易子项之和可在两个时代各提供这样一种门。对 NISQ，Hadamard：每个平方项被加入一个 Fourier 寄存器并在那里平方，使用 Θ(d^2N^3Q^3) 个双量子比特门。对容错，T：可逆算术，每个平方项一次相位梯度注入，使用 Θ(d^2N^3Q^2) 个 T 门且无需任意角度旋转。两者均被构建和验证。在原生 R_ZZ 下，NISQ 电路在 SU(2) 从 Q=6、SU(5) 从 Q=2 起比每个奇偶网络使用更少的双量子比特门；该 oracle 在所有构建点上（除最小点外）都优于精度匹配的 Hamming-weight-phasing 现有方案，T 计数最多改进 11.9 倍，在等宽度下 surface-code 时空最多改进 25.5 倍。使用相同算术但无分解的消融实验最多多花 21 倍，并在 17 个点中的 15 个点输给该现有方案，因此获胜来自分解而非算术。两种构造在带费米子的 mini-BMN 超对称形变下仍然成立，并且 statevector 模拟器上的完整 Trotter 演化以 2×10^{-12} 的精度重现精确乘积公式。

English: The SU$(N)$ matrix-model potential $V=-\tfrac{g^2}{4}\sum_{I,J}Tr[X_I,X_J]^2$, the interaction of the BFSS/BMN family, whose thermal large-$N$ states are dual to black holes, is diagonal in the coordinate basis and is compiled in the literature as a phase polynomial with $O(d^2N^4Q^4)$ rotations per Trotter step. That cost is close to optimal for its gate class: we show that for a generic Trotter step the Walsh support $m_{\min}$ lower-bounds both the rotation count and the two-qubit count of every circuit over $\{CNOT,CZ,CPhase,R_{ZZ},SWAP,X,R_z\}$, ancillas included, and we build a parity network attaining $1.01$--$1.10\,m_{\min}$. Improvement therefore requires a gate outside that class, and the exact factorisation of $V$ into a sum of squared commutator entries supplies one in each era. For NISQ, Hadamard: each squared entry is added into a Fourier register and squared there, $\Theta(d^2N^3Q^3)$ two-qubit gates. For fault tolerance, $T$: reversible arithmetic with one phase-gradient injection per squared entry, $\Theta(d^2N^3Q^2)$ T gates and no arbitrary-angle rotation. Both are built and verified. With a native $R_{ZZ}$ the NISQ circuit uses fewer two-qubit gates than every parity network from $Q=6$ at SU(2) and $Q=2$ at SU(5); the oracle beats a precision-matched Hamming-weight-phasing incumbent at every point built except the smallest, by up to $11.9\times$ in T count and, at equal width, $25.5\times$ in surface-code spacetime. An ablation with the same arithmetic but no factorisation costs up to $21\times$ more and loses to that incumbent at $15$ of $17$ points, so the factorisation, not the arithmetic, produces the win. Both constructions survive the supersymmetric deformation to mini-BMN with fermions, and complete Trotter evolutions on a statevector simulator reproduce the exact product formula to $2\times10^{-12}$.

一句话导读：提出将 BFSS/BMN 类 SU(N) 矩阵模型势精确分解为平方对易子项之和，实现 NISQ 与容错硬件上的高效量子编译，显著减少 Trotter 演化门数。

准正规模对撞机光谱学

Quasinormal-Mode Collider Spectroscopy

Mian Zhu, Jun Tao, Peng Wang · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-06

中文摘要：黑洞（BH）准正规模编码并合遗迹的性质，并为强场引力提供有力检验。黑洞光谱学此前主要将它们视为独立的线性振荡。非线性铃宕还能揭示这些模式如何相互作用，以及哪些中间态介导其相互作用。受宇宙学对撞机物理启发，我们引入准正规模对撞机光谱学（QCS），一个用于组织和预测非线性黑洞响应的框架。我们建立两个结构性结果。第一，在孤立、非简并的中间极点处，三次应变留数分解为一个激发振幅和一个二次转换系数。该因式分解对输出通道以及二阶初始数据选择施加秩约束，为中间模式描述提供一致性检验。第二，中间极点留数可由其视界和无穷远辐射重构。在一阶场和三阶数据固定时，这一重构可推广到由改变二阶初始数据所产生的完整三次波形差。QCS 因而将低阶辐射与高阶可观测量联系起来，并为探测非线性铃宕的相互作用结构提供框架。

English: Black-hole (BH) quasinormal modes encode the properties of merger remnants and provide powerful tests of strong-field gravity. The BH spectroscopy has predominantly treated them as independent linear oscillations. Nonlinear ringdown can additionally reveal how these modes interact and which intermediate states mediate their interactions. Inspired by cosmological collider physics, we introduce quasinormal-mode collider spectroscopy (QCS), a framework for organizing and predicting nonlinear BH responses. We establish two structural results. First, at an isolated, nondegenerate intermediate pole, a cubic strain residue factorizes into an excitation amplitude and a quadratic conversion coefficient. This factorization imposes rank constraints across output channels and choices of second-order initial data, providing consistency tests of the intermediate-mode description. Second, the intermediate pole residue can be reconstructed from its horizon and infinity radiation. With the first-order field and third-order data held fixed, this reconstruction extends to the full cubic waveform difference generated by changing the second-order initial data. QCS thus connects lower-order radiation to higher-order observables and provides a framework for probing the interaction structure of nonlinear ringdown.

一句话导读：提出准正规模对撞机光谱学框架，用因式分解与留数重构组织非线性黑洞铃宕中的模式相互作用。

带电 de Sitter 黑洞中中性标量 Christodoulou 阈值的四阶导数修正

Four-derivative corrections to the neutral-scalar Christodoulou threshold in charged de Sitter black holes

Reggie C. Pantig · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-06

中文摘要：我们研究了四维带电 de Sitter 黑洞中，对中性、无质量、最小耦合旁观标量的线性 Christodoulou 正则性判据的首个宇称偶四阶导数修正。我们在 Einstein-Maxwell 有效理论中推导了修正后的静态解、冷极值关系、近视界几何、Cauchy 视界表面引力以及中性标量准正规模谱。在冷极值附近，标量方程解析地约化为有限温度的反 de Sitter 二维喉问题。我们发现主导的非静态球对称模式到一阶仍保持其冷极限正则性比，而更高角动量扇区则响应相对喉半径的形变。尽管如此，有限距离中性标量 Christodoulou 边界仍发生移动，因为相关外部标量谱和不相等的视界表面引力进入正则性比。在较小和中等宇宙学尺度，正的有效系数将 Christodoulou 阈值移动到 Cauchy 视界与事件视界之间更大的归一化分离。朝着冷分支中较大的宇宙学尺度部分，相同的系数方向将该阈值移回冷端点。该反转伴随着提供谱隙的准正规模族的转变。我们进一步表明，控制固定电荷极值质量参数的系数组合通常不同于控制冷喉和有限距离中性标量边界的系数组合。因此，极值性并不决定中性标量 Christodoulou 阈值修正的普适方向。我们的结果将宇宙学尺度和谱族竞争确定为在这一旁观扇区中联系有效引力、黑洞极值性和 Cauchy 视界正则性的关键要素。

English: We study leading parity-even four-derivative corrections to the linear Christodoulou regularity criterion for a neutral, massless, minimally coupled spectator scalar in four-dimensional charged de Sitter black holes. We derive the corrected static solution, cold extremality relation, near-horizon geometry, Cauchy-horizon surface gravity, and neutral scalar quasinormal spectrum within Einstein-Maxwell effective theory. Near cold extremality, the scalar equation reduces analytically to the finite-temperature anti-de Sitter two-dimensional throat problem. We find that the dominant nonstationary spherically symmetric mode retains its cold-limit regularity ratio through first order, while higher angular sectors respond to the deformation of the relative throat radii. The finite-distance neutral-scalar Christodoulou boundary nevertheless shifts because the relevant exterior scalar spectrum and the unequal horizon surface gravities enter the regularity ratio. At smaller and intermediate cosmological scales, positive effective coefficients move the Christodoulou threshold to larger normalized separation of the Cauchy and event horizons. Toward the larger cosmological-scale part of the cold branch, the same coefficient directions move that threshold back toward the cold endpoint. The reversal accompanies a transition in the quasinormal family that supplies the spectral gap. We further show that the coefficient combination governing the fixed-charge extremal mass parameter differs generically from those governing the cold throat and the finite-distance neutral-scalar boundary. Extremality therefore does not determine a universal direction for the neutral-scalar Christodoulou-threshold correction. Our results identify cosmological scale and spectral-family competition as essential elements in relating effective gravity, black-hole extremality, and Cauchy-horizon regularity in this spectator sector.

一句话导读：带电 de Sitter 黑洞的四阶导数修正会移动中性标量 Christodoulou 阈值，且移动方向依赖宇宙学尺度和准正规模族，极值性并不给出普适方向。

黑洞标量化中 Ricci 耦合的非线性完备化

Nonlinear completions of the Ricci coupling in black-hole scalarization

Subrat Parida · gr-qc, hep-ph, hep-th, math-ph, math.MP · v1 · 更新 2026-10-06

中文摘要：我们研究标量–Gauss–Bonnet 引力中静态球对称黑洞的自发标量化，其中 Ricci 耦合为 F=1+βφ²/4+γβ²φ⁴+O(φ⁶)，对二次项作了非线性完备化。对于任意耦合和势，我们以闭式导出了近视界正则条件和视界曲率不变量；标量化分支在该条件退化处、于有限视界曲率处终止。弱非线性展开精确固定了分岔方向：对于无质量标量，其控制系数是 β 的二次函数，在 β=1.1156 处变号，并线性依赖于四次自相互作用。在标量取相同视界值时，不同完备化在领头阶的质量差与 γ 成正比。任意耦合下的径向微扰主方程证实了在分岔点和转折点处稳定性的交换。因此，在所研究范围内，径向稳定黑洞的参数区域随 γ 增大而缩小；指数型完备化下的区域比二次截断更小。

English: We study spontaneous scalarization of static, spherically symmetric black holes in scalar--Gauss--Bonnet gravity with a Ricci coupling $F=1 \beta\phi^{2}/4+\gamma\beta^{2}\phi^{4}+O(\phi^{6})$ that nonlinearly completes the quadratic one. For arbitrary couplings and potential, we derive the near-horizon regularity condition and horizon curvature invariants in closed form; scalarized branches terminate where this condition degenerates, at finite horizon curvature. A weakly nonlinear expansion fixes the bifurcation direction exactly: for a massless scalar, its governing coefficient is quadratic in $\beta$, changes sign at $\beta=1.1156$, and depends linearly on a quartic self-interaction. At equal horizon values of the scalar, completions differ in mass, to leading order, in proportion to $\gamma$. A radial-perturbation master equation for arbitrary couplings confirms the exchange of stability at the bifurcation and turning points. Consequently, the domain of radially stable black holes shrinks as $\gamma$ increases over the range studied; it is smaller for the exponential completion than for the quadratic truncation.

一句话导读：该文在标量–Gauss–Bonnet 引力中为 Ricci 耦合加入非线性项，分析黑洞标量化分支、分岔方向、稳定性交换及质量修正。

量子退相干对黑洞阴影可见性与时域回声的影响

Influence of quantum decoherence on black hole shadow visibility and time domain echoes

Sen Guo, Xin Li, Yu Liang, Kai Lin, Li-Fang Li · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-06

中文摘要：黑洞的几何阴影在观测上无法区分无视界奇异致密天体。我们通过将视界的基本量子退相干（Danielson-Satishchandran-Wald 机制）映射为宏观有效反射率 \mathcal{R} 来打破这种简并。利用 Kerr 光线追踪，我们表明部分反射边界（\mathcal{R}>0）在镜面反射和漫反射（Lambertian）条件下都会产生延迟的电磁回声。在空间域中，这些回声照亮内部阴影并改变低频可见度，同时保持由度规控制的光子子环不变。信号强度随膜紧致度 \epsilon 按 \epsilon^\Gamma 标度，其中镜面反射时 \Gamma=0，而由于逃逸锥塌缩，漫反射再发射时 \Gamma\to1。这使镜面反射率降至 \mathcal{R}\simeq0.12（ngEHT）和 0.04（BHEX），处于静态成像可及范围内。对于人马座 A*，我们将这些回声转化为稳健的时域特征。使用自相关函数（ACF）流程，我们证明单耀发回声可以从严重的吸积红噪声中干净地提取，在连续监测 15 至 33 小时内对振幅 \mathcal{A}\gtrsim0.3 实现 3σ 探测。该框架为检验黑洞幺正性提供了一条可直接部署的途径。

English: The geometric shadow of a black hole cannot observationally distinguish horizonless exotic compact objects. We break this degeneracy by mapping the fundamental quantum decoherence of the horizon (the Danielson-Satishchandran-Wald mechanism) into a macroscopic effective reflectivity $\mathcal{R}$. Utilizing Kerr ray tracing, we show that a partially reflective boundary ($\mathcal{R}>0$) generates delayed electromagnetic echoes under both specular and diffuse (Lambertian) conditions. In the spatial domain, these echoes illuminate the inner shadow and alter low-frequency visibilities, while leaving metric-governed photon subrings unchanged. The signal strength scales with the membrane compactness $\epsilon$ as $\epsilon^{\Gamma}$, where $\Gamma=0$ for specular reflection and $\Gamma\to1$ for diffuse re-emission due to escape-cone collapse. This brings specular reflectivities down to $\mathcal{R}\simeq0.12$ (ngEHT) and $0.04$ (BHEX) within reach of static imaging. For Sagittarius A$^\ast$, we translate these echoes into a robust time-domain signature. Using an Autocorrelation Function (ACF) pipeline, we demonstrate that single-flare echoes can be cleanly extracted from severe accretion red noise, achieving a $3\sigma$ detection for amplitudes $\mathcal{A}\gtrsim0.3$ within 15 to 33 hours of continuous monitoring. This framework provides a directly deployable pathway to test black hole unitarity.

一句话导读：将视界量子退相干映射为有效反射率，并用 Kerr 光线追踪与 ACF 时域分析预测黑洞阴影低频可见度变化和可观测回声，以检验黑洞幺正性。

On-shell Homogeneous Curvature Modes in Quadratic $F(R,\mathcal G)$ Cosmology

Francisco Tello-Ortiz, B. Mishra, Y. G\'omez-Leyton, Jean B\'aez Cuevas · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-06

中文摘要：我们研究二次模型 F(R,𝒢)=R+αR^2+β𝒢^2 中的均匀宇宙学扰动。修改后的 Friedmann 方程线性化并结合尘埃守恒，给出均匀 Hubble 扰动的二阶方程，或等价地给出物质对比度的三阶方程。随后，我们将渐近分析限制在满足同一二次理论零阶方程的背景上。除低曲率尘埃支（趋近 H=2/(3t)）外，该模型还允许一个非平凡真空 de Sitter 解，满足 β H_dS^6=1/96。仅当 α<-1/(6H_dS^2) 时，其均匀曲率模式才是稳定的。在高曲率下，背景方程还允许一个真空 big rip 渐近支，起始为 H=7/(t_s-t)；首批修正由二次耦合确定。相应的 𝒢^2 主导扰动有一个发散的均匀模式。同时取 Einstein 极限仅作为一致性检验，并恢复标准尘埃行为。

English: 5We study homogeneous cosmological perturbations in the quadratic model $F(R,\mathcal G)=R+\alpha R^2+\beta\mathcal G^2$. Linearization of the modified Friedmann equation together with dust conservation yields a second-order equation for the homogeneous Hubble perturbation, or equivalently a third-order equation for the matter contrast. We then restrict the asymptotic analysis to backgrounds that satisfy the zeroth-order equations of the same quadratic theory. Besides the low-curvature dust branch, which approaches $H=2/(3t)$, the model admits a nontrivial vacuum de Sitter solution with $\beta H_{\rm dS}^6=1/96$. Its homogeneous curvature modes are stable only when $\alpha<-1/(6H_{\rm dS}^2)$. At high curvature the background equation also admits a vacuum big-rip asymptotic branch beginning with $H=7/(t_s-t)$; the first corrections are fixed by the quadratic couplings. The corresponding $\mathcal G^2$-dominated perturbation has one divergent homogeneous mode. The simultaneous Einstein limit is taken only as a consistency check and recovers the standard dust behavior.

一句话导读：在二次 F(R,𝒢) 宇宙学中分析均匀 Hubble 扰动与物质对比度的渐近演化，并考察低曲率尘埃支、真空 de Sitter 支及高曲率 big rip 支的稳定性。

带电大 D 膜范式中黑洞动力学的局部第二定律

A local second law for black hole dynamics in the charged large-$D$ membrane paradigm

Supratim Halder, Mangesh Mandlik · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-06

中文摘要：大 D 膜范式为黑洞动力学提供了一种微扰的非引力描述。虽然中性膜的局部热力学第二定律已经建立，但在带电大 D 膜框架中显式确定局部熵产生方程仍未解决。本文计算了平直背景下带电黑洞膜速度散度的次领头阶修正。我们通过非仿射零 Raychaudhuri 方程，在物理事件视界上计算相应的标量 Einstein-Maxwell 约束方程，并将物理视界表达式与辅助膜运动学联系起来，证明膜速度在膜世界体积的第一个非零阶产生非负散度，该散度由两个二次形式驱动：膜剪切以及纯 Maxwell 场产生的新贡献。利用这一结果，我们构造了膜熵流，并证明其散度到该阶非负，从而建立了带电大 D 膜范式的局部第二定律。

English: The large-$D$ membrane paradigm provides a perturbative, non-gravitational description of black hole dynamics. While the local second law of thermodynamics has been established for neutral membranes, the explicit determination of the local entropy production equation within the charged large-$D$ membrane framework remains unsolved. In this paper, we compute the subleading-order correction to the divergence of the membrane velocity for a charged black hole in a flat background. We evaluate the corresponding scalar Einstein-Maxwell constraint equation at the physical event horizon via the non-affine null Raychaudhuri equation, and relate the physical horizon expressions to the auxiliary membrane kinematics, demonstrating that the membrane velocity produces a non-negative divergence at the first non-vanishing order in the membrane worldvolume, which is driven by two quadratic forms: the membrane shear and a novel contribution generated purely by the Maxwell field. Using this result, we construct the membrane entropy current and prove that its divergence is non-negative through this order, thereby establishing the local second law for the charged large-$D$ membrane paradigm.

一句话导读：在带电大 D 膜范式中计算膜速度散度的次领头阶修正，并构造具有非负散度的熵流，证明局部第二定律。

Black Hole Entropy and Holographic Entanglement Entropy in DGP Brane Gravity

Takamasa Kanai · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-06

中文摘要：我们研究引力熵与全息纠缠熵在膜世界引力中的关系，其中引力动力学定域在膜上。首先考虑DGP膜模型，即在膜作用量中包含Einstein-Hilbert项，推导膜世界黑洞的引力熵与全息纠缠熵一致所需的条件。我们表明，当涉及膜外曲率的一个特定条件满足时，两种熵相等；特别地，该条件对静态构型自动满足。随后将膜局域Einstein-Hilbert项推广到高阶曲率引力理论。对于膜上的Lovelock引力和$f(R)$引力，我们推导引力熵与全息纠缠熵相等对应的条件，并表明它们与Einstein引力所得形式相同。尽管对一般稳态构型等式并不保证成立，但所需条件对静态膜世界黑洞满足，从而使两种熵一致。这些结果阐明了膜世界引力中引力熵与全息纠缠熵的关系，并有助于更深入理解膜世界设定中的全息。

English: We investigate the relation between gravitational entropy and holographic entanglement entropy in braneworld gravity with gravitational dynamics localized on the brane. We first consider the DGP brane model, in which an Einstein-Hilbert term is included in the brane action, and derive the condition under which the gravitational entropy of a braneworld black hole agrees with the holographic entanglement entropy. We show that the two entropies coincide when a specific condition involving the extrinsic curvature of the brane is satisfied. In particular, this condition is automatically satisfied for static configurations. We then generalize the brane-localized Einstein-Hilbert term to higher-curvature gravitational theories. For Lovelock gravity and $f(R)$ gravity on the brane, we derive the corresponding conditions for the equality between gravitational entropy and holographic entanglement entropy and show that they take the same form as that obtained for Einstein gravity. Although the equality is not guaranteed for general stationary configurations, the required condition is satisfied for static braneworld black holes, leading to an agreement between the two entropies. These results clarify the relation between gravitational entropy and holographic entanglement entropy in braneworld gravity and contribute to a deeper understanding of holography in braneworld settings.

一句话导读：在DGP等膜世界引力中，黑洞的引力熵与全息纠缠熵在静态膜世界黑洞构型下满足特定外曲率条件时相等。

Palatini 与度量仿射 f(R) 引力中宇宙学膜世界的全局一致性

Global Consistency of Cosmological Braneworlds in Palatini and Metric-Affine f(R) Gravity

Paulo Michel L. T da Silva · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-06

中文摘要：我们研究 Palatini 与度量仿射引力中五维弯曲膜世界的全局一致性条件。从广义 Gibbons-Kallosh-Linde 框架出发，我们推导了宇宙学弯曲几何的积分求和规则，并考察独立联络自由度如何改变标准 Einstein 引力对光滑紧致膜世界的障碍。分析将几何、物质和非黎曼贡献分开，并澄清了通常 no-go 结果可被修改的条件。我们证明广义一致性关系为允许构型提供了必要的全局约束，并确定了导致偏离黎曼情形可能的项。结果建立了一个系统性框架，用于检验具有独立仿射结构的引力理论中光滑五维膜世界的全局一致性。

English: We investigate global consistency conditions for five-dimensional warped braneworlds in Palatini and metric-affine gravity. Starting from the generalized Gibbons-Kallosh-Linde framework, we derive integrated sum rules for cosmological warped geometries and examine how independent connection degrees of freedom modify the standard Einstein-gravity obstruction to smooth compact braneworlds. The analysis separates geometric, matter, and non-Riemannian contributions and clarifies the conditions under which the usual no-go result can be modified. We show that the generalized consistency relations provide necessary global constraints on admissible configurations and identify the terms responsible for possible departures from the Riemannian case. The results establish a systematic framework for testing the global consistency of smooth five-dimensional braneworlds in gravitational theories with independent affine structure.

一句话导读：研究 Palatini/度量仿射 f(R) 引力下五维弯曲膜世界的全局一致性条件与求和规则，分析非黎曼联络如何改变 Einstein 引力对光滑紧致膜世界的障碍。

Einstein-Maxwell 求和规则与光滑膜禁戒定理的持续

Einstein--Maxwell Sum Rules and the Persistence of the Smooth-Brane No-Go Theorem

Paulo Michel Longo Tavares da Silva · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-06

中文摘要：我们研究最小耦合阿贝尔 Maxwell 部门是否能够缓解 Gibbons-Kallosh-Linde (GKL) 对五维光滑翘曲膜世界的阻碍。对于与体 Maxwell 场耦合的正则标量场，我们在将切向 F_{\mu\nu} 和混合 F_{\mu5} 部门分开的情况下，推导了单参数族整体一致性条件。这种分解至关重要，因为 Maxwell 应力张量在五维中并非无迹。我们表明电磁项在形式上修正了积分 GKL 约束，但在标准假设下这种修正不能提供对禁戒定理的一致规避。精确的四维 Poincaré 不变性排除了背景中非零确定性经典 Maxwell 场，因为其场强会选出优先的四维方向。因此 Maxwell 部门在对称背景中消失，通常的光滑膜阻碍重新出现。我们还指出了哪些假设必须被放松才能得到非平庸的电磁贡献，并将此背景结果与体规范场局域化的局域一致性条件区分开。

English: We investigate whether a minimally coupled Abelian Maxwell sector can relax the Gibbons--Kallosh--Linde (GKL) obstruction to smooth five-dimensional warped braneworlds. For a canonical scalar field coupled to a bulk Maxwell field, we derive the one-parameter family of global consistency conditions while keeping the tangential F_{{\mu}{\nu}} and mixed F_{{\mu}5} sectors separate. This decomposition is essential because the Maxwell stress tensor is not traceless in five dimensions. We show that electromagnetic terms formally modify the integrated GKL constraints, but this modification does not provide a consistent evasion of the no-go theorem under the standard assumptions. Exact four-dimensional Poincar\'e invariance excludes a nonzero deterministic classical Maxwell field from the background, since its field strength would select preferred four-dimensional directions. The Maxwell sector therefore vanishes in the symmetric background and the usual smooth-brane obstruction is recovered. We also identify which assumptions must be relaxed for a nontrivial electromagnetic contribution and distinguish this background result from local consistency conditions for bulk gauge-field localization.

一句话导读：在标准假设下，阿贝尔 Maxwell 场不能规避五维光滑翘曲膜世界的 GKL 禁戒定理。

N=8 超引力中天球软对称代数的进一步研究

More on the Celestial Soft Symmetry Algebra in the ${\cal N}=8$ Supergravity

Changhyun Ahn · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-06

中文摘要：我们构造了 ${\cal N}=8$ 超引力中（由反全纯光变换得到的）${\cal N}=8$ ${\rm w}_{1+\infty}$ 流与物质场的算子乘积展开（OPEs）。利用上述 OPE，通过双重围道积分得到相应的（反）对易子。通过计算由流-流-物质组成的三重（反）对易子（即固定最后一个元素的 Jacobi 恒等式），复现了先前已知的、这些流之间（在反全纯部分）的 ${\cal N}=8$ 天球软对称代数。我们对全纯光变换以及 ${\cal N}=8$ ${\rm \bar{w}}_{1+\infty}$ 流与物质场的 OPE 重复上述过程，得到相应的（反）对易子。我们还得到这些流之间（在全纯部分）的另一类 ${\cal N}=8$ 天球软对称代数。作为反全纯与全纯部分中的子代数，存在 ${\cal N}=8$ 扩展 BMS（Bondi、van der Burg、Metzner 和 Sachs，1962）代数。我们从反全纯（或全纯）部分中的 ${\cal N}=8$ 共形{\it 软} ${\rm w}_{1+\infty}$（或 ${\rm \bar{w}}_{1+\infty}$）流来分析上述结果。描述了引力子、引力微子和引力光子的非平凡软定理。最后，利用 shadow 变换（全纯与反全纯光变换的连续复合），我们得到 ${\cal N}=8$ {\it shadow} ${\rm w}_{1+\infty}$（或 ${\rm \bar{w}}_{1+\infty}$）流与物质场的 OPE，其中识别出 ${\cal N}=8$ 扩展 BMS 代数的应力-能量张量、超流（supercurrents）和超平移生成元。

English: We construct the operator product expansions (OPEs) of the ${\cal N}=8$ ${\rm w}_{1+\infty}$ currents (obtained from the antiholomorphic light transform) with the matter fields in the ${\cal N}=8$ supergravity. The corresponding (anti)commutators are obtained from the double contour integrals using the above OPEs. By computing the triple (anti)commutators consisting of current-current-matter (i.e., the Jacobi identity for fixed last element), the previously known ${\cal N}=8$ celestial soft symmetry algebra between these currents (in the antiholomorphic sector) is reproduced. We repeat the above procedure by taking the holomorphic light transform and the OPEs of the ${\cal N}=8$ ${\rm \bar{w}}_{1+\infty}$ currents with the matter fields and the corresponding (anti)commutators are obtained. We also obtain another type of ${\cal N}=8$ celestial soft symmetry algebra between these currents (in the holomorphic sector). As a subalgebra in the antiholomorphic and holomorphic sectors, there exists the ${\cal N}=8$ extended BMS (Bondi, van der Burg, Metzner, and Sachs in 1962) algebra. We analyze the above results from the ${\cal N}=8$ conformally {\it soft} ${\rm w}_{1+\infty}$ (or ${\rm \bar{w}}_{1+\infty}$) currents in the antiholomorphic (or holomorphic) sector. The nontrivial soft theorems for the graviton, the gravitinos and the graviphotons are described. Finally, using the shadow transform (the consecutive composition of holomorphic and antiholomorphic light transforms), we obtain the OPEs of the ${\cal N}=8$ {\it shadow} ${\rm w}_{1+\infty}$ (or ${\rm \bar{w}}_{1+\infty}$) currents with the matter fields where the stress-energy tensor, the supercurrents and the supertranslation generator of the ${\cal N}=8$ extended BMS algebra are identified.

一句话导读：本文通过 N=8 超引力中 w_{1+∞} 流与物质场的 OPE 与三重（反）对易子，构造全纯/反全纯天球软对称代数，并识别其 N=8 扩展 BMS 子代数及软定理、shadow 变换结构。

从非极端近地平展开得到极端黑洞喉部

Extremal black hole throats from non extremal near horizon expansions

Anirudhda Shinde, Mangesh Mandlik · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-06

中文摘要：我们展示了，对于具有光滑极端极限的光滑稳态黑洞族，如何从非极端近地平展开恢复极端近地平几何。在族共有的 Gaussian null 坐标中，我们对表面引力作近极端缩放，并结合径向缩放和 Killing 时间重标度。尽管物理表面引力消失，缩放后的地平可以保留有限表面引力。当这一缩放表面引力趋于零时，就得到极端近地平几何。在近极端缩放和时间重标度下，时间度规分量中的二次径向项可以存活，而更高径向阶消失。因此，展开到二阶既充分，又在所选图中二次项具有非零极限系数时必要。我们推导了用于提取近地平系数的统一拉回方案，并恢复了 Reissner-Nordström、Kerr、Kerr-Newman 以及带电旋转 Bañados-Teitelboim-Zanelli (BTZ) 黑洞的已知喉部。中性旋转 BTZ 提供了一个弦 Carroll 展开已经足够的例子。

English: We show how extremal near horizon geometries can be recovered from the non extremal near horizon expansion for smooth stationary black hole families admitting a smooth extremal limit. In Gaussian null coordinates common to the family, we apply the near extremal scaling of the surface gravity together with a radial scaling and a rescaling of Killing time. Although the physical surface gravity vanishes, the scaled horizon can retain a finite surface gravity. The extremal near horizon geometry is obtained when this scaled surface gravity is taken to zero. Under the near extremal scaling and the time rescaling, the quadratic radial term in the temporal metric component can survive, while higher radial orders vanish. Expansion through second order is therefore sufficient and is necessary whenever the quadratic term has a nonzero limiting coefficient in the chosen chart. We derive a common pullback prescription for extracting the near horizon coefficients and recover the known throats of Reissner-Nordstr\"om, Kerr, Kerr-Newman, and charged rotating Ba\~nados-Teitelboim-Zanelli (BTZ) black holes. Neutral rotating BTZ provides a case in which the string Carroll expansion already suffices.

一句话导读：该文建立坐标缩放与拉回方法，从非极端近地平展开恢复极端黑洞近地平喉部几何。

从临界零模到全息超导体的内部动力学

From Critical Zero Modes to Interior Dynamics in Holographic Superconductors

Yan Liu, Hong-Da Lyu · hep-th, cond-mat.str-el, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-06

中文摘要：我们研究全息超导体的临界行为如何控制带电黑洞的内部几何。尽管外部凝聚在临界点消失，临界零模在Reissner-Nordström Cauchy视界附近产生对数振荡，使得内部临界极限非一致。我们表明，透射的临界模振幅与局部Cauchy视界量共同决定了主导的Einstein-Rosen坍缩宽度Δz_ER以及后续Josephson区域中的相位Θ_J。若凝聚满足 t≡1-T/T_c∝ε^{2r}，则 Δz_ER∝t^{1/r}，Θ_J∝t^{-1/r}。该Josephson相位被转移到第一个Kasner epoch，产生振荡的Kasner指数以及标量速度相继零点的累积律 t_n∼n^{-r}。临界零模确定了主导坍缩和相位系数，并在普通和三临界情形下由完全非线性解定量证实。在低温下，内部则依赖于零温几何的红外完成。因此，近临界标度由临界模透射控制，而低温行为由红外端点控制。

English: We study how the critical behavior of holographic superconductors controls the interior geometry of charged black holes. Although the exterior condensate vanishes at criticality, the critical zero mode develops logarithmic oscillations near the Reissner--Nordstr\"om Cauchy horizon, rendering the interior critical limit nonuniform. We show that the transmitted critical-mode amplitude, together with local Cauchy-horizon quantities, fixes both the leading Einstein--Rosen collapse $\Delta z_{\rm ER}$ width and the phase $\Theta_J$ in the subsequent Josephson regime. If the condensate obeys $t\equiv1-T/T_c\propto\epsilon^{2r}$, then $\Delta z_{\rm ER}\propto t^{1/r}$ and $\Theta_J\propto t^{-1/r}$. This Josephson phase is transferred to the first Kasner epoch, producing oscillatory Kasner exponents and an accumulation law $t_n\sim n^{-r}$ for successive zeros of the scalar velocity. The critical zero mode fixes the leading collapse and phase coefficients, which are quantitatively confirmed by fully nonlinear solutions in both the ordinary and tricritical cases. At low temperature, the interior instead depends on the infrared completion of the zero-temperature geometry. Thus near-critical scaling is governed by critical-mode transmission, whereas the low-temperature behavior is controlled by the infrared endpoint.

一句话导读：全息超导临界零模通过透射控制带电黑洞内部ER坍缩与Josephson/Kasner动力学，低温行为则由红外端点决定。

2+1维引力中的Wald熵与Wen-Zee型规范-曲率耦合

Wald entropy and Wen-Zee type gauge-curvature coupling in 2+1-dimensional gravity

Aryan Bhatia, Giandomenico Palumbo, Suraj S. Hegde · hep-th, cond-mat.mes-hall, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-06

中文摘要：Wen-Zee项是量子霍尔流体的拓扑Chern-Simons描述中的一种混合规范-曲率耦合，编码了束缚于空间曲率的电荷。我们研究该耦合的洛伦兹协变化推广，将其范围扩展至黑洞时空，并确定其对视界熵的贡献。此类耦合自然出现在基于Maxwell代数的三维Chern-Simons引力中。我们证明其Wald熵贡献是一个视界助推荷，由附加规范场沿分叉圆切向投影的环路积分给出。即使混合项在壳消失，该贡献也可以非零。当投影方向协变常时，该积分具有Abelian holonomy解释。我们在平直宇宙学解上计算该荷，并利用光滑视界场和指定热系综在AdS-Lorentz黑洞上计算该荷。这些结果将量子霍尔物理中熟悉的几何响应与引力视界热力学联系起来。

English: The Wen-Zee term is a mixed gauge-curvature coupling in the topological Chern-Simons description of a quantum Hall fluid, encoding the electric charge bound to spatial curvature. We investigate a Lorentz-covariant generalisation of this coupling, expanding its scope to black-hole spacetimes and determine its contribution to horizon entropy. Such a coupling arises naturally in three-dimensional Chern-Simons gravity based on the Maxwell algebra. We show that its Wald entropy contribution is a horizon boost charge, given by a loop integral of the additional gauge field projected along the tangent to the bifurcation circle. This contribution can be nonzero even when the mixed term vanishes on shell. We show that the integral admits an Abelian holonomy interpretation when the projection direction is covariantly constant. We evaluate the charge on a flat cosmological solution and, using smooth horizon fields and a specified thermal ensemble, on an AdS-Lorentz black hole. These results connect the geometric response familiar from quantum Hall physics to gravitational horizon thermodynamics.

一句话导读：在2+1维Chern-Simons引力中，Wen-Zee型混合规范-曲率耦合对Wald熵的贡献表现为视界助推荷，并在平直宇宙学解与AdS-Lorentz黑洞上计算。

最大对称空间中线性化引力的高形式对称性

Higher-form Symmetries of Linearized Gravity in Maximally Symmetric Spaces

Natsuya Kido · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-06

中文摘要：我们将最大对称时空上的引力场表述为规范理论，并通过对牛顿引力常数作级数展开来研究线性化引力场的高形式对称性。为了把引力作为规范理论处理，采用了基于 Cartan 几何的 MacDowell-Mansouri 表述。我们证明了闵可夫斯基时空上线性化引力中 1-形式对称性的存在。此外，对于具有小宇宙学常数的其他最大对称时空（de Sitter 和 anti-de Sitter 时空），我们证明了相应线性化引力中存在近似的 1-形式对称性，并详细给出了其对宇宙学常数的显式依赖。

English: We formulate the gravitational field on maximally symmetric spacetimes as a gauge theory, and investigate higher-form symmetries of the linearized gravitational field via a series expansion in Newton's gravitational constant. To treat gravity as a gauge theory, the MacDowell-Mansouri formulation based on Cartan geometry is utilized. We show the existence of a 1-form symmetry in linearized gravity on Minkowski spacetime. Furthermore, for other maximally symmetric spacetimes (de Sitter and anti-de Sitter spacetimes) with a small cosmological constant, we demonstrate the existence of an approximate 1-form symmetry in the corresponding linearized gravity, detailing its explicit dependence on the cosmological constant.

一句话导读：将最大对称时空中的线性化引力表述为基于 Cartan 几何的 MacDowell-Mansouri 规范理论，并发现闵氏时空中的 1-形式对称性及 dS/AdS 小宇宙学常数下的近似 1-形式对称性。

M2-膜 SCFT 的 Wilson 线缺陷指标

Wilson line defect indices for M2-brane SCFTs

Hirotaka Hayashi, Tomoki Nosaka, Tadashi Okazaki · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-06

中文摘要：我们研究 3d N≥4 超对称规范理论中的线缺陷 Coulomb 和 Higgs 指标。由修饰缺陷指标与普通指标之比定义的归一化线缺陷指标给出良好定义的整数值，即在单位 R-荷逸度极限下的线缺陷 Witten 指标。我们为无 Chern-Simons 项的理论提出 Coulomb 和 Higgs 极限下这些 Witten 指标的通用公式，并证明二者都计数在分支一般点处残余规范群下不变的态，该残余规范群由真空方程读出。此外，我们在描述 M2-膜的 3d SCFT（包括 ADHM 型理论和 ABJ(M) 理论）中，发现 Wilson 线缺陷 Coulomb 指标的强有力代数递推关系。这些关系意味着更高阶线缺陷指标由低阶数据递归决定，适用于 U(N)、USp(2N)、SO(2N) 和 SO(2N+1) ADHM 型理论以及 ABJ(M) 理论。

English: We investigate line defect Coulomb and Higgs indices in 3d $\mathcal{N}\ge 4$ supersymmetric gauge theories. The normalized line defect indices defined by ratios of the decorated defect indices to the ordinary indices yield well-defined integer values, the line defect Witten indices in the unit R-charge fugacity limit. We propose general formulae for these Witten indices in both Coulomb and Higgs limits for the theories without Chern-Simons terms, and we show that both count the states invariant under the residual gauge group left unbroken at a generic point of the branch, which we read off from the vacuum equations. Furthermore, we find powerful algebraic recursion relations for Wilson line defect Coulomb indices in the 3d SCFTs describing M2-branes, including ADHM-type theories and ABJ(M) theories. These relations imply that higher rank line defect indices are recursively determined by lower rank data across $U(N)$, $USp(2N)$, $SO(2N)$ and $SO(2N+1)$ ADHM-type theories and ABJ(M) theories.

一句话导读：研究 3d N≥4 规范理论中 Wilson 线缺陷的 Coulomb/Higgs 指标，并在 M2-膜 SCFT 中发现递推关系。

Matthew Headrick, Sreeman Reddy Kasireddy, Andrew Rolph · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-06

中文摘要：纠缠熵在全息中起核心作用。量子极值面（QES）公式是在动力学与体量子修正都重要的情形（如黑洞蒸发）中的标准工具。我们推导并探索了与 QES 等价的方案——量子协变比特线——它用体的极小或极大流，而不是极值面，来表述全息纠缠熵。与经典协变比特线一样，我们的方案有两种类型：（通常）类空的 V-流和类时的 U-流。为了计入体量子修正，流线可以在体中的点开始和结束，端点的分布由体纠缠熵控制。在我们的比特线语言中，QES 是流的量子瓶颈，一些线穿过它（对应广义熵中的面积项），另一些线跳过它（对应熵项）。我们的方案为 QES 公式提供了互补视角，并为黑洞蒸发、岛和婴儿宇宙等重要现象提供了新见解。

English: Entanglement entropy plays a central role in holography. The quantum extremal surface (QES) formula is the standard tool in settings where both dynamics and bulk quantum corrections are important, such as in black hole evaporation. We derive and explore QES-equivalent prescriptions --- quantum covariant bit threads --- that formulate holographic entanglement entropy in terms of minimal or maximal bulk flows rather than extremal surfaces. Like classical covariant bit threads, our prescriptions come in two types: (typically) spacelike V-flows, and timelike U-flows. To account for bulk quantum corrections, the flow lines can start and end at points in the bulk, with the distribution of endpoints controlled by bulk entanglement entropies. In our bit thread language, the QES is a quantum bottleneck to the flow, with some threads passing through it (accounting for the area term in the generalized entropy) and others jumping across it (accounting for the entropy term). Our prescriptions provide a complementary perspective to the QES formula and offer new insights on important phenomena such as black hole evaporation, islands, and baby universes.

一句话导读：提出量子协变比特线方案，用体的极小/极大流等价表述量子极值面与全息纠缠熵，并将 QES 视为流的量子瓶颈。

中文摘要：暗物质核心与偏软的核物质状态方程可以产生相似的质量—半径特征，这促使人们通过 f-模式谱进行互补探测。我们在完整广义相对论下计算了冷、非转动、且掺入自相互作用玻色暗物质（DM）中子星的四极 f-模式频率和引力波阻尼时间。我们的双流体扫描涵盖 21 个核物质状态方程，覆盖核子、超子、Δ 混杂以及超子—Δ 组合成分，暗物质分数 F_DM=1%–20%。主要序列对核心和晕研究分别采用 λ=π 以及 500 和 100 MeV 的玻色子质量。独立的正常物质（NM）和暗物质位移通过度规耦合，产生 NM 主导和 DM 主导的 f-模式分支，其辐射阻尼由出射波边界条件决定。在 1.4 M⊙ 处，核心 DM 主导的阻尼时间从 F_DM=1% 时的约 10^3 s 降至 20% 时的约 1 s，大致遵循经验性的 F_DM^{-2} 依赖；而 NM 主导的阻尼时间保持在 0.12–0.33 s 内。晕中 DM 主导的阻尼反而随暗物质分数增加：在相同恒星质量和 F_DM=20% 时，暗半径接近 88 km，频率降至 0.14 kHz，阻尼时间达到约 450 s。部分高质量核心序列表现出 DM 主导阻尼时间的强烈上折，而领先的质量四极诊断无法再现。代表性核心计算显示 DM 主导模式对玻色子自耦合更敏感，并且在 ℓ=3 时仍保留两个分支。在所采用的非转动、圆轨道双星近似下，没有评估的构型满足受控线性潮汐共振所需的全部几何和微扰条件。

English: A dark-matter core and a soft nuclear equation of state can produce similar mass--radius signatures, motivating a complementary probe through the $f$-mode spectrum. We compute quadrupolar $f$-mode frequencies and gravitational-wave damping times in full general relativity for cold, nonrotating neutron stars admixed with self-interacting bosonic dark matter (DM). Our two-fluid survey spans 21 nuclear equations of state covering nucleonic, hyperonic, $\Delta$-admixed, and combined hyperon--$\Delta$ compositions at $F_{\rm DM}=1$--$20\%$. The main sequences use $\lambda=\pi$ and boson masses of $500$ and $100\,\mathrm{MeV}$ for the core and halo studies, respectively. Independent normal-matter (NM) and DM displacements couple through the metric, yielding NM-led and DM-led $f$-mode branches whose radiative damping is determined by outgoing-wave boundary conditions. At $1.4\,M_\odot$, the core DM-led damping time decreases from order $10^3\,\mathrm{s}$ at $F_{\rm DM}=1\%$ to order $1\,\mathrm{s}$ at $20\%$, approximately following an empirical $F_{\rm DM}^{-2}$ dependence, while NM-led damping times remain within $0.12$--$0.33\,\mathrm{s}$. Halo DM-led damping instead increases with dark fraction: at the same stellar mass and $F_{\rm DM}=20\%$, dark radii approach $88\,\mathrm{km}$, frequencies fall to $0.14\,\mathrm{kHz}$, and damping times reach approximately $450\,\mathrm{s}$. Selected high-mass core sequences exhibit strong DM-led damping-time upturns not reproduced by the leading mass-quadrupole diagnostic. Representative core calculations show greater DM-led sensitivity to the bosonic self-coupling and retain both branches at $\ell=3$. Under the adopted nonrotating, circular-binary prescriptions, no evaluated configuration satisfies all geometric and perturbative conditions for a controlled linear tidal resonance.

中文摘要：我们研究由宇宙学一阶相变中产生的超重暗物质（DM）衰变而来的高能中微子（HEνs）。采用过滤暗物质产生机制，我们结合从流体力学确定气泡壁速度的最新进展，重新考察了遗迹丰度计算。我们表明，质量 m_DM≈4.4×10^8 GeV 的暗物质可以再现观测到的遗迹丰度，并容纳如 KM3-230213A 这样的超高能中微子事件，而同一相变同时产生随机引力波（GW）背景。尽管在此例子中 GW 信号（峰值在 10^4 Hz）尚不可观测，但在较低 DM 质量 m_DM≲10^6 GeV 时，中微子谱移入与 IceCube 观测相关的能量范围，同时相关 GW 信号移到较低频率，并可达到 Cosmic Explorer、BBO 和 DECIGO 的预期灵敏度。这给出了 HEνs 与 GWs 之间的多信使联系，两种信号都与一阶相变中的 DM 产生相关。

English: We investigate high energy neutrinos (HE$\nu$s) from the decay of superheavy dark matter (DM) produced during a cosmological first order phase transition. Adopting the filtered DM production mechanism, we revisit the relic abundance calculation by incorporating recent progress in determining the bubble wall velocity from hydrodynamics. We show that DM with mass $m_{\text{DM}}\simeq 4.4\times10^{8}~\text{GeV}$ can reproduce the observed relic abundance and accommodate ultra high energy neutrino events such as KM3-230213A, while the same phase transition simultaneously generates a stochastic gravitational wave (GW) background. Although the GW signal (which peaks at $10^{4}\,\text{Hz}$) is not yet observable in this example, at lower DM masses $m_{\text{DM}} \lesssim10^{6}~\text{GeV}$, the neutrino spectrum shifts into the energy range relevant for IceCube observations, while the associated GW signal moves to lower frequencies and can reach the projected sensitivities of Cosmic Explorer, BBO, and DECIGO. This gives a multimessenger connection between HE$\nu$s and GWs, with both signals connected to DM production in a first order phase transition.

一句话导读：一阶宇宙相变中过滤产生的超重暗物质可同时解释超高能中微子事件并产生随机引力波信号，形成暗物质-中微子-引力波多信使联系。

Peshwaz Abdulkareem Abdoul · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-05

中文摘要：我们研究了对数非线性电动力学（LNED）中静态、带电、渐近平直黑洞在 (Q, ε) 参数空间中的性质。我们区分了三种相结构：视界几何、背景圆形零轨道，以及有效光学几何的圆形光子轨道。它们都共享一个零半径边界 Q_nc(ε;M)=γ M^{2/3} ε^{1/6}，但具有不同的临界结构：极值曲线 Q_ext(ε;M) 和背景合并曲线 Q_m(ε;M) 都终止于位于 r=0 的分岔点 (Q_b, ε_b)。相反，有效光子轨道合并曲线 Q_m^{ph}(ε;M) 不经过该点。对于 ε≥ε_b，趋近 Q_nc 会使视界收缩到零半径，形成具有非零、量子修正熵的黑点。它们的霍金温度在分岔点消失，并在 ε>ε_b 时发散，除非 ηδ=1；此时分岔点的温度也发散。背景势 V_eff^{bg}(r) 在 r=0 处形成无限势垒，且没有局域极值，表现为完美排斥体。相比之下，光子势 V_eff^{ph}(r) 被正则化，并在有限半径处有一个最大值，表现为部分反射体。因此，这些黑点仍保留有限半径的光子球。远离 Q_nc 时，对于 ε<ε_b，两种几何都支持高于 Q_ext 的无视界结构；对于 ε≥ε_b，只有光学几何在 Q_nc<Q<Q_m^{ph} 区域支持无视界结构。非径向测地线被阻止到达奇点，并可形成亚稳束缚态，而径向测地线要么到达 r=0，要么逃逸到无穷远。临界碰撞参数同时编码了引力几何和光学几何效应，从而探测这些不同的相结构。

English: We investigate static, charged, asymptotically flat black holes in logarithmic nonlinear electrodynamics (LNED) within the $(Q,\epsilon)$ parameter space. We distinguish three phase structures: the horizon geometry, the background circular null orbits, and the circular photon orbits of the effective optical geometry. All share a zero-radius boundary $Q_{nc}(\epsilon;M)=\gamma M^{2/3}\epsilon^{1/6}$, but possess distinct critical structures: the extremal curve $Q_{ext}(\epsilon;M)$ and the background merger curve $Q_{m}(\epsilon;M)$ both terminate at the bifurcation point $(Q_{b},\epsilon_{b})$, located at $r=0$. In contrast, the effective photon-orbit merger curve $Q_{m}^{ph}(\epsilon;M)$ does not pass through this point. For $\epsilon\ge\epsilon_{b}$, approaching $Q_{nc}$ shrinks the horizon to zero radius, resulting in black points with non-zero, quantum-corrected entropy. Their Hawking temperature vanishes at the bifurcation point and diverges for $\epsilon>\epsilon_{b}$, except when $\eta\delta=1$, where the temperature at the bifurcation point also diverges. The background potential $V_{eff}^{bg}(r)$ develops an infinite barrier at $r=0$ without local extrema, acting as a perfect repeller. In contrast, the photon potential $V_{eff}^{ph}(r)$ is regularized with a maximum at a finite radius, acting as a partial reflector. Consequently, the black points retain photon spheres of finite radius. Away from $Q_{nc}$, for $\epsilon<\epsilon_{b}$, both geometries support horizonless structures above $Q_{ext}$; for $\epsilon\ge\epsilon_{b}$, only the optical geometry does so in the region $Q_{nc}<Q<Q_{m}^{ph}$. Non-radial geodesics are blocked from the singularity and can form metastable bound states, while radial geodesics either reach $r=0$ or escape to infinity. The critical impact parameter encodes both gravitational and optical-geometry effects, probing the distinct phase structures.

一句话导读：在LNED黑洞的(Q,ε)参数空间中，视界、背景零轨道和有效光学光子轨道具有不同临界结构；黑点可保留有限半径光子球，临界碰撞参数可区分这些相。

Fernando Ruiz Ruiz · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-05

中文摘要：本文明确计算了若干渐近 AdS 空间中的类时奇点以及负质量 Schwarzschild 黑洞的引力能量。在所有考虑的情形中，能量均为有限且为正，依赖于奇点周围的几何，并抵消来自渐近边界的负能量贡献，从而使总引力能量为正。所用能量定义是 Hawking 和 Horowitz 提出的物理经典作用量的壳上哈密顿量。为处理奇点，用一个包围奇点的类时调节边界截断时空，该边界与按常时切片进行的时空叶状分层相容。结果表明，具有类时 Kasner 奇点的静态 AdS-Kasner 解的总能量等于平面 AdS 黑洞的能量，而负质量 Schwarzschild 黑洞具有与 Minkowski 空间相同的能量。

English: The gravitational energies of timelike singularities in some asymptotically AdS spaces and in the Schwarzschild black hole with negative mass are explicitly computed. In all cases considered, the energy is finite and positive, depends on the geometry around the singularity, and compensates negative energy contributions from the asymptotic boundary, rendering the total gravitational energy positive. The definition used for energy is the on-shell Hamiltonian of the physical classical action proposed by Hawking and Horowitz~\cite{Hawking-Horowitz}. To deal with the singularity, spacetime is cut off by a timelike regulating boundary surrounding the singularity that is compatible with a foliation of spacetime in constant-time slices. It is shown that the total energy of static AdS-Kasner solutions with timelike Kasner singularities is equal to the energy of the planar AdS black hole, and that the Schwarzschild black hole with negative mass has the same energy as Minkowski space.

纯 Lovelock 黑洞的 Hawking-Page 相变

Hawking-Page phase transition for pure Lovelock black holes

Nitesh K. Dubey, Sanved Kolekar · gr-qc, hep-th, quant-ph · v2 · 更新 2026-10-05

中文摘要：我们研究静态、球对称反德西特（AdS）黑洞的热力学性质，重点考察特征温度之间的相互关系，以及 Hawking-Page（HP）相变处 Ruppeiner 标量曲率的普适性。特别地，我们研究纯 Lovelock 引力中静态球对称 AdS 黑洞的最低温度与 HP 相变温度之间的关系。对于 Einstein 引力中的电磁中性情形，(d+1) 维的最低温度与 d 维的 HP 相变温度一致；而在更高阶纯 Lovelock 理论中，这一关系被一个依赖于维度和阶数的因子修正，并在适当极限下回到 Einstein 结果。对于带电 AdS 黑洞，在巨正则系综中，广义相对论里两个温度相差一个简单的维度依赖因子，而在更高曲率纯 Lovelock 理论中不存在持续的普适关系。我们进一步分析 HP 相变处的归一化 Ruppeiner 标量曲率，并表明对于纯 Lovelock 理论中的电磁中性黑洞，它是一个仅依赖于时空维度的普适常数。对于 Einstein 理论情形下巨正则系综中的带电静态球对称黑洞，归一化标量曲率在适当条件下也保持为常数；而在一般纯 Lovelock 理论中，它依赖于压强和静电势等热力学参数，并在大压强极限或电势与压强同时很大的极限下渐近趋于常数。

English: We investigate the thermodynamic properties of static, spherically symmetric Anti-de Sitter (AdS) black holes, focusing on the interplay between characteristic temperatures, as well as on the universality of Ruppeiner scalar curvature at the Hawking-Page (HP) phase transition. In particular, we study the relation between the minimum temperature and the HP phase transition temperature for static, spherically symmetric AdS black holes in pure Lovelock gravity. For the electromagnetically neutral case in Einstein gravity, the minimum temperature in $(d+1)$ dimensions coincides with the HP transition temperature in $d$ dimensions, while in higher pure Lovelock theories this relation is modified by a dimension- and order-dependent factor, reducing to the Einstein result in appropriate limits. For charged AdS black holes, in the grand canonical ensemble, in general relativity, the two temperatures differ by a simple dimension-dependent factor, whereas no universal relation persists in higher curvature pure Lovelock theories. We further analyze the normalized Ruppeiner scalar curvature at the HP transition and show that it is a universal constant depending only on the spacetime dimension for electromagnetically neutral black holes in pure Lovelock theories. The normalized scalar curvature remains a constant, under appropriate conditions, even for the charged static spherically symmetric black holes in the grand canonical ensemble for the Einstein theory case, whereas in general pure Lovelock theories it depends on thermodynamic parameters such as pressure and electrostatic potential, asymptotically approaching a constant in the large-pressure or simultaneous large-potential and large-pressure limits.

中文摘要：我们研究了具有 N_f=2+1 味的热密 QCD 的全息 Einstein-Maxwell-Dilaton (EMD) 模型相图中的若干输运系数。我们的结果来自该模型的一个开源 C++ 实现，该实现作为 MUSES 框架内的一个模块公开可用。该代码包含一种新的数值方法，用于从全息模型的近边界渐近行为中提取热力学量，本文首次引入该方法，与早期实现相比，它极大地提高了数值稳定性和性能。得益于这一改进技术，我们能够针对从受零化学势格点 QCD 结果约束的贝叶斯后验分布中采样得到的该全息模型的许多实现进行计算。这使我们能够将格点 QCD 误差棒传播到宽温度与重子化学势窗口内输运系数的预言，涵盖 crossover 区域、预言临界点附近以及一阶相变线。物理观测量包括重子电导率和热导率、重子扩散、剪切与体粘度、喷注淬火参数、重夸克拖曳力以及 Langevin 扩散系数。在零重子密度下，我们将结果与 JETSCAPE 合作组从重离子数据中提取的估计值进行比较，发现二者符合良好。

English: We investigate several transport coefficients across the phase diagram of a holographic Einstein-Maxwell-Dilaton (EMD) model of hot and dense QCD with $N_f=2+1$ flavors. Our results are obtained from an open-source implementation of this model in C++, publicly available as a module within the MUSES Framework. This code includes a new numerical method to extract thermodynamic quantities from near-boundary asymptotics in holographic models, introduced here for the first time, which greatly improves numerical stability and performance in comparison to earlier implementations. Thanks to this improved technique, we are able to compute results for many realizations of our holographic model, sampled from a Bayesian posterior distribution constrained by lattice QCD results at zero chemical potential. This allows us to propagate lattice QCD error bars to predictions of transport coefficients in a wide window of temperature and baryon chemical potential, covering the crossover region, the neighborhood of the predicted critical point, and the line of first-order phase transition. The physical observables include baryon and thermal conductivities, baryon diffusion, shear and bulk viscosities, the jet-quenching parameter, the heavy-quark drag force, and Langevin diffusion coefficients. At vanishing baryon density, we compare our results to estimates extracted by the JETSCAPE Collaboration from heavy-ion data, with which we find good agreement.
