利用引力波检验引力的 Fisher 与 DALI 后验近似

Fisher and DALI posterior approximations for testing gravity with gravitational waves

Felipe A. da Silva Barbosa, Davi C. Rodrigues, Josiel Mendon\c{c}a Soares de Souza, Miguel Quartin · astro-ph.IM, astro-ph.CO, gr-qc, physics.data-an · v1 · 更新 2026-10-01

中文摘要：我们研究了在利用 inspiral 波形中的参数化偏离（TIGER 形式）检验广义相对论时，基于 Fisher 矩阵及其高阶扩展 DALI（Derivative Approximation for LIkelihoods）的后验近似在引力波参数估计中的精度与计算效率。我们采用 IMRPhenomD 波形，并将精确后验采样与按复杂度递增的以下近似进行比较：传统 Fisher 矩阵、Fisher 采样（singlet-DALI）、doublet-DALI 和 triplet-DALI。我们发现 singlet-DALI 和 doublet-DALI 都比精确后验显著更快，加速因子在 20 到 1000 之间，取决于 inspiral 信噪比——信噪比越大增益越大。对于更完整的波形（如 IMRPhenomHM），这些增益更大。为评估近似精度，我们使用 Jensen-Shannon 散度。我们得出结论：singlet-DALI 和 doublet-DALI 都系统性地优于标准 Fisher 矩阵近似，而 triplet-DALI 表现出较大波动，限制了其实际优势。我们还发布了一个包含 Fisher 和 DALI 分析新实现的代码（Symbolic DALI, SymDALI），它通过 Wolfram Language 符号计算导数。

English: We investigate the accuracy and computational efficiency of posterior approximations for gravitational-wave (GW) parameter estimation based on Fisher Matrix and its higher-order extension, the Derivative Approximation for LIkelihoods (DALI), in the context of tests of General Relativity using parameterized deviations in the inspiral waveforms (the TIGER formalism). We adopt the \texttt{IMRPhenomD} waveform and compare the exact posterior sampling to the following approximations in increasing order of complexity: the traditional Fisher Matrix, the Fisher sampling (singlet-DALI), the doublet-DALI and the triplet-DALI. We find that both singlet and doublet-DALI are significantly faster than the exact posterior by factors between 20 and 1000, depending on the inspiral SNRs -- larger gains correspond to larger SNRs. These gains are considerably larger for more complete waveforms, such as \texttt{IMRPhenomHM}. To evaluate the accuracy of the approximations, we use Jensen-Shannon divergence. We conclude that both singlet and doublet-DALI systematically improves over the standard Fisher Matrix approximation, while triplet-DALI shows large variability, limiting its practical advantage. We also introduce a code with a new implementation of Fisher and DALI analysis (Symbolic DALI, \texttt{SymDALI}) which computes derivatives symbolically via \textit{Wolfram Language}.

一句话导读：比较 Fisher 矩阵与 DALI 高阶后验近似在引力波参数估计和广义相对论检验中的精度与效率，并发布符号计算代码 SymDALI。

论规范引力对“几何三位一体”的“超动量挑战”

On Gauge Gravity's 'Hypermomentum Challenge' to the Geometric Trinity

Kartik Tiwari · physics.hist-ph, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-01

中文摘要：关于广义相对论与其两种重新表述（分别将引力编码在挠率和非度规性中）之间存在动力学等价性的主张已引起一些关注。若该主张成立，这一“几何三位一体”意味着，即使在原则上也无法确定一个人所处的时空解究竟具有曲率、挠率还是非度规性（就几何的探针是测试粒子路径而言）。该主张与将引力视为规范理论的悠久传统直接冲突，后者中不同的几何属性耦合到物质的不同属性（例如能动张量耦合到曲率，自旋角动量耦合到挠率）。在这篇短文中，我比较这两种相互冲突的时空几何化框架，并描述其分歧的确切来源、性质与含义。等价性主张仅在物质部分受到实质性限制时才成立，即物质不耦合到独立的仿射联络。由于相关耦合仍超出当前经验范围，两种框架之间的选择取决于本体论、认识论和方法论简约性之间的权衡。

English: Claims concerning a dynamical equivalence between general relativity and two reformulations of it, in which gravity is encoded in torsion and non-metricity respectively, have attracted some attention. If taken to be true, this 'Geometric Trinity' suggests that it is impossible to determine, even in principle, whether one inhabits a spacetime solution possessing curvature, torsion or non-metricity (insofar as the probes of geometry are paths of test particles). This claim is in direct tension with the long tradition of studying gravity as a gauge theory, in which distinct geometric attributes couple to distinct properties of matter (such as energy-momentum to curvature and spin angular momentum to torsion). In this short paper, I compare these two conflicting frameworks for geometrizing spacetime and describe the precise source, nature and implications of their disagreement. The equivalence claim holds only under a substantive restriction on the matter sector, namely that matter does not couple to an independent affine connection. Because the relevant couplings remain beyond current empirical reach, the choice between the frameworks turns on a trade-off among ontological, epistemic, and methodological forms of parsimony.

一句话导读：本文辨析广义相对论与挠率/非度规表述的“几何三位一体”等价性主张，指出其依赖物质不耦合独立仿射联络的限制，并与规范引力中不同几何属性耦合不同物质属性的图景冲突。

Schwarzschild-de Sitter 中标量波人工宇宙学的平直极限

Flat limit of artificial cosmology for scalar waves in Schwarzschild-de Sitter

An{\i}l Zengino\u{g}lu, Govind Arun Kumar · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-01

中文摘要：当宇宙学常数很小时，宇宙学波形如何近似孤立系统的波形？这个问题由观测到的很小的宇宙学常数，以及 Misner 通过共形紧致化调节爱因斯坦方程中形式上奇异项的思想所驱动。我们使用 Schwarzschild--de Sitter 背景上的标量波定量研究这个问题。一个合适的平直极限要求叶状结构在未来共形边界处保持正则。我们将从黑洞视界延伸到宇宙学视界的桥式叶状结构与一个正则的渐近平直极限进行比较。在几何匹配的数据上比较宇宙学与渐近平直波形表明，平直极限在数值上表现良好，并恢复了渐近平直波形的基本特征。我们通过引入一个不改变近区几何的宇宙学源来扩展 Misner 的人工宇宙学，并表明它改善了 ringdown 波形的一致性，但未能准确捕捉中间的多项式尾行为。

English: How do cosmological waveforms approximate waveforms from isolated systems for a small cosmological constant? This question is motivated by the observed small value of the cosmological constant, and also by Misner's idea to regulate the formally singular terms introduced into the Einstein equations by conformal compactification. We investigate this question quantitatively using scalar waves on Schwarzschild--de Sitter backgrounds. A suitable flat limit requires the foliation to remain regular at the future conformal boundary. We compare bridge foliations extending from the black hole horizon to the cosmological horizon with a regular asymptotically flat limit. Comparisons of cosmological and asymptotically flat waveforms on geometrically matched data show that the flat limit is numerically well behaved and recovers the essential features of the asymptotically flat waveform. We extend Misner's artificial cosmology by introducing a cosmological source that leaves the near-zone geometry unchanged and show that it improves agreement of the ringdown waveform but fails to capture the intermediate polynomial tail behavior accurately.

一句话导读：在 Schwarzschild-de Sitter 上定量检验标量波宇宙学波形的小宇宙学常数平直极限，并扩展 Misner 人工宇宙学。

通过 X 射线双星中的高频准周期振荡检验带电 bumblebee 黑洞

Testing charged bumblebee black holes through high-frequency quasi-periodic oscillations in X-ray binaries

Qi-Qi Liang, De-Jiang Yin, Zi-Qiang Cai, Zheng-Wen Long · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-01

中文摘要：我们研究了具有自发洛伦兹破缺效应的静态球对称带电 bumblebee 黑洞的强场轨道动力学。对零测地线和类时圆轨道的分析给出了光子球半径、最内稳定圆轨道（ISCO）半径以及试验粒子的特征轨道频率。在高频准周期振荡（HFQPOs）的相对论进动模型中，观测到的双峰频率由全部基本参数 M、X=r/M、l1、l2 和 Q0/M 决定。其中 l1、l2 和 Q0/M 仅以组合形式进入频率表达式，导致内禀参数简并。因此引入有效参数集 Θ=(M,X,C,β) 来刻画这些组合贡献。我们使用三个黑洞 X 射线双星 GRO J1655--40、XTE J1550--564 和 GRS 1915+105 的 HFQPO 观测数据进行贝叶斯 MCMC 参数推断。复合参数 C 的 68% 可信区间均包含 Reissner--Nordström 极限 C=1，表明在我们模型假设下没有统计显著的净洛伦兹破缺修正。不同的三元组 (l1,l2,Q0/M) 给出相同的 QPO 预言，因此仅凭 HFQPO 观测无法区分洛伦兹破缺效应与电荷相关效应；对这些基本量的精确限制需要额外、更精确的观测数据。

English: We investigate strong-field orbital dynamics for static spherically symmetric charged bumblebee black holes featuring spontaneous Lorentz-violating effects. Analysis of null and timelike circular geodesics yields the photon-sphere radius, the innermost stable circular orbit (ISCO) radius, and characteristic orbital frequencies for test particles. Within the relativistic precession model for high-frequency quasi-periodic oscillations (HFQPOs), observed twin-peak frequencies are governed by the full set of fundamental parameters $M$, $X=r/M$, $l_1$, $l_2$, and $Q_0/M$. Among them, $l_1$, $l_2$, and $Q_0/M$ enter frequency expressions only in combined forms, giving rise to intrinsic parameter degeneracy. An effective-parameter set $\Theta=(M,X,C,\beta)$ is accordingly introduced to characterize these composite contributions. Bayesian MCMC parameter inference is carried out using HFQPO observational data from three black-hole X-ray binaries: GRO J1655--40, XTE J1550--564, and GRS 1915+105. The 68\% credible intervals of composite parameter $C$ all contain the Reissner--Nordstr\"om limit $C=1$, revealing no statistically significant net Lorentz-violating correction under our model assumptions. Distinct triples $(l_1,l_2,Q_0/M)$ yield identical QPO predictions, so HFQPO observations alone cannot disentangle Lorentz-violating and charge-related effects; precise constraints on these fundamental quantities require additional, more precise observational data.

一句话导读：在带电 bumblebee 黑洞时空中计算强场轨道频率，并用 X 射线双星 HFQPO 数据做贝叶斯限制，未发现显著洛伦兹破缺修正。

幺模引力中带电荷的球对称薄壳

Spherical thin shells with charge in unimodular gravity

Gabriel R. Bengochea, Ernesto F. Eiroa, Griselda Figueroa-Aguirre · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-01

中文摘要：我们在幺模引力（UG）中构造球对称薄壳，并在径向、保持对称性的微扰下分析其动力学稳定性。我们使用 UG 连接条件，并采用由径向电场源产生的非守恒带电外部解。作为一个应用，我们构建带电真空泡：内部为 Minkowski 时空，外部由带电薄壳包围并匹配到 UG 外部几何。所得时空无事件视界和中心奇点，而在类 de Sitter 情形中壳外可能存在宇宙学视界。我们将稳定性区域和物质内容与广义相对论中的对应结果进行比较，发现一些由 UG 非守恒参数控制的差异。本工作扩展了此前发表的结果。

English: We construct spherically symmetric thin shells in unimodular gravity (UG) and analyze their dynamical stability under radial, symmetry-preserving perturbations. We use the UG junction conditions and adopt non-conservative charged exterior solutions sourced by a radial electric field. As an application, we build charged vacuum bubbles: a Minkowski interior surrounded by a charged thin shell and matched to an exterior UG geometry. The resulting spacetimes are free of event horizons and central singularities, while in de Sitter-like cases a cosmological horizon may exist outside the shell. We compare the stability regions and the matter content with their counterparts in general relativity, finding some differences controlled by the UG non-conservation parameter. This work extends previously published results.

一句话导读：在幺模引力中构造带电球对称薄壳与真空泡，分析其径向稳定性并与广义相对论比较。

MADGRAV：应用于 LIGO 数据的引力波搜索多级异常检测流程

MADGRAV: a multilevel anomaly-detection pipeline for gravitational-wave searches applied to LIGO data

Gianluca Inguglia, Huw Haigh, Ulyana Dupletsa, Alessandro Longo · gr-qc, astro-ph.IM, cs.LG · v1 · 更新 2026-10-01

中文摘要：我们展示了 MADGRAV 的结果，这是一个基于深度学习的高质量致密双星并合搜索，应用于 LIGO 干涉仪在第三次观测运行以及第四次观测运行第一、第二部分收集的数据。MADGRAV 流程由一系列顺序卷积神经网络组成，执行异常检测、毛刺分类、相干性检验和信号排序。我们通过 1 秒 Q 变换窗口研究 Hanford 和 Livingston LIGO 探测器的数据（分别以及相干）。在通过流程每一阶段的候选者中，48 个达到显著性阈值，我们报告了 47 个引力波探测，其虚警率低于 1 yr^-1，天体物理来源概率 p_astro>0.9。47 个探测中有 44 个与最小模型化相干 WaveBurst 搜索共享。从官方引力波瞬变目录提取的观测总源帧质量范围为 14–236 M_sun，中位数为 69 M_sun，中位信噪比为 16。我们注意到，回收的置信探测比例随质量上升：对于 LIGO 探测器网络 SNR>10，该流程回收 30 M_sun 以下置信目录事件的 8.1%，30–100 M_sun 之间的 39.8%，100 M_sun 以上的 53.3%，分别对应相干 WaveBurst 在同一区间探测事件的 33.3%、45.5% 和 53.3%。这些结果表明，异常检测流程可以作为独立探测通道，在高质量高信噪比区域补充匹配滤波。

English: We present the results of \textbf{MADGRAV}, a deep-learning-based search for high-mass compact binary coalescences, applied to the data collected by the LIGO interferometers during the third observing run and during the first and second part of the fourth observing run. The \textbf{MADGRAV} pipeline consists of a series of sequential convolutional neural networks that perform anomaly detection, glitch classification, coherence testing, and signal ranking. Data from the Hanford and Livingston LIGO detectors are studied (both individually and in coherence) by way of 1 second Q-transform windows. Of the candidates that survive every stage of the pipeline, 48 reach the significance threshold, and we report 47 gravitational wave detections characterised by a false alarm rate below $1\,{\rm yr}^{-1}$ with a probability of astrophysical origin $p_{\rm astro}>0.9$. Of the 47 detections, 44 are shared with the minimally modelled coherent WaveBurst search. The observed total source-frame masses, extracted from official gravitational wave transient catalogues, are in the $14-236 M_{\odot}$ range with a median of $69 M_{\odot}$, and a median SNR of 16. We note that the recovered fraction of confident detections rises with mass: for LIGO detectors network SNR $>10$ the pipeline recovers $8.1\%$ of confident catalog events below $30 M_{\odot}$, $39.8\%$ between $30$ and $100 M_{\odot}$, and $53.3\%$ above $100 M_{\odot}$, corresponding to $33.3\%$, $45.5\%$ and $53.3\%$ of the events detected by coherent WaveBurst in the same bins. These results suggest that anomaly detection pipelines can serve as an independent detection channel complementary to matched filtering in the high-mass high-SNR regime.

一句话导读：MADGRAV 深度学习异常检测流程在 LIGO O3/O4 数据中报告 47 个高置信引力波探测，并显示在高质量区可作为匹配滤波的补充通道。

具有完备渐近喉的黑洞

Black Holes With Complete Asymptotic Throats

Yi-Bo Liang, Hong-Rong Li · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-01

中文摘要：我们研究一个球对称黑洞能否在有限非零面积半径处具有完备内端，同时在其视界外足够远处满足标准能量条件。保留两个独立的度规函数，我们处理零类（null-type）和类空型（spacelike-type）渐近喉，并推导因果测地线完备性的一个必要且充分积分判据。在对独立曲率分量有有界性和有限极限假设下，零类型端点的极限曲率由喉半径固定，而类空类型端点允许一个额外的非负曲率参数。我们得到了在类时和零类平行传播标架中曲率有界的判据。完备的类空类型例子可以有有界标量不变量和有界类时标架曲率，但在无限仿射参数处零标架曲率无界。我们还证明，在所陈述类别中，径向零能量条件必须在每个完备内端任意近处失效。然而，具有任一种喉的显式实解析构造在足够远的外部区域处处满足零、弱、主和强能量条件。光滑构造可以在有限半径之外变成精确的 Schwarzschild。这些结果确立了完备渐近喉与外部能量条件的相容性，同时区分完备性与不同层次的曲率正则性。

English: We investigate whether a spherically symmetric black hole can have a complete inner end at finite, nonzero areal radius while satisfying the standard energy conditions sufficiently far outside its horizon. Retaining two independent metric functions, we treat both null-type and spacelike-type asymptotic throats and derive a necessary and sufficient integral criterion for causal geodesic completeness. Under boundedness and finite-limit assumptions on the independent curvature components, null-type ends have limiting curvature fixed by the throat radius, whereas spacelike-type ends admit an additional nonnegative curvature parameter. We obtain criteria for bounded curvature in timelike and null parallel-propagated frames. Complete spacelike-type examples can have bounded scalar invariants and bounded timelike-frame curvature but unbounded null-frame curvature at infinite affine parameter. We also prove that the radial null energy condition must fail arbitrarily close to every complete inner end in the stated class. Nevertheless, explicit real-analytic constructions with either type of throat satisfy the null, weak, dominant, and strong energy conditions throughout a sufficiently distant exterior region. Smooth constructions can become exactly Schwarzschild beyond a finite radius. These results establish the compatibility of complete asymptotic throats with exterior energy conditions while distinguishing completeness from different levels of curvature regularity.

一句话导读：该文证明球对称黑洞可在视界外满足标准能量条件的同时拥有完备渐近内喉，给出测地线完备性判据，并指出径向零能量条件在完备内端附近必被违反。

洛伦兹破坏暴胀中非正则动能的原初张量特征与引力波约束

Primordial Tensor Signatures and Gravitational Wave Constraints in Lorentz Violating Inflation with Non-Canonical Kinetics

Dibash Plaban Kalita, Shreya Banerjee · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO · v1 · 更新 2026-10-01

中文摘要：我们研究洛伦兹破坏暴胀框架中带非正则标量场动力学的原初张量扰动。采用含高阶动能项 K3X^2 的爱因斯坦-以太型理论，导出张量传播速度及其对有效洛伦兹破坏耦合的依赖。我们考虑一个可解析处理的无势背景，并研究两种代表性耦合 q_k=λ_T φ_k^2 和 q_k=λ_T φ_k^4。所得张量谱指数 n_T 及其跑动 α_T 满足不同的一致性关系，为原初引力波谱中的洛伦兹破坏提供潜在特征。我们导出张量倾斜和跑动对应的约束，并将其与 GW170817/GRB170817A 给出的晚期引力波速度严格限制比较。我们强调，将该限制转化为原初约束需要对张量扇区耦合从暴胀到晚期宇宙的演化作出假设。结果表明，原初张量观测量可为洛伦兹破坏及其与非正则暴胀动力学的相互作用提供互补探针。

English: We investigate primordial tensor perturbations in a Lorentz violating inflationary framework with non-canonical scalar field dynamics. Using an Einstein-\AE{}ther type with a higher order kinetic term $K_3X^2$, we derive the tensor propagation speed and its dependence on an effective Lorentz violating coupling. We consider an analytically tractable potential free background and study two representative couplings, $q_k=\lambda_T\phi_k^2$ and $q_k=\lambda_T\phi_k^4$. The resulting tensor spectral index $n_T$ and its running $\alpha_T$ satisfy distinct consistency relations, providing potential signatures of Lorentz violation in the primordial gravitational wave spectrum. We derive corresponding constraints from the tensor tilt and running and compare them with the stringent late-time bound on the gravitational wave speed from GW170817/GRB170817A. We emphasize that translating this bound into primordial constraint requires an assumption about the evolution of tensor sector coupling between inflation and the late Universe. Our results demonstrate that primordial tensor observables can provide a complementary probe of Lorentz violation and its interplay with non-canonical inflationary dynamics.

一句话导读：在含非正则动能和爱因斯坦-以太型洛伦兹破坏的暴胀模型中，导出张量传播速度、谱指数与跑动的一致性关系，并讨论原初引力波约束及 GW170817 限制。

迈向利用物理信息神经网络求解广义相对论

Towards solving General Relativity with Physics-Informed Neural Networks

Juan A. Carretero, Jorge F. Urb\'an, Fernando Abalos, Joan Mass\'o, Oscar A. Reula, Jose A. Pons, Carlos Palenzuela · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-01

中文摘要：物理信息神经网络（PINNs）是一种机器学习框架，通过约束神经网络满足底层物理定律来近似偏微分方程组的解。由此得到的连续表示不需要预定义的计算网格，并可在训练域内任意点求值。在本工作中，我们研究将 PINNs 应用于广义相对论的 Einstein 方程。我们讨论用于获得精确时空解的数学表述、网络架构、损失函数和训练策略，并通过数值相对论中的一系列标准基准展示该方法。随后，我们将该方法扩展到更具天体物理背景的情形，考虑一个孤立孤子玻色星的动力学演化。我们的模拟表明，直接在三维笛卡尔坐标中运行的 PINN 可以重现高度致密玻色星的平衡结构，并恢复其标志性的径向振荡频率。这些结果确立了 PINNs 作为求解耦合物质-Einstein 方程以及探索数值相对论中替代表述的可行补充框架。

English: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) are a machine-learning framework for approximating solutions to systems of partial differential equations by constraining neural networks to satisfy the underlying physical laws. The resulting continuous representation does not require a predefined computational mesh and can be evaluated at arbitrary points within the training domain. In this work, we investigate the application of PINNs to Einstein's equations of General Relativity. We discuss the mathematical formulation, network architectures, loss functions, and training strategies used to obtain accurate spacetime solutions, and demonstrate the approach through a series of standard benchmarks from Numerical Relativity. We then extend the method to a more astrophysical setting by considering the dynamical evolution of an isolated solitonic boson star. Our simulations show that a PINN operating directly in three-dimensional Cartesian coordinates can reproduce the equilibrium structure of a highly compact boson star and recover its characteristic radial oscillation frequencies. These results establish PINNs as a viable complementary framework for solving coupled matter-Einstein equations and exploring alternative formulations in numerical relativity.

一句话导读：将物理信息神经网络用于求解 Einstein 方程，并在数值相对论基准与孤子玻色星动力学中验证其可行性。

线性化广义相对论中一个强宇宙学耦合质量增长解

A Strong Cosmologically Coupled Mass Growth Solution in Linearized General Relativity

Kevin S. Croker, Joshua Cohon, Viktor T. Toth, Massimiliano Rinaldi, Nicolas Fernandez, Joel L. Weiner, Duncan Farrah, Gregory Tarl\'e, Gustavo Niz, Christopher Cain, James W. Rohlf, Alejandro Aviles, Jake Summers, Leander Thiele, Rogier A. Windhorst, Joshua Grumski-Flores · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO · v1 · 更新 2026-10-01

中文摘要：DESI Data Release 2 提高了对宇宙学耦合黑洞（CCBHs）作为加速晚期膨胀解释的兴趣，但已知的 CCBH 模型增长太慢，无法驱动该膨胀。我们在线性阶构造了一个广义相对论解，其 Hernandez-Misner-Sharp 质量随宇宙膨胀被动增长 ∝ a^κ。常数 κ 进入 Weyl 算符和应力-张量算符的所有本征值，因此这种增长在自由场和物质扇区中都是明确物理的。该解在恒星坍缩致密天体相关时空范围内是因果的。在 κ = 3 时出现一团被激发的真空云，补充了在其他地方为被激发真空黑洞质量预测的 a^3 标度。这是迈向 κ ∼ 3 的 CCBH 精确解的第一步，使得能够用脉冲星双星进行观测检验。

English: DESI Data Release 2 has heightened interest in cosmologically coupled black holes (CCBHs) as an explanation for accelerating late-time expansion, but known models for CCBHs grow too slowly to drive it. We construct at linear order a solution to General Relativity whose Hernandez-Misner-Sharp mass passively grows $\propto a^\kappa$ as the universe expands. The constant $\kappa$ enters all eigenvalues of the Weyl and stress-tensor operators, so growth is unambiguously physical in both free-field and material sectors. The solution is causal over spacetime relevant for stellar collapse compact objects. A cloud of energized vacuum emerges at $\kappa = 3$, complementing the $a^3$ scaling predicted elsewhere for the masses of energized vacuum black holes. This first step toward $\kappa \sim 3$ CCBH exact solutions enables observational tests with pulsar binaries.

一句话导读：在线性化广义相对论中构造了一个 Hernandez-Misner-Sharp 质量随尺度因子 ∝ a^κ 增长的宇宙学耦合黑洞解，为 κ∼3 情形和脉冲星双星观测检验铺路。

D≥4 中由共形耦合标量场支撑的可穿越虫洞：几何、测地线与准正规模

Traversable Wormholes Supported by Conformally Coupled Scalar Fields in $D \geq 4$: Geometry, Geodesics, and Quasinormal Modes

Pablo Vidal · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-01

中文摘要：本文分析由无质量共形耦合标量场生成的一类双参数 (μ,b) 非对称可穿越虫洞解。我们表明在适当参数范围内，该时空处处正则并具有两个渐近平直区域。随后定义虫洞喉部并验证 flare-out 条件，这导致广义相对论中经典能量条件被违反，因此需要奇异物质来维持喉部张开。我们通过有效势分析由零测地线支配的光子运动，数值计算轨迹并用嵌入图可视化。沿此路线，研究由无质量 Klein-Gordon 方程支配的标量扰动，并半解析和数值地求出 QNM 谱。有趣的是，这些扰动仅由一个参数 μ 支配，因此在 D=4 中发现虫洞与 BBMB/极端 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞之间的等谱性。本着 Morris 和 Thorne 开创性工作的精神，我们推导可穿越性条件并计算旅行者穿越虫洞的固有时。最后讨论可能的扩展和未来方向。

English: In this work, we analyze a two-parameter $(\mu, b)$ asymmetric family of traversable wormhole solutions generated by a massless conformally coupled scalar field. We show that, for a suitable range of parameters, the spacetime is everywhere regular and has two asymptotically flat regions. We then define the wormhole throat and verify the flare-out condition, which leads to violations of the classical energy conditions in GR, thereby requiring exotic matter to hold the throat open. We further analyze the motion of photons governed by null geodesics through an effective potential. The resulting trajectories are computed numerically and visualized using embedding diagrams. Following this route, we investigate scalar perturbations governed by the massless Klein-Gordon equation and find the QNM spectrum semianalytically and numerically. Interestingly enough, we show that such perturbations are governed by only one parameter $\mu$. Therefore, in $D = 4$, we find an isospectrality between the wormhole and the BBMB/Extremal Reissner-Nordstr\"om black hole. In the spirit of the seminal work of Morris and Thorne, we derive the conditions for traversability and compute the proper time for a traveler to traverse the wormhole. Finally, we discuss possible extensions and future directions for our work.

一句话导读：分析D≥4中双参数共形耦合标量场可穿越虫洞的几何、光子测地线、标量准正规模、等谱性与可穿越条件。
